original: pakṣaprāptasyāprāptāṃśaparipūraṇaphalako vidhirdvitīyaḥ| yathā "vrīhīnavahanti" iti| atra vidhyabhāve'pi puroḍāśaprakṛtidravyāṇāṃ vrīhīṇāṃ taṇḍulaniṣpattyākṣepādevāvahananaprāptirbhaviṣyatīti na tatprāptyartho'yaṃ vidhiḥ, kintvākṣepādavahananaprāptau tadvadeva lokāvagatakāraṇatvāviśeṣāt nakhavidalanādirapi pakṣe prāpnuyāditi avahananāprāptāṃśasya
analyzed: pakṣa prāptasya aprāpta aṃśa paripūraṇa phalakaḥ vidhiḥ dvitīyaḥ yathā vrīhīn avahanti iti atra vidhi abhāve pi puroḍāśa prakṛti dravyāṇām vrīhīṇām taṇḍula niṣpatti ākṣepāt eva avahanana prāptiḥ bhaviṣyati iti na tad prāpti arthaḥ yam vidhiḥ kintu ākṣepāt avahanana prāptau tadvat eva loka avagata kāraṇa tva aviśeṣāt nakha vidalana ādiḥ api pakṣe prāpnuyāt iti avahanana aprāpta aṃśasya aprāpta aṃśasya aprāpta aṃśasya aprā

original: dvayoḥ śeṣiṇorekasya śeṣasya vā ekasmiñcheṣiṇi dvayoḥ śeṣayorvā nityaprāptai śeṣyantarasya śeṣāntarasya vā nivṛttiphalako vidhistṛtīyaḥ| yathā agnicayane "imāmagṛbhṇannaśanāmṛtasyetyaśvābhidhānīmādattaṃ" iti, yathā vā cāturmāsyāntargateṣṭiviśeṣe gṛhamedhīye gṛhamedhīye "ājyabhāgau yajati" iti|

original: agnicayane aśvaraśanāgrahaṇaṃ gardabharaśanāgrahaṇaṃ ceti dvayamanuṣṭheyam| tatrāśvaraśanāgrahaṇe "imāmagṛbhṇan" iti mantro liṅgādeva raśanāgrahaṇaprakāśanasāmarthyarūpānnityaṃ prāpnotīti na tatprāptyarthaḥ, tadaprāptāṃśaparipūraṇārtho vā vidhiḥ, kiṃ tu liṅgāviśeṣāt gardabharaśanāgrahaṇe'pi mantraḥ prāpnuyāditi tannivṛttyarthaḥ|
analyzed: agni cayane aśva raśanā grahaṇam gardabha raśanā grahaṇam ca iti dvayam anuṣṭheyam tatra aśva raśanā grahaṇe imām agṛbhṇan iti mantraḥ liṅgāt eva raśanā grahaṇa prakāśana sāmarthya rūpāt nityam prāpnoti iti na tad prāpti arthaḥ tad aprāpta aṃśa paripūraṇa arthaḥ vā vidhiḥ kim tu liṅga aviśeṣāt gardabha raśanā grahaṇe api mantraḥ prāpnuyāt iti tad nivṛtti arthaḥ

original: tathā gṛhamedhīyasya darśapūrṇamāsaprakṛtikatvādatideśādevājyabhāgau nityaṃ prāpnuta iti na tatra vidhiḥ tatprāptyarthaḥ, tanniyamārtho vā kintvatideśāt prayājādikamapi prāpnuyāditi tannivṛttyarthaḥ| gṛhamedhīyādhikaraṇapūrvapakṣarītyedamudāharaṇaṃ yatra kkacidudāhartavyamityudāhṛtam|
analyzed: tathā gṛhamedhīyasya darśa pūrṇamāsa prakṛtika tvāt atideśāt eva ājyabhāgau nityam prāpnutaḥ iti na tatra vidhiḥ tad prāpti arthaḥ tad niyama arthaḥ vā kintu atideśāt prayāja ādikam api prāpnuyāt iti tad nivṛtti arthaḥ gṛhamedhīya adhikaraṇa pūrvapakṣa rītyā idam udāharaṇam yatra kkacid udāhartavyam iti udāhṛtam

original: na ca niyamavidhāvapi pakṣaprāptāvahananasyāprāptāṃśaparipūraṇe kṛte tadavaruddhatvāt pākṣikasādhanāntarasya nakhavidalanādernivṛttirapi labhyata itītaranivṛttiphalakatvāviśeṣānniyamaparisaṅkhyayoḥ phalato viveko na yukta iti śaṅkyam|
analyzed: na ca niyama vidhau api pakṣa prāptau ahananasya aprāpta aṃśa paripūraṇe kṛte tad avaruddha tvāt pākṣika sādhana antarasya nakha vidalana ādeḥ nivṛttiḥ api labhyate iti itara nivṛtti phalaka tva aviśeṣāt niyama parisaṅkhyayoḥ phalataḥ vivekaḥ na yuktaḥ iti śaṅkyam

original: vidhito'vahanananiyamaṃ vinā ākṣopalabhyasya nakhavidalanādernivartayitumaśakyatayā aprāptāṃśaparipūraṇarūpasya niyamasya prāthamyāt vidheyāvahananagatatvena pratyāsannatvācca tasyaiva niyamavidhiphalatvopagamāt| tadanuniṣpādinyā avidheyagatatvena viprakṛṣṭāyā itaranivṛtteḥ sānnikṛṣṭaphalasambhave phalatvānaucityāt|
analyzed: vidhitaḥ vahanana niyamam vinā ākṣa upalabhyasya nakha vidalana ādeḥ nivartayitum aśakya tayā aprāpta aṃśa paripūraṇa rūpasya niyamasya prāthamyāt vidheya avahanana gata tvena pratyāsanna tvāt ca tasya eva niyama vidhi phalatva upagamāt tad anuniṣpādinyāḥ avidheya gata tvena viprakṛṣṭāyāḥ itara nivṛtteḥ sānnikṛṣṭa phala sambhave phalatva anaucityāt

original: evaṃ viviktāsu tisṛṣu vidhāsu kiṃvidhaḥ śravaṇavidhirāśrīyate|
analyzed: evam viviktāsu tisṛṣu vidhāsu kiṃvidhaḥ śravaṇa vidhiḥ āśrīyate

original: atra prakaṭārthakārādayaḥ kecidāhuḥ apūrvavidhirayam| aprāptatvāt| na hi `vedāntaśravaṇaṃ brahmasākṣātkārahetuḥ'ityatra anvayavyatirekapramāṇamasti| loke kṛtaśravaṇasyāpi bahuśastadanutpatteḥ, akṛtaśrahavaṇasyāpi garbhagatasya vāmadevasya tadutpatterubhayato vyabhicārāt|
analyzed: atra prakaṭārthakāra ādayaḥ kecid āhuḥ apūrva vidhiḥ ayam aprāpta tvāt na hi vedānta śravaṇam brahma sākṣātkāra hetuḥ iti atra anvaya vyatireka pramāṇam asti loke kṛta śravaṇasya api bahuśas tad anutpatteḥ akṛta śrahavaṇasya api garbha gatasya vāmadevasya tad utpatteḥ ubhayatas vyabhicārāt

original: na vā `śravaṇamātraṃ śotavyārthasākṣātkārahetuḥ' iti śāstrāntaraśravaṇe gṛhītaḥ sāmānyaniyamo'sti| yenātra viśiṣya hetutvagrāhakābhāve'pi sāmānyamukhenaiva hetutvaṃ prāpyata ityāśaṅkyeta| gāndharvādiśāstraśravaṇasya ṣaḍjādisākṣātkārahetutvābhyupagame'pi karmakāṇḍādiśravaṇāt tadarthadhaऱmādisākṣātkārādarśanena vyabhicārāt| tasmādapūrvavidhirevāyam|
analyzed: na vā śravaṇa mātram śotavya artha sākṣātkāra hetuḥ iti śāstra antara śravaṇe gṛhītaḥ sāmānya niyamaḥ usti yena atra viśiṣya hetutva grāhaka abhāve pi sāmānya mukhena eva hetu tvam prāpyate iti āśaṅkyeta gāndharva ādi śāstra śravaṇasya ṣaḍja ādi sākṣātkāra hetutva abhyupagame api karmakāṇḍa ādi śravaṇāt tad artha dhaḍma ādi sākṣātkāra adarśanena vyabhicārāt tasmāt apūrva vidhiḥ eva ayam

original: bhāṣye'pi "sahakāryantaravidhiḥ pakṣeṇa tṛtīyaṃ tadvato vidhyādivat" ityadhikaraṇe "vidyāsahakāriṇo maunasya bālyapāṇḍityavādvidhirevāśrayitavyaḥ apūrvatvād" iti pāṇḍityaśabdaśabdite śravaṇe apūrvavidhirevāṅgīkriyate iti|
analyzed: bhāṣye api sahakāri antara vidhiḥ pakṣeṇa tṛtīyam tadvataḥ vidhi ādi vat iti adhikaraṇe vidyā sahakāriṇaḥ maunasya bālya pāṇḍitya vāt vidhiḥ eva āśrayitavyaḥ apūrva tvāt iti pāṇḍitya śabda śabdite śravaṇe apūrva vidhiḥ eva aṅgīkriyate iti

original: anyetu vedāntaśravaṇasya nityāparokṣabrahmasākṣātkārahetutvaṃ na aprāptam| aparokṣavastuviṣayakapramāṇatvāvacchedena sākṣātkārahetutvasya prāpteḥ śābdāparokṣavāde vyavasthāpanāt| tadarthameva hi tatprstāvaḥ|
analyzed: anye tu vedānta śravaṇasya nitya aparokṣa brahma sākṣātkāra hetutvam na aprāptam aparokṣa vastu viṣayaka pramāṇa tva avacchedena sākṣātkāra hetutvasya prāpteḥ śābda aparokṣa vāde vyavasthāpanāt tad artham eva hi tad prstāvaḥ

original: na ca tāvatā brahmapramāṇatvenāpātadarśanasādhāraṇabrahmasākṣātkārahetutvaprāptāvapi avidyānivṛttyarthamiṣyamāṇasattāniścayarūpatatsākṣātkārahetutvaṃ śravaṇasya na prāptamiti vācyam| vicāramātrasya vicāryanirṇayahetutvasya, brahmapramāṇasya tatsākṣātkārahetutvasya ca prāptau vicāritavedāntaśabdajñānarūpasya śravaṇasya taddhetutvapārpateḥ|
analyzed: na ca tāvatā brahma pramāṇa tvena āpāta darśana sādhāraṇa brahma sākṣātkāra hetutva prāptau api avidyā nivṛtti artham iṣyamāṇa sattā niścaya rūpa tad sākṣātkāra hetutvam śravaṇasya na prāptam iti vācyam vicāra mātrasya vicārya nirṇaya hetutvasya brahma pramāṇasya tad sākṣātkāra hetutvasya ca prāptau vicārita vedānta śabda jñāna rūpasya śravaṇasya tad hetutva pārpateḥ

original: na cokta ubhayato vyabhicāraḥ, sahakārivaikalyenānvayavyabhicārasyādoṣatvāt| jātismarasya janmāntaraśravaṇāt phalasambhavena vyatirekavyabhicārābhāvāt| anyathā viyabhicāreṇaiva hetutvabādhe śrutyā'pi tatsādhanatājñānāsambhavāt|
analyzed: na ca uktaḥ ubhayatas vyabhicāraḥ sahakāri vaikalyena anvaya vyabhicārasya adoṣa tvāt jāti smarasya janma antara śravaṇāt phala sambhavena vyatireka vyabhicāra abhāvāt anyathā viyabhicāreṇa eva hetu tva bādhe śrutyā api tad sādhanatā jñāna asambhavāt

original: ghaṭasākṣātkāre cakṣuratirekeṇa tvagindriyamiva brahmasākṣarātkāre śravaṇātirekeṇa upāyāntaramastītiśaṅkāyā vyatirekavyabhicārasyāpyadoṣatvātū| katathā ca prāptatvānnapūrvavidhiḥ|
analyzed: ghaṭa sākṣātkāre cakṣuḥ atirekeṇa tvac indriyam iva brahma sākṣarātkāre śravaṇa atirekeṇa upāya antaram asti iti śaṅkāyāḥ vyatireka vyabhicārasya api adoṣa tvāt ca prāptatvāt na pūrva vidhiḥ

original: ata eva "āvṛttirasatṛdupadeśāt" ityadhikaraṇabhāṣye "darśanaparyavasānāni he śravaṇādīnyāvartyamānāni dṛṣṭārthāni bhavanti| yathā'vaghātādīni taṇḍulaniṣpattiparyavasānāni" iti śravaṇasya brahmadarśanārthasya dṛṣṭārthatayā dārśapūrṇamāsikāvaghātanyāyaprāptāvāvṛttayupadeśaḥ| apūrvavidhitve tu sa na saṅgacchate sarvauṣadhāvaghātavat|
analyzed: atas eva āvṛtti rasa tṛd upadeśāt iti adhikaraṇa bhāṣye darśana paryavasānāni he śravaṇa ādīni āvartyamānāni dṛṣṭa arthāni bhavanti yathā avaghāta ādīni taṇḍula niṣpatti paryavasānāni iti śravaṇasya brahma darśana arthasya dṛṣṭārtha tayā dārśapūrṇamāsika avaghāta nyāya prāptau āvṛtti upadeśaḥ apūrva vidhi tve tu sa na saṅgacchate sarva auṣadha avaghāta vat

original: agnicayane "sarvauṣadhasya pūrayitvā'vahanti athaitadupadadhāti" ityupadheyolūkhalasaṃskārārthatvena vihitasyāvaghātasya dṛṣṭārthatvābhāvānnāvṛttiriti hi tantralakṣaṇe sthitam| ato niyamavidhirevāyam|
analyzed: agnicayane sarva auṣadhasya pūrayitvā āvahanti atha etat upadadhāti iti upadheya ulūkhala saṃskāra artha tvena vihitasya avaghātasya dṛṣṭārtha tva abhāvāt na avṛttiḥ iti hi tantra lakṣaṇe sthitam atas niyama vidhiḥ eva ayam

original: tadabhāve hi yathā vastu kiñciccakṣuṣā vīkṣamāṇastatra svāgṛhīte sūkṣme viśeṣāntare kenacit kathite tadavagamāya tasyaiva cakṣuṣaḥ punarapi sapraṇidhānaṃ vyāpāre pravartate, evaṃ manasā `aham' itigṛhyamāṇe jīve vedāntairadhyayanagṛhītairupadiṣṭaṃ nirviśeṣabrahmaṭacaitanyarūpatvamākarṇya tadavagaprāya tatra sāvadhānaṃ manasa eva praṇidhāne kadācit
analyzed: tad abhāve hi yathā vastu kiñcid cakṣuṣā vīkṣamāṇaḥ tatra sva agṛhīte sūkṣme viśeṣa antare kenacid kathite tad avagamāya tasya eva cakṣuṣaḥ punar api sa praṇidhānam vyāpāre pravartate evam manasā aham iti gṛhyamāṇe jīve vedāntaiḥ adhyayana gṛhītaiḥ upadiṣṭam nirviśeṣa brahmaṭa caitanya rūpa tvam ākarṇya tad avagaprāya tatra sāvadhānam manasaḥ eva praṇidhāne kadācid

original: puruṣaḥ pravarteteti vedāntaśravaṇe pravṛttiḥ pākṣikī syāt| "aprāpya manasā saha" iti śrutiḥ "manasaivānudraṣṭavyam" "dṛśyate tvagtyayā buddhyā" ityapi śravaṇenānavahitamanoviṣayeti śaṅkāsambhavāt|
analyzed: puruṣaḥ pravarteta iti vedānta śravaṇe pravṛttiḥ pākṣikī syāt a prāpya manasā saha iti śrutiḥ manasā eva anudraṣṭavyam dṛśyate tvac tyayā buddhyā iti api śravaṇena anavahita manaḥ viṣayā iti śaṅkā sambhavāt

original: athavā "juṣṭaṃ yadā paśyatyanyamīśamasya sahimānamiti vītaśokaḥ" ityādiśravaṇāt bhinnātmajñānānmuktiriti bhramasambhavena muktisādhanajñānāya bhinnātmavicārarūpe śāstrantaraśravaṇe'pi pakṣe pravṛttissyādityadvaitātmaparevadāntaśravaṇaniyamāvidhirayamastu| ihātmaśabdasya "idaṃ sarvaṃ yadayamātmā" ityādi prakaraṇaparyālocanayā advitīyātmaparatvāt|
analyzed: athavā juṣṭam yadā paśyati anyam īśam asya sahimānam iti vīta śokaḥ ityādi śravaṇāt bhinna ātma jñānāt muktiḥ iti bhrama sambhavena mukti sādhana jñānāya bhinna ātma vicāra rūpe śāstṛ antara śravaṇe pi pakṣe pravṛttiḥ syāt iti advaita ātma parevadānta śravaṇa niyama a vidhiḥ ayam astu iha ātma śabdasya idam sarvam yat ayam ātmā ityādi prakaraṇa paryālocanayā advitīya ātma paratvāt

original: na hi vastusatsādhanāntaraprāptāveva niyamavidhiriti kuladharmaḥ| yena vedāntaśravaṇaniyamārthavattvāya niyamādṛṣṭajanyasvapratibandhakakalmaṣanivṛttidvārā sattāniścayarūpabrahamasākṣātkārasya vedāntaśrahavaṇaikasādhyatvasyābhyupagantavyatvena tatra vastutaḥ sādhanāntarābhāvānna niyamavidhiryujyata iti āśaṅkayeta|

original: tattāṃśagocarajñānajananāsamarthasyāpīndriyasya tatsamarthasaṃskārasāhityāt pratyabhijñānajanakatvavat svato'parokṣajñānanāsamarthasyāpi śabdasya vidhuraparibhāvitakāminīsākṣātkārasthale tatsamarthatvena klṛptabhāvanāpracayasāhityādaparokṣajñānajanakatvaṃ yuktam|

original: śravaṇavidhervicārakartavyatāvidhāyakajijñāsāsūtramūlatvopagamācca| śravaṇavidhervicārikartavyatāvidhāyakajijñāsāsūtramūlatvopagamācca ūhāpohātmakamānasakriyārūpavicārasyaiva śravaṇatvaucityāt| na ca vicārasyaiva tātparyanirṇayadvārā, tajjanyatātparyabhramādipuruṣāparādharūpapratibandhakavigamadvārā vā brahamajñānaṃ phalamastviti vācyam|

original: tātparyajñānasya śābdajñāne kāraṇatvānupagamāt, kārye kvacidapi prātibandhakābhāvasya kāraṇatvānupagamācca tayordvāratvānupapatteḥ| brahmajñānasya vicārarūpātiriktakāraṇajanyatve tatprāmāṇyasya paratastvāpatteśca| tasmāttātparyanirṇayadvārā puruṣāparādhanirāsārthatvenaiva vicārarūpe śravaṇe niyamavidhiḥ|

original: "draṣṭavyaḥ" iti tu darśanārhatvena stutimātram, na śravaṇaphalasaṅkīrtanamiti saṅkṣepaśārīrakānusāriṇaḥ||
analyzed: draṣṭavyaḥ iti tu darśana arha tvena stuti mātram na śravaṇa phala saṅkīrtanam iti saṅkṣepaśārīraka anusāriṇaḥ

original: brahmajñānārthaṃ vedāntaśravaṇe pravṛttasya cikitsājñānārthaṃ carakasuśrutādiśravaṇe pravṛttasyeva madhye vyāpārāntare'pi pravṛttiḥ prasajyata iti tannivṛttiphalakaḥ "śrotavyaḥ" iti parisaṅkhyāvidhiḥ|
analyzed: brahma jñāna artham vedānta śravaṇe pravṛttasya cikitsā jñāna artham caraka suśruta ādi śravaṇe pravṛttasya iva madhye vyāpāra antare api pravṛttiḥ prasajyate iti tad nivṛtti phalakaḥ śrotavyaḥ iti parisaṅkhyā vidhiḥ

original: "brahmasaṃstho'mṛtatvameti" iti chāndegyeṃ ananyavyāpāratvasya muktyupāyatvāvadhāraṇātsampūrvasya tiṣṭhateḥ sāmāptivācitayā brahmasaṃsthāśabdaśabditāyā brahmaṇi samāpterananyavyāpārarūpatvāt| "tamevaikaṃ jānatha anyā vāco vimuñcatha" ityātharvaṇe kaṇṭhata eva vyāpārāntarapratiṣedhācca| "āsupterāmṛteḥ kālaṃ nayedvedāntacintayā" ityādismṛteśca|
analyzed: brahma saṃsthaḥ umṛta tvam eti iti chāndegyeṃ an anya vyāpāra tvasya mukti upāya tva avadhāraṇāt sampūrvasya tiṣṭhateḥ sāma āpti vācitayā brahma saṃsthā śabda śabditāyāḥ brahmaṇi samāpteḥ an anya vyāpāra rūpatvāt tam eva ekam jānatha anyāḥ vācaḥ vimuñcatha iti ātharvaṇe kaṇṭhataḥ eva vyāpāra antara pratiṣedhāt ca āsupteḥ āmṛteḥ kālam nayet vedānta cintayā ityādi smṛteḥ ca

original: na ca brahmajñānānupayogino vyāpārāntarasya ekasmini sādhye śravaṇena saha samuccitya prāptyabhāvānna tannivṛttyarthaḥ parisaṅkhyāvidhiryujyate iti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca brahma jñāna anupayoginaḥ vyāpāra antarasya ekasmini sādhye śravaṇena saha samuccitya prāpti abhāvāt na tad nivṛtti arthaḥ parisaṅkhyā vidhiḥ yujyate iti vācyam

original: "sahakāryantaravidhiḥ" ityādisūtre `yasmāt pakṣe bhedadarśanaprābalyānna prāpnoti, tasmānniyamavidhiḥ' iti tadbhāṣye ca kṛtaśravaṇasya śābdajñānamātrāt kṛtakṛtyātāṃ manvānasyāvidyānivartakasākṣātkāropayogini nidhidhyāsane pravṛttirna syādini atatsādhanapakṣaprāptimātreṇa nididhyāsane niyamavidherabhyupagatatayā tannyāyenāsādhanasya samuccitya
analyzed: sahakāri antara vidhiḥ ityādi sūtre yasmāt pakṣe bheda darśana prābalyāt na prāpnoti tasmāt niyama vidhiḥ iti tad bhāṣye ca kṛta śravaṇasya śābda jñāna mātrāt kṛtakṛtyātām manvānasya avidyā nivartaka sākṣātkāra upayogini nidhi dhyāsane pravṛttiḥ na syāt ini atatsādhana pakṣa prāpti mātreṇa nididhyāsane niyama vidheḥ abhyupagata tayā tad nyāyena asādhanasya samuccitya

analyzed: ityādi śruteḥ kṛtstra vyāvahārika prapañcasya brahmā eva upādānam jīvaḥ tu prātibhāsikasya svapna prapañcasya ca kṛtstra prasaktiḥ nirakyavatva śabda kopaḥ vā iti adhikaraṇe brahmaṇaḥ jagat upādāna tve tasya kārtsnyena jagat ākāreṇa pariṇāme vikara atirekeṇa brahma abhāvaḥ vā eka ādeśena pariṇāme niravayava tva śruti virodhaḥ vā prasajyate iti pūrvapakṣe ātmani ca evam

original: vicitrāśca hi' iti satreṇa vivartavādābhiprāyeṇa svapnadṛśi jīvātmani svarūpānupamardanenānekākārasvāpnaprapañcasṛṣṭivat brahmaṇi viyadādisṛṣṭirupapadyate iti siddhāntitatvādityanye||
analyzed: vicitrāḥ ca hi iti satreṇa vivarta vāda abhiprāyeṇa svapna dṛśi jīvātmani svarūpa anupamardanena aneka ākāra svāpna prapañca sṛṣṭi vat brahmaṇi viyat ādi sṛṣṭiḥ upapadyate iti siddhāntita tvāt iti anye

original: atha "māyāṃ tu prakṛtiṃ vidyāt" iti śruteḥ, māyājāḍyasya ghaṭādiṣvanugamācca māyā jagadupādānaṃ pratīyate, kathaṃ brahmopādānam?|
analyzed: atha māyām tu prakṛtim vidyāt iti śruteḥ māyā jāḍyasya ghaṭa ādiṣu anugamāt ca māyā jagat upādānam pratīyate katham brahma upādānam

original: atrāhuḥ padārthatattvanirṇayakārāḥ brahma māyā cetyubhayamupādānamityubhayaśrutyupapattiḥ, sattājāḍyarūpobhayadharmānugatyupapattiśca| tatra brahma vivartamānatayopādānam, avidyā pariṇamānatayā|
analyzed: atra āhuḥ padārtha tattva nirṇaya kārāḥ brahma māyā ca iti ubhayam upādānam iti ubhaya śruti upapattiḥ sattā jāḍya rūpa ubhaya dharma anugati upapattiḥ ca tatra brahma vivartamāna tayā upādānam avidyā pariṇamāna tayā

original: na ca vivartādhiṣṭhāne pāribhāṣikamupādānatvam| svātmani kāryajanihetutvasyopādānalakṣaṇasya tatrāpyaviśeṣāditi||
analyzed: na ca vivarta adhiṣṭhāne pāribhāṣikam upādāna tvam sva ātmani kārya jani hetu tvasya upādāna lakṣaṇasya tatra api aviśeṣāt iti

original: kecit uktāmeva prakriyāmāśritya vivartapariṇāmopādānadvayasādhāraṇamanyallakṣamāhuḥ svābhinnakāryajanakatvamupādānatvam| asti ca prapañcasya sadrūpeṇa brahmaṇā vivartamānena jaḍenājñānena pariṇāminā cābhedaḥ| `san ghaṭaḥ, jaḍo ghaṭaḥ' iti sāmānādhikaraṇyānubhavāt|
analyzed: kecid uktām eva prakriyām āśritya vivarta pariṇāma upādāna dvaya sādhāraṇam anyat lakṣam āhuḥ sva abhinna kārya janakatvam upādānatvam asti ca prapañcasya sat rūpeṇa brahmaṇā vivartamānena jaḍena ajñānena pariṇāminā ca abhedaḥ san ghaṭaḥ jaḍaḥ ghaṭaḥ iti sāmānādhikaraṇya anubhavāt

original: na ca `tadananyatvamārambhaṇaśabdādibhyaḥ' iti sūtre `ananyatva vyatirekeṇābhāvaḥ| na khalvananyatvamityabhedaṃ brūmaḥ, kintu? bhedaṃ vyāsedhāmaḥ' iti bhāṣyabhāmatīnibrandhanābhyāṃ prapañcasya brahmābhedaniṣedhādabhedābhyupagame upasiddhānta iti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca tad ananyatvam ārambhaṇa śabda ādibhyaḥ iti sūtre ananyatva vyatirekeṇa abhāvaḥ na khalu ananyatvam iti abhedam brūmaḥ kintu bhedam vyāsedhāmaḥ iti bhāṣya bhāmatī nibrandhanābhyām prapañcasya brahma abheda niṣedhāt abheda abhyupagame upasiddhāntaḥ iti vācyam

original: tayorbrahmarūpadharmisamānasattākābhedaniṣedhe tātparyeṇa śuktirajatayoriva prātītikābhedābhyupagame'pi virodhābhāvāditi||
analyzed: tayoḥ brahma rūpa dharmi samāna sattāka abheda niṣedhe tātparyeṇa śukti rajatayoḥ iva prātītika abheda abhyupagame pi virodha abhāvāt iti

original: saṅkṣepaśārīrakakṛtastu brahmaivopādānam|kūṭasthasya svataḥ kāraṇatvānupapatteḥ māyā dvārakāraṇam| akāraṇamapi dvāraṃ kārye'nugacchati| mṛda iva tadgataślakṣṇatvāderapi anugamanadarśanādityāhuḥ||
analyzed: saṅkṣepaśārīraka kṛtaḥ tu brahma eva upādānam kūṭasthasya svatas kāraṇatva anupapatteḥ māyā dvāra kāraṇam akāraṇam api dvāram kārye anugacchati mṛdaḥ iva tad gata ślakṣṇa tva ādeḥ api anugamana darśanāt iti āhuḥ

original: vācaspatimiśrāstu jīvāśritamāyāviṣayīkṛtaṃ brahama svata eva jāḍyāśrayaprapañcākāreṇa vivartamānatayopādānamiti māyā sahakārimātram, na kāryānugataṃ dvārakāraṇamityāhuḥ||
analyzed: vācaspati miśrāḥ tu jīva āśrita māyā viṣayīkṛtam svatas eva jāḍya āśraya prapañca ākāreṇa vivartamāna tayā upādānam iti māyā sahakāri mātram na kārya anugatam dvāra kāraṇam iti āhuḥ

original: siddhāntamuktāvalīkṛtastu māyāśaktirevopādānaṃ na brahma "tadetad brahmāpūrvamanaparamabāhyam" "na tasya kāryaṃ karaṇaṃ ca vidyate" ityādiśruteḥ jagadupādānamāyādhiṣṭhānatvena upacārādupādānam, tādṛśamevopādānatvaṃ lakṣaṇe vivakṣitamityāhuḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: siddhāntamuktāvalī kṛtaḥ tu māyā śaktiḥ eva upādānam na brahma tat etat brahma apūrvam anaparam abāhyam na tasya kāryam karaṇam ca vidyate ityādi śruteḥ jagat upādāna māyā adhiṣṭhāna tvena upacārāt upādānam tādṛśam eva upādānatvam lakṣaṇe vivakṣitam iti āhuḥ

original: atha ka īśvaraḥ ko vā jīvaḥ?| atroktaṃ prakaṭārthavivaraṇe anādiranirvācyā bhūtaprakṛtiścinmātrasambandhinī māyā| tasyāṃ citpratibimba īśvaraḥ, tasyā eva paricchinnānantapradeśeṣvāvaraṇavikṣepaśaktimatsu avidyābhidhāneṣu citpratibimbo jīva iti||
analyzed: atha kaḥ īśvaraḥ kaḥ vā jīvaḥ atra uktam prakaṭa artha vivaraṇe anādiḥ anirvācyā bhūtaprakṛtiḥ cit mātra sambandhinī māyā tasyām cit pratibimbaḥ īśvaraḥ tasyāḥ eva paricchinna ananta pradeśeṣu āvaraṇa vikṣepa śaktimatsu avidyā abhidhāneṣu cit pratibimbaḥ jīvaḥ iti

original: tattvaviveke tu triguṇātmikāyā mūlaprakṛteḥ "jīveśāvābhāsena karoti māyā cāvidyā ca svayameva bhavati" iti śrutisiddhau dvau rūpabhedau| rajastamo'nabhibhūtaśuddhasattvapradhānā māyā, tadabhibhūtamalinasattvā avidyeti māyā'vidyābhedaṃ parikalpya, māyāpratibimba īśvaraḥ, avidyāpratibimbo jīva ityuktam||
analyzed: tattvaviveke tu triguṇa ātmikāyāḥ mūlaprakṛteḥ jīva īśau ābhāsena karoti māyā ca avidyā ca svayam eva bhavati iti śruti siddhau dvau rūpa bhedau māyā tad abhibhūta malina sattvā avidyā iti māyā avidyā bhedam parikalpya māyā pratibimbaḥ īśvaraḥ avidyā pratibimbaḥ jīvaḥ iti uktam

original: ekaiva mūlaprakṛtirvikṣepaprādhānyena māyāśabditeśvaropādhiḥ, āvaraṇaprādhānyenāvidyā 'jñānaśabditā jīvopādhiḥ| ata eva tasyā jīveśvarasādhāraṇacinmātrasambandhitve'pi jīvasyaiva `ajño'smi'ityajñānasambandhānubhavaḥ neśvarasyeti jīveśvaravibhāgaḥ kvacidupapāditaḥ||
analyzed: ekā eva mūlaprakṛtiḥ vikṣepa prādhānyena māyā śabditā īśvara upādhiḥ āvaraṇa prādhānyena avidyā jñāna śabditā jīva upādhiḥ atas eva tasyāḥ jīva īśvara sādhāraṇa cit mātra sambandhi tve pi jīvasya eva ajñaḥ asmi iti ajñāna sambandha anubhavaḥ na īśvarasya iti jīva īśvara vibhāgaḥ kvacid upapāditaḥ

original: saṅkṣepaśārīrake tu kāryopādhirayaṃ jīvaḥ kāraṇopādhirīśvaraḥ||
analyzed: saṅkṣepaśārīrake tu kārya upādhiḥ ayam jīvaḥ kāraṇa upādhiḥ īśvaraḥ

original: iti śrutimanusṛtyāvidyāyāṃ citpratibimba īśvaraḥ, antaḥ karaṇe citpratibimbo jīvaḥ| na cāntaḥkaraṇarūpeṇa dravyeṇa ghaṭenākāśasyeva caitanyasyāvacchedasambhavāt tadavacchinnameva caitanyaṃ jīvo'stviti vācyam| iha paratra ca jīvabhāvenāvacchedyacaitanyapradeśasya bhedena kṛtahānākṛtābhyāgamaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: iti śrutim anusṛtya avidyāyām cit pratibimbaḥ īśvaraḥ antar karaṇe cit pratibimbaḥ jīvaḥ na ca antaḥkaraṇa rūpeṇa dravyeṇa ghaṭena ākāśasya iva caitanyasya avaccheda sambhavāt tad avacchinnam eva caitanyam jīva ustu iti vācyam iha paratra ca jīva bhāvena avacchedya caitanya pradeśasya bhedena kṛta hāna akṛta abhyāgama prasaṅgāt

original: pratibimbastūpādhergatāgatayoravacchedyavanna bhidyate iti pratibimbapakṣe nāyaṃ doṣa ityuktam|
analyzed: pratibimbaḥ tu upādheḥ gata agatayoḥ avacchedya vat na bhidyate iti pratibimba pakṣe na ayam doṣaḥ iti uktam

original: evamukteṣveteṣu jīveśvarayoḥ pratibimbaviśeṣatvapakṣeṣu yat bimbasthānīyaṃ brahma tat muktaprāpyaṃ śuddhacaitanyam||
analyzed: evam ukteṣu eteṣu jīva īśvarayoḥ pratibimba viśeṣa tva pakṣeṣu yat bimba sthānīyam brahma tat mukta prāpyam śuddha caitanyam

original: citradīpe `jīva īśo viśuddhā cit' iti traividhyaprakriyā vihāya yathā ghaṭāvacchinnākāśo ghaṭākāśaḥ, tadāśrite jalaṃ pratibimbitassābhranakṣatro jalākāśaḥ, anavacchinno mahākāśaḥ, mahākāśamadhyavartini meghamaṇḍale vṛṣṭilakṣaṇakāryānumeyeṣu jalarūpatadavayaveṣu tuṣārākāreṣu pratibimbito meghākāśaḥ iti vastuta ekasyāpyākāśasya cāturvidhyam, tathā
analyzed: citradīpe jīvaḥ īśaḥ viśuddhā cit iti traividhya prakriyāḥ vihāya yathā ghaṭa avacchinna ākāśaḥ ghaṭa ākāśaḥ tad āśrite jalam pratibimbitaḥ sa abhra nakṣatraḥ jala ākāśaḥ anavacchinnaḥ mahākāśaḥ mahākāśa madhya vartini megha maṇḍale vṛṣṭi lakṣaṇa kārya anumeyeṣu jala rūpa tad avayaveṣu tuṣāra ākāreṣu pratibimbitaḥ megha ākāśaḥ iti vastutas ekasya api ākāśasya cāturvidhyam tathā

original: sthūlasūkṣmadehadvayasyādhiṣṭhānatayā vartamānaṃ tadavacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ kūṭavannirvikāratvena sthitaṃ kūṭastham, tatra kalpite'ntaḥ karaṇe pratibimbitaṃ caitanyaṃ saṃsārayogī jīvaḥ, anavacchinnaṃ caitanyaṃ brahma, tadāśrite māyātamasi sthitāsu sarvaprāṇināṃ dhīvāsanāsu pratibimbitaṃ caitanyamīśvaraḥ iti caitanyasya cāturvidhyaṃ
analyzed: sthūla sūkṣma deha dvayasya adhiṣṭhāna tayā vartamānam tad avacchinnam caitanyam kūṭa vat nirvikāra tvena sthitam kūṭastham tatra kalpita intar karaṇe pratibimbitam caitanyam saṃsāra yogī jīvaḥ anavacchinnam caitanyam brahma tad āśrite māyā tamasi sthitāsu sarva prāṇinām dhī vāsanāsu pratibimbitam caitanyam īśvaraḥ iti caitanyasya cāturvidhyam

original: parikalpyāntaḥkaraṇadhīvāsanoparaktājñānopādhibhedena jīveśvaravibhāgo darśitaḥ|
analyzed: parikalpya antaḥkaraṇa dhī vāsanā uparakta ajñāna upādhi bhedena jīva īśvara vibhāgaḥ darśitaḥ

original: ayaṃ cāparastadabhihito viśeṣaḥ caturvidheṣu caitanyeṣu jīvaḥ `aham' iti prakāśamānaḥ kūṭasthe avidyātirohitāsaṅgānandarūpaviśeṣāśeśuktau rupyavadadhyastaḥ| ata evedantvarajatatvayorivādhiṣṭhānasāmānyāṃśādhyastaviśeṣāṃśarūpayosvayantvāhantvayoḥ saha prakāśaḥ `svayamahaṃ karomi' ityādau| ahantvaṃ tvadhyastaviśeṣāṃśarūpam |
analyzed: ayam ca aparaḥ tad abhihitaḥ viśeṣaḥ caturvidheṣu caitanyeṣu jīvaḥ aham iti prakāśamānaḥ kūṭasthe avidyā tirohita āsaṅga ānanda rūpa viśeṣa āśe śuktau rupya vat adhyastaḥ atas eva idantva rajatatvayoḥ iva adhiṣṭhāna sāmānya aṃśa adhyasta viśeṣa aṃśa rūpayoḥ svayantva ahaṃtvayoḥ saha prakāśaḥ svayam aham karomi ityādau ahantvam tu adhyasta viśeṣa aṃśa rūpam

original: puruṣāntarasya puruṣāntare `aham' itivyavahārābhāvena vyāvṛttatvāt| svayantvaṃ cānyatvapratiyogyadhiṣṭhānasāmānyāśarūpam| `svayaṃ devadatto gacchati' iti puruṣāntare'pi vyavahāreṇānuvṛttatvāt| evaṃ parasparādhyāsādeva kūṭasthajīvayoraviveko laukikānām|
analyzed: puruṣa antarasya puruṣa antare aham iti vyavahāra abhāvena vyāvṛtta tvāt svayantvam ca anyatva pratiyogi adhiṣṭhāna sāmānya āśa rūpam svayam devadattaḥ gacchati iti puruṣa antare api vyavahāreṇa anuvṛtta tvāt evam paraspara adhyāsāt eva kūṭastha jīvayoḥ avivekaḥ laukikānām

original: vivekastu tayorbṛhadāraṇyake "prajñānaghana evaitebhye bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tānyevānu vinaśyati" iti jīvābhiprāyeṇopādhivināśānuvināśapratipādanena, "avināśī vā are'yamātmā" iti kūṭasthābhiprāyeṇāvināśapratipādanena ca spaṣṭaḥ| ahamarthasya jīvasya vināśitve kathamavināśibrahmābhedaḥ| nedamabhede sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ, kiṃ tu bādhāyām|
analyzed: vivekaḥ tu tayoḥ bṛhadāraṇyake prajñāna ghanaḥ eva etebhyaḥ bhūtebhyaḥ samutthāya tāni eva anu vinaśyati iti jīva abhiprāyeṇa upādhi vināśa anuvināśa pratipādanena avināśī vai are yam ātmā iti kūṭastha abhiprāyeṇa avināśa pratipādanena ca spaṣṭaḥ aham arthasya jīvasya vināśi tve katham avināśi brahma abhedaḥ na idam abhede sāmānādhikaraṇyam kim tu bādhāyām

original: yathā `yaḥ sthāṇureṣa pumān' iti puruṣatvabodhena sthāṇutvabuddhirnivartyate| evam `ahaṃ brahmāsmi' iti kūṭasthabrahmasvarūpatvabodhenādhyastāhamartharūpatvaṃ nivartyate|
analyzed: yathā yaḥ sthāṇuḥ eṣa pumān iti puruṣa tva bodhena sthāṇu tva buddhiḥ nivartyate evam aham brahma asmi iti kūṭastha brahma svarūpa tva bodhena adhyasta ahamartha rūpa tvam nivartyate

original: yo'yaṃ sthāṇuḥ pumāneṣa pundhiyā sthāṇudhīriva||
analyzed: yaḥ ayam sthāṇuḥ pumān eṣa pundhiyā sthāṇu dhīḥ iva

original: brahmāsmītidhiyā'raśeṣā hyahambuddhirnivartate || 1 ||
analyzed: brahma asmi iti dhiyā araśeṣā hi aham buddhiḥ nivartate 1

original: iti naiṣkarmyasiddhivacanāt| yadi ca vivaraṇādyuktarītyā idamabhede sāmānādhikaraṇyam, tadā jīvavācino'haṃśabdasya lakṣaṇayā kūṭasthaparatvamastu| tasyānadhyastasya brahmābhede yogyatvāt|

original: anenaiva nikhilaprapañcaracanākartṛbhāvenārthasiddhaṃ sarvajñitvaṃ brahmaṇaḥ `śāstrayonitvāt' ityadhikaraṇe vedakartṛtvenāpi samarthitam||

original: prakaṭārthakārāstvāhuḥ yathā jīvasya svopādhyantaḥkaraṇapariṇāmāścaitanyapratibimbagrāhiṇa iti tadyogāt jñātṛtvam, evaṃ brahmaṇaḥ svopādhimāyāpariṇāmāścitpratibimbagrāhiṇassantīti tatpratibimbitaiḥ sphuraṇaiḥ kālatrayavartino'pi prapañcasyāpirokṣeṇāvakalanāt sarvajñatvamiti||

original: tattvaśuddhikārāstūktarītyā brahmaṇo vidyamānanikhilaprapañca sārātkārasambhavāt tajjanitasaṃskāravattayā ca smaraṇopapatteratītasakalavastvavabhāsasiddhiḥ|

original: sṛṣṭeḥpāṅmāyāyāssṛjyamānanikhilapadārthasphuraṇarūpeṇa jīvādṛṣṭānurodhena vivartamānatvāt tatsākṣitayā tadupādhikasya brahmaṇo'pi tatsādhakatvasiddheḥ anāgatavastuviṣayavijñānopapattiriti sarvajñatvaṃ samarthayante||

original: kaumudīkṛtastu vadanti svarūpajñānenaiva brahmaṇaḥ svasaṃsṛṣṭasarvāvabhāsakatvāt sarvajñatvam| atītānāgatayorapyavidyāyāṃ citrabhitrau vimṛṣṭānunmīlitacitravat saṃskārātmanā sattvena tatsaṃsargasyāpyupapatteḥ| na tu vṛttijñānaistasya sarvajñātvam|
analyzed: kaumudīkṛtaḥ tu vadanti sva rūpa jñānena eva brahmaṇaḥ sva saṃsṛṣṭa sarva avabhāsaka tvāt sarvajñatvam atīta anāgatayoḥ api avidyāyām citra bhitrau vimṛṣṭa an unmīlita citra vat saṃskāra ātmanā sattvena tad saṃsargasya api upapatteḥ na tu vṛtti jñānaiḥ tasya sarvajña tvam

original: "tameva bhāntamanu bhāti sarvam" iti sāvadhāraṇaśrutivirodhātsṛṣṭeḥ prāgekamevādvitīyamityavadhāraṇānurodhena mahābhūtānāmipa vṛttijñānānāmapi pralayasya vaktavyatayā brahmaṇastadā sarvajñatvābhāvāpattyā prāthamikamāyāvivartarūpe īkṣaṇe tatpūrvake mahābhūtādau ca sraṣṭṭatvābhāvaprasaṅgācca|
analyzed: tam eva bhāntam anu bhāti sarvam iti sa avadhāraṇa śruti virodhāt sṛṣṭeḥ prāk ekam eva advitīyam iti avadhāraṇa anurodhena mahābhūtānām ipa vṛtti jñānānām api pralayasya vaktavya tayā brahmaṇaḥ tadā sarvajñatva abhāva āpattyā prāthamika māyā vivarta rūpe īkṣaṇe tad pūrvake mahābhūta ādau ca sraṣṭṛ tva abhāva prasaṅgāt ca

original: evaṃ sati brahmaṇassrvaviviṣayajñānātmakatvameva syāt, na tu sarvajñātṛtvarūpaṃ sarvajñatvamiti cet, satyam| sarvaviṣayajñānātmakayeva brahma, na tu sarvajñānakartṛtvarūpaṃ jñātṛtvamasti| ata eva`vākyānvayāt' ityādhikaraṇe vijñātṛtvaṃ jīvaliṅgamityuktaṃ bhāṣyakāraiḥ| "yassarvajñaḥ" ityādiśrutirapi tasya jñānarūpatvābhiprāyeṇaiva yojanīyeti|
analyzed: evam sati brahmaṇaḥ srva vi viṣaya jñāna ātmaka tvam eva syāt na tu sarvajñātṛ tva rūpam sarvajñatvam iti ced satyam sarva viṣaya jñāna ātmakayā iva brahma na tu sarva jñāna kartṛ tva rūpam jñātṛ tvam asti atas eva vākya anvayāt itya adhikaraṇe vijñātṛ tvam jīva liṅgam iti uktam bhāṣyakāraiḥ yaḥ sarvajñaḥ ityādi śrutiḥ api tasya jñāna rūpatva abhiprāyeṇa eva yojanīyā iti

original: yadyapi brahma svarūpacaitanyenaiva spasaṃsṛṣṭasarvāvabhāsakaṃ, tathāpi tasya svarūpeṇākāryatve'pi dṛśyāvacchinnarūpeṇa tu brahmakāryatvāt| "yassarvajñaḥ" iti jñānajananakartṛtvaśruterapi na kaścidvirodha iti ācāryavācaspatimiśrāḥ||9||
analyzed: yadi api brahma sva rūpa caitanyena eva tathā api tasya sva rūpeṇa akārya tve pi dṛśya avacchinna rūpeṇa tu brahma kārya tvāt yaḥ sarvajñaḥ iti jñāna janana kartṛ tva śruteḥ api na kaścid virodhaḥ iti ācārya vācaspatimiśrāḥ

original: nanvīśvaravajjīvo'pi vṛttimanapekṣya svarūpacaitanyenaiva kimiti viṣayānnāvabhāsayati?

original: atroktaṃ vivaraṇe brahmacaitanyaṃ sarvopādānatayā sarvatādātmyāpannaṃ sat svasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ sarvamavabhāsayati, na jīvacaitanyam| tasyāvidyopādhikarayā sarvagatatve'pyanupādānatvenāsaṅgitvāt| yathā sarvagataṃ gotvasāmānyaṃ svabhāvādaśvādivyaktisaṅgitvābhāve'pi sāsnāvadvyaktau saṃsṛjyate, evaṃ viṣayāsaṅgyapi jīvaḥ svabhāvādantaḥkaraṇe saṃsṛjyate|
analyzed: atra uktam vivaraṇe brahma caitanyam sarva upādānatayā sarva tādātmya āpannam sat sva saṃsṛṣṭam sarvam avabhāsayati na jīva caitanyam tasya avidyā upādhi karayā sarvagata tve pi anupādāna tvena asaṅgi tvāt yathā sarva gatam go tva sāmānyam svabhāvāt aśva ādi vyakti saṅgi tva abhāve pi sāsnāvat vyaktau saṃsṛjyate evam viṣaya asaṅgī api jīvaḥ svabhāvāt antaḥkaraṇe saṃsṛjyate

original: tathāca yadā'ntaḥkaraṇasya pariṇāmo vṛttirūpo nayanādidvāreṇa nirgatya viṣayaparyantaṃ cakṣuraśmivat jhaṭiti dīrghaprabhākāreṇa pariṇamya viṣayaṃ vyāpnoti, tadā tamupāruhya taṃ viṣayaṃ gocarayati| kevalāgnyadāhyasyāpi tṛṇaderayaḥpiṇḍasamārūḍhāgnidāhyatvavat kevalajīvacaitanyāprakāśyasyāpi ghaṭāderantaḥkaraṇavṛttyupārūḍhasya tatprakāśyatvaṃ yuktam|
analyzed: tathā ca yadā antaḥkaraṇasya pariṇāmaḥ vṛtti rūpaḥ nayana ādi dvāreṇa nirgatya viṣaya paryantam cakṣu raśmi vat jhaṭiti dīrgha prabhā ākāreṇa pariṇamya viṣayam vyāpnoti tadā tam upāruhya tam viṣayam gocarayati kevala agni adāhyasya api tṛṇa deḥ ayaḥ piṇḍa samārūḍha agni dāhya tva vat kevala jīva caitanya aprakāśyasya api ghaṭa ādeḥ antaḥkaraṇa vṛtti upārūḍhasya tad prakāśya tvam yuktam

original: yadvā'ntaḥkaraṇopādhikatvena jīvaḥ paricchinnaḥ| ataḥ saṃsargābhāvānna ghaṭādikamavabhāsayati| vṛttidvārā tat‌saṃsṛṣṭaviṣayāvacchinnabrahmacatainyābhedābhivyaktau tu taṃ viṣayaṃ prakāśayati|

original: athavā jīvaḥ sarvagato'pyavidyāvṛtatvāt svayamapyaprakāśamānatayā viṣayānanavabhāsayanviṣayaviśeṣe vṛttyuparāgādāvāvaraṇatirodhānena tatraivābhivyaktastameva viṣayaṃ prakāśayati|

original: evaṃ ca ciduparāgārthatvena, viṣayacaitanyābhedābhivyaktyarthatvena, āvaraṇābhibhavārthatvena vā vṛttinirgamamapekṣya tatsaṃsṛṣṭavaliṣayamātrāvabhāsakatvāt jīvasya kiñcijjñatvamapyupapadyate iti||10||
analyzed: evam ca cit uparāga artha tvena viṣaya caitanya abheda abhivyakti artha tvena āvaraṇa abhibhava artha tvena vā vṛtti nirgamam apekṣya tad saṃsṛṣṭa vali ṣaya mātra avabhāsaka tvāt jīvasya kiñcijjñatvam api upapadyate iti

original: atra prathamapakṣe sarvagatasya jīvasya vṛttyadhīnaḥ ko viṣayoparāgaḥ? vṛttyā'pi hi pūrvasiddhayorniṣkriyayorviṣayajīvacaitanyayostādātmyasya saṃyogasya vā na sambhavatyādhānam|
analyzed: atra prathama pakṣe sarva gatasya jīvasya vṛtti adhīnaḥ kaḥ viṣaya uparāgaḥ vṛttyā api hi pūrva siddhayoḥ niṣkriyayoḥ viṣaya jīva caitanyayoḥ tādātmyasya saṃyogasya vā na sambhavati ādhānam

original: anye tu viṣayaviṣayibhāvamātraniyāmikā vṛttiścedanirgatāyā apyaindriyakavṛttestanniyāmakatvaṃ nātiprasaṅgāvahamiti tannirgamābhyupagamavaiyarthyāpatteḥ sa nābhisaṃhitaḥ| kiṃ tu viṣayasannihitajīvacaitanyatādātmyāpannāyā vṛtterviṣayasaṃyoge tasyāpi taddvārakaḥ paramparāsambandho labhyate iti sa eva ciduparāgo'bhisaṃhita ityāhuḥ||
analyzed: anye tu viṣaya viṣayi bhāva mātra niyāmikā vṛttiḥ ced anirgatāyāḥ api aindriyaka vṛtteḥ tad niyāmaka tvam na ati prasaṅga āvaham iti tad nirgama abhyupagama vaiyarthya āpatteḥ sa na abhisaṃhitaḥ kim tu viṣaya sannihita jīva caitanya tādātmya āpannāyāḥ vṛtteḥ viṣaya saṃyoge tasyāḥ api tad dvārakaḥ paramparā sambandhaḥ labhyate iti saḥ eva cit uparāgaḥ abhisaṃhitaḥ iti āhuḥ

original: aparetu sākṣādaparokṣacaitanyasaṃsargiṇa eva sukhāderāparokṣyadarśanāt aparokṣaviṣaye sākṣātsaṃsarga eṣṭavyaḥ| tasmād vṛtterviṣayasaṃyoge vṛttirūpāvacchedakalābhāt tadavacchedena tadupādānasya jīvasyāpi saṃyogajasaṃyogaḥ sambhavati|

original: kāraṇākāraṇasaṃyogāt kāryākāryasaṃyogavat kāryākāryasaṃyogāt kāraṇākāraṇasaṃyogasyāpi yuktitaulyenābhyupagantuṃ yuktatvādityāhuḥ||

original: ekadeśinastu antaḥkaraṇopahitasya viṣayāvabhāsakacaitanyasya viṣayatādātmyāpannabrahmacaitanyābhedābhivyaktidvārā viṣayatādātmyasampādanameva ciduparāgo'bhisaṃhitaḥ|
analyzed: ekadeśinaḥ tu antaḥkaraṇa upahitasya viṣaya avabhāsaka caitanyasya viṣaya tādātmya āpanna brahma caitanya abheda abhivyakti dvārā viṣaya tādātmya sampādanam eva cit uparāgaḥ abhisaṃhitaḥ

analyzed: sarvagata tayā sarva viṣaya sannihitasya api jīvasya tena rūpeṇa viṣaya avabhāsaka tve tasya sādhāraṇa tayā puruṣa viśeṣa aparokṣya vyavasthiti ayogena tasya antaḥkaraṇa upahita tva rūpeṇa eva viṣaya avabhāsaka tvāt evam ca viṣaya āparokṣye ādhyāsika sambandhaḥ niyāmakaḥ iti siddhāntaḥ api saṅgacchate na ca evam dvitīya pakṣa sāṅkaryam

original: atha dvitīyapakṣe keyamabhedābhivyaktiṛḥ?|

original: kecidāhuḥ kulyādvārā taḍāgakedārasalilayoriva viṣayāntaḥkaraṇāvacchinnacaitanyayorvṛttidvārā ekībhāvo'bhedābhivyaktiḥ| evaṃ ca yadyapi viṣayāvacchinnaṃ brahmacaitanyameva viṣayaprakāśakam, tathāpi tasya vṛttidvārā ekībhāvena jīvatvaṃ sampannamiti jīvasya viṣayaprakāśopapattiriti||

original: anye tvāhuḥ vimbasthānīyasya viṣayāvacchinnasya brahmaṇaḥ pratibimbabhūtena jīvena ekībhāvo nābhedābhivyaktiḥ| vyāvartakopādhau darpaṇa iva jāgrati tayorekībhāvāyogāt|

original: vṛttikṛtābhedābhivyaktyā viṣayāvacchinnasya brahmaṇo jīvatvaprāptau brahmaṇastadā tadviṣayasaṃsargābhāvena taddraṣṭṛtvāsambhave sati tasya sarvajñatvābhāvāpatteśca| kiṃ tu viṣayāvacchinnaṃ brahmacaitanyaṃ viṣayasaṃsṛṣṭāyā vṛtteragrabhāge viṣayaprakāśakaṃ pratibimbaṃ samarpayatīti tasya pratibimbasya jīvenaikībhāvaḥ|

original: evaṃ cāntaḥkaraṇatadvṛttiviṣayāvacchinnacaitanyānāṃ pramātṛpramāṇaprameyabhāvena asaṅkaro'pyupapadyate| na ca vṛttyupahitacaitanyasya viṣayapramātve tasya viṣayādhiṣṭhānacaitanyasyeva viṣayeṇādhyāsikasambandhābhāvāt viṣayāparokṣye ādhyāsikasambandhastantraṃ na syāditi vācyam|
analyzed: evam ca antaḥkaraṇa tad vṛtti viṣaya avacchinna caitanyānām pramātṛ pramāṇa prameya bhāvena asaṅkaraḥ upi upapadyate na ca vṛtti upahita caitanyasya viṣaya pramā tve tasya viṣaya adhiṣṭhāna caitanyasya iva viṣayeṇa ādhyāsika sambandha abhāvāt viṣaya āparokṣye ādhyāsika sambandhaḥ tantram na syāt iti vācyam

original: apare tvāhuḥ bimbabhūtaviṣayādhiṣṭhānacaitanyameva sākṣādādhyāsikasambanmadhalābhāt viṣayaprakāśakamiti tasyaiva bimbatadvaviśiṣṭarūpeṇa bhedasadbhāve'pi tadupalakṣitacaitanyātmanā ekībhāvo'bhedābhivyaktiḥ| na caivaṃ sati jīvabrahmasāṅkaryam, na vā brahmaṇaḥ sarvajñatvavirodhaḥ| bimbātmanā tasya yathāpūrvamavasthānāditi||12||

original: atha tṛtīyapakṣe ko nāmāvaraṇābhibavaḥ? ajñānanāśaścet, ghaṭajñānenaivājñānamūlaḥ prapañco nivarteteti cet|
analyzed: atha tṛtīya pakṣe kaḥ nāma āvaraṇa abhibavaḥ ajñāna nāśaḥ ced ghaṭa jñānena eva ajñāna mūlaḥ prapañcaḥ nivarteta iti ced

original: atra kecidāhuḥ caitanyamātrāvārakasyājñānasya viṣayāvacchinnapradeśe spadyotādiprakāśena mahāndhakārasyeva jñānenaikadeśena nāśo vā, kaṭavat saṃveṣṭanaṃ vā bhītabhaṭavadapasaraṇaṃ vā'bhibhava iti||
analyzed: atra kecid āhuḥ caitanya mātra āvārakasya ajñānasya viṣaya avacchinna pradeśe spadyota ādi prakāśena mahā andhakārasya iva jñānena eka deśena nāśaḥ vā kaṭa vat saṃveṣṭanam vā bhīta bhaṭa vat apasaraṇam vā abhibhavaḥ iti

original: anye tu ajñānasyaikadeśena nāśe upādānābhāvāt punastatra kandalanāyogena sakṛdagate samayāntare'pyāvaraṇābhāvaprasaṅgāt, niṣkriyasyāpasaraṇasaṃveṣṭanayorasambhavācca na yathoktarūpo'bhibhavaḥ sambhavati| ataḥ caitanyamātrāvārakasyāpyajñānasya tattadākāravṛttisaṃsṛṣṭāvasthaviṣayāvacchinnacaitanyānāvārakatvasvābhāvyamevābhibhavaḥ|
analyzed: anye tu ajñānasya eka deśena nāśe upādāna abhāvāt punar tatra kandalana ayogena sakṛt agate samaya antare pi āvaraṇa abhāva prasaṅgāt niṣkriyasya apasaraṇa saṃveṣṭanayoḥ asambhavāt ca na yathā ukta rūpaḥ abhibhavaḥ sambhavati atas caitanya mātra āvārakasya api ajñānasya tad tad ākāra vṛtti saṃsṛṣṭa avasthā viṣaya avacchinna caitanya anāvāraka tva svābhāvyam eva abhibhavaḥ

original: na ca viṣayāvaguṇṭhanapaṭavadviṣayacaitanyamāśritya sthitasyājñānasya kathaṃ tadanāvārakatvaṃ yujyate iti śaṅkyam| `ahamajñaḥ' iti pratītyā'hamanubhave prakāśamānacaitanyamāśrayata eva tasya tadanāvārakatvāpratipatterityāhuḥ||
analyzed: na ca viṣaya avaguṇṭhana paṭa vat viṣaya caitanyam āśritya sthitasya ajñānasya katham tad anāvāraka tvam yujyate iti śaṅkyam aham ajñaḥ iti pratītya aham anubhave prakāśamāna caitanyam āśrayate eva tasya tad anāvāraka tva apratipatteḥ iti āhuḥ

original: apare tu `ghaṭaṃ na jānāmi'iti ghaṭajñānavirodhitvena, ghaṭajñāne sati ghaṭājñānaṃ nivṛttamiti tannivartyatvena cānubhūyamānaṃ na mūlājñānam| śuddhacaitanyaviṣayasya tajjñānanivartyasya ca tasya tathātvāyogāt| kintu ghaṭāvacchinnacaitanyaviṣayaṃ mūlājñānasyāvasthābhedarūpamajñānāntaramiti tannāśa evābhibhavaḥ|
analyzed: apare tu ghaṭam na jānāmi iti ghaṭa jñāna virodhi tvena ghaṭa jñāne sati ghaṭa ajñānam nivṛttam iti tad nivartya tvena ca anubhūyamānam na mūla ajñānam śuddha caitanya viṣayasya tad jñāna nivartyasya ca tasya tathātva ayogāt kintu ghaṭa avacchinna caitanya viṣayam mūla ajñānasya avasthā bheda rūpam ajñāna antaram iti tad nāśaḥ eva abhibhavaḥ

original: na caivaṃ jñānodaye'pyāvaraṇasambhavādviṣayānavabhāsaprasaṅgaḥ| avasthārūpāṇyajñānāni hi tattatkālopalakṣitasvarūpāvarakāṇi, jñānāni ca yāvatsvakālopalakṣitaviṣayāvarakājñānanāśakāni| tathā ca kuñcijjñānodayo tatkālīnaviṣayāvarakājñānasya nāśāt vidyamānānāmajñānāntarāṇāmanyakālīnaviṣayāvārakatvācca na tatkālīnaviṣayāvabhāse kācidanupapattiḥ|

original: kecittu prathamajñānanivartyamevājñānaṃ svarūpāvārakam| dvitīyādijñānanivartyāni tu deśakālādiviśeṣaṇāntaraviśiṣṭaviṣayāṇi| ata eva sattāniścayarūpe ajñānanivartake caitradarśane sakṛjjāte `caitraṃ na jānāmi' iti svarūpāvaraṇaṃ nānubhūyate, kiṃ tu `idānīṃ sakutreti na jānāmi' ityādirūpeṇa viśiṣṭāvaraṇameva|
analyzed: kecid tu prathama jñāna nivartyam eva ajñānam svarūpa āvārakam dvitīya ādi jñāna nivartyāni tu deśa kāla ādi viśeṣaṇa antara viśiṣṭa viṣayāṇi atas eva sattā niścaya rūpe ajñāna nivartake caitra darśane sakṛt jāte caitram na jānāmi iti sva rūpa āvaraṇam na anubhūyate kim tu idānīm sa kutra iti na jānāmi ityādi rūpeṇa viśiṣṭa āvaraṇam eva

original: atre kecidāhuḥ svasaṃsṛṣṭena sākṣiṇā sadā bhāsyamāno'haṃkārastattadghaṭādiviṣayavṛttyākārapariṇatasvāvacchinnenāpi sākṣiṇā bhāsyate iti tasyānityatvāt sambhavati saṃskārādhānaṃ ghaṭādau viṣaye iva| na hi svākāravṛttyavacchinnasākṣiṇaiva svagocarasaṃskārādhānamiti niyamo'sti| tathā sati vṛttigocarasaṃskārāsambhavena vṛtterasmaraṇaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: atre kecid āhuḥ sva saṃsṛṣṭena sākṣiṇā sadā bhāsyamāna uhaṃkāraḥ tad tad ghaṭa ādi viṣaya vṛtti ākāra pariṇata sva avacchinnena api sākṣiṇā bhāsyate iti tasya anitya tvāt sambhavati saṃskāra ādhānam ghaṭa ādau viṣaye iva na hi sva ākāra vṛtti avacchinna sākṣiṇā eva sva gocara saṃskāra ādhānam iti niyamaḥ usti tathā sati vṛtti gocara saṃskāra asambhavena vṛtteḥ asmaraṇa prasaṅgāt

original: anavasthā''pattyā vṛttigocaravṛttyantarasyānuvyavasāyanirasanena nirastatvāt| kiṃ tu vadvṛttyavacchinnacaitanyena yat prakāśate, tad‌vṛttyā tad‌gocarasaṃskārādhānamityeva niyamaḥ|
analyzed: anavasthā āpattyā vṛtti gocara vṛtti antarasya anuvyavasāya nirasanena nirasta tvāt kim tu vat vṛtti avacchinna caitanyena yat prakāśate tad vṛttyā tad gocara saṃskāra ādhānam iti eva niyamaḥ

original: evaṃ ca jñānasukhādayo'pyantaḥ karaṇavṛttayaḥ taptāyaḥpiṇḍād vyuccaranto visphuliṅgā iva svāvacchinnena vahnineva svasvāvacchinnenānityena sākṣiṇā bhāsyante iti yuktaṃ teṣvapi saṃskārādhānam| yastu

original: ghaṭaikākāradhīsthā cid ghaṭamevāvabhāsayet||
analyzed: ghaṭa eka ākāra dhī sthā cit ghaṭam eva avabhāsayet

original: ghaṭasya jñātatā brahmacaitanyenāvabhāsate||4||
analyzed: ghaṭasya jñāta tā brahma caitanyena avabhāsate

original: iti kūṭasthadīpokto viṣayaviśaṣaṇasya jñānasya viṣayāvacchinnabrahmacaitanyāvabhāsyatvapakṣaḥ, paśca tattvapradīpikokto jñānecchādīnāmanavacchinnaśuddhacaitanyarūpanityasākṣibhāsyatvapakṣaḥ, tayerapi caitanyasya svasaṃsṛṣṭāparokṣarūpatvād vṛttisaṃsargo'vaśyaṃ vācya iti tatsaṃsṛṣṭānityarūpasadbhāvānna teṣu saṃskārādhāne kācidanupapattiriti||
analyzed: iti kūṭasthadīpa uktaḥ viṣaya viśaṣaṇasya jñānasya viṣaya avacchinna brahma caitanya avabhāsya tva pakṣaḥ tattvapradīpikā uktaḥ jñāna icchā ādīnām anavacchinna śuddha caitanya rūpa nitya sākṣi bhāsya tva pakṣaḥ caitanyasya sva saṃsṛṣṭa aparokṣa rūpatvāt vṛtti saṃsargaḥ uvaśyam vācyaḥ iti tad saṃsṛṣṭa anitya rūpa sadbhāvāt na teṣu saṃskāra ādhāne kācid anupapattiḥ iti

original: anye tu suṣuptāvapyavidyādyanusandhānasiddhaye kalpitāmavidyāvṛttimahamākārāmaṅkīkṛtyāhamarthe saṃskāramupapādayanti|
analyzed: anye tu suṣuptau api avidyā ādi anusandhāna siddhaye kalpitām avidyā vṛttim aham ākārām aṅkīkṛtya ahamarthe saṃskāram upapādayanti

original: na cāsmin pakṣe `etāvantaṃ kālamidamahaṃ paśyannevāsam' iti anyajñānadhārākālīnāhamarthānusandhānānupapattiḥ| avacchedakabhedena sukhaduḥkhayaugapadyavad vṛttidvayayaugapadyasyāpyavirodhenānyajñānadhārākāle'pi ahamākārāvidyāvṛttisantānasambhavāditi||
analyzed: na ca asmin pakṣe etāvantam kālam idam aham paśyan eva āsam iti anya jñāna dhārā kālīna ahamartha anusandhāna anupapattiḥ avacchedaka bhedena sukha duḥkha yaugapadya vat vṛtti dvaya yaugapadyasya api avirodhena anya jñāna dhārā kāle api ahamākāra avidyā vṛtti santāna sambhavāt iti

original: apare tu ahamākārā vṛttirantaḥkaraṇavṛttireva| kintu upāsanādivṛttivanna jñānam, klṛptatatkāraṇājanyatvāt| na hi tatra cakṣurādipratyakṣalakṣaṇaṃ sambhavati, na vā liṅāgadikam| liṅgādipratisandhānaśūnyasyāpyahaṃkārānusandhānadarśanāt| nāpi manaḥ karaṇam| tasyopādānabhūtasya kvacidavapi karaṇatvāklṛpteḥ|
analyzed: apare tu aham ākārā vṛttiḥ antaḥkaraṇa vṛttiḥ eva kintu upāsana ādi vṛtti vat na jñānam klṛpta tad kāraṇa ajanya tvāt na hi tatra cakṣuḥ ādi pratyakṣa lakṣaṇam sambhavati na vā liṅāgadikam liṅga ādi pratisandhāna śūnyasya api ahaṃkāra anusandhāna darśanāt na api manaḥ karaṇam tasya upādāna bhūtasya karaṇa tva aklṛpteḥ

original: tarhi ahamarthapratyabhijñā'pi jñānaṃ na syāditi cet, na| tasyā hamaṃśe jñānatvābhāve'pi tattāṃśe smṛtikaraṇatvena klṛptasaṃskārajanyatayā jñānatvāt| aśaṃbhedena jñāne parokṣatvāparokṣatvavat pramātvāpramātvavacca jñānatvā jñānatvayorapi avirodhādityāhuḥ||
analyzed: tarhi ahamartha pratyabhijñā api jñānam na syāt iti cet na tasyāḥ ham aṃśe jñāna tva abhāve pi tattā aṃśe smṛti karaṇa tvena klṛpta saṃskāra janya tayā jñāna tvāt aśam bhedena jñāne parokṣa tva aparokṣa tva vat pramā tva apramā tva vat ca jñāna tva jñāna tvayoḥ api avirodhāt iti āhuḥ

original: itare tu ahamākrārā'pi vṛttirjñānameva| `māmahaṃ jānāmi' ityanubhavāt| naca karaṇāsambhavaḥ| anubhavānusāreṇa manasa evāntarindriyasya karaṇatvasyāpi kalpanādityāhuḥ||17||
analyzed: itare tu aham ākrārā api vṛttiḥ jñānam eva mām aham jānāmi iti anubhavāt na ca karaṇa asambhavaḥ anubhava anusāreṇa manasaḥ eva antar indriyasya karaṇa tvasya api kalpanāt iti āhuḥ

original: evaṃ sati bāhyaviṣayāparokṣavṛttīnāmevāvaraṇābhibhāvakatvaniyamaḥ paryavasannaḥ|
analyzed: evam sati bāhya viṣaya aparokṣa vṛttīnām eva āvaraṇa abhibhāvaka tva niyamaḥ paryavasannaḥ

original: nanu nāyamapi niyamaḥ, śuktirajanasthale idamākāravṛtterajñānānabhibhāvakatvāt| anyathopādānābhāvena rajatotpattyayogāditi ceta,
analyzed: nanu nā ayam api niyamaḥ śukti rajana sthale idam ākāra vṛtteḥ ajñāna anabhibhāvaka tvāt anyathā upādāna abhāvena rajata utpatti ayogāt iti ceta

original: atrāhuḥ idamākāravṛttyā idamaṃśājñānanivṛttāvapi śuktitvādiviśeṣāśājñānanivṛtteḥ tadeva rajatopādānam, śuktitvādyajñāne rajatādhyāsasya tadbhāne tadabhāvasyānubhūyamānatvāt| adhyāsabhāṣyaṭīkāvivaraṇe anubhūyamānānvayavyatirekasyaivājñānasya rajatādyadhyāsopādānatvokteḥ|
analyzed: atra āhuḥ idam ākāra vṛttyā idam aṃśa ajñāna nivṛttau api śukti tva ādi viśeṣa āśā jñāna nivṛtteḥ tat eva rajata upādānam śukti tva ādi ajñāne rajata adhyāsasya tad bhāne tad abhāvasya anubhūyamāna tvāt adhyāsa bhāṣya ṭīkā vivaraṇe anubhūyamāna anvaya vyatirekasya eva ajñānasya rajata ādi adhyāsa upādāna tva ukteḥ

original: ata eva śuktyaṃśo'dhiṣṭhānam, idamaṃśa ādhāraḥ| savilāsājñānaviṣayo'dhiṣṭhānam, atadrūpo'pi tadrūpeṇāropyabuddhau sphurannādhāra iti saṃkṣepaśārīrake'pi vivecanāditi||
analyzed: atas eva śukti aṃśa udhiṣṭhānam idam aṃśaḥ ādhāraḥ savilāsa ajñāna viṣayaḥ adhiṣṭhānam atadrūpaḥ api tad rūpeṇa āropya buddhau sphuran ādhāraḥ iti saṃkṣepaśārīrake api vivecanāt iti

original: apare tu `idaṃ rajatam' iti idamaṃśasambhinnetvena pratīyamānasya rajatasya idamaṃśājñānamevopādānam| tasya cedamākāravṛttyā āvaraṇaśaktimātranivṛttāvapi vikṣepaśaktyā maha tadanuvṛtteḥ nopādānatvāsambhavaḥ|
analyzed: apare tu idam rajatam iti idam aṃśa sambhinna tvena pratīyamānasya rajatasya idam aṃśa ajñānam eva upādānam tasya ca idam ākāra vṛttyā āvaraṇa śakti mātra nivṛttau api vikṣepa śaktyā maha tad anuvṛtteḥ na upādāna tva asambhavaḥ

original: jalapratibimbitavṛkṣādho'gratvādhyāse jīvanmuktyanuvṛtte prapañcādhyāse ca sarvātmanā adhiṣṭhānasākṣātkārānantarabhāvinyāmāvaraṇanivṛttāvapi vikṣepaśaktikahitājñānamātrasyopādānatvasampratipatterityāhuḥ||
analyzed: jala pratibimbita vṛkṣa adhas ugra tva adhyāse jīvanmukti anuvṛtte prapañca adhyāse ca sarvātmanā adhiṣṭhāna sākṣātkāra anantara bhāvinyām āvaraṇa nivṛttau api vikṣepa śaktika hita ajñāna mātrasya upādāna tva sampratipatteḥ iti āhuḥ

original: kavitārkikacakravartinṛsiṃhabhaṭṭopādhyāyāstu `idaṃ rajatam' iti bhramarūpavṛttivyatirekeṇa rajatotpatteḥ prāgidamākārā vṛttireva nāstīti tasyā ajñānanivartakatvasadasakadbhāvavicāraṃ nirālambanaṃ manyante|
analyzed: kavi tārkika cakravarti nṛsiṃha bhaṭṭa upādhyāyāḥ tu idam rajatam iti bhrama rūpa vṛtti vyatirekeṇa rajata utpatteḥ prāk idam ākārā vṛttiḥ eva na asti iti tasyāḥ ajñāna nivartaka tva sadasat kadbhāva vicāram nirālambanam manyante

original: tathāhi na tāvat bhramarūpavṛttivyatirekeṇa idamākārā vṛttiranubhavasiddhā| nāpyadhiṣṭhānasāmānyajñānamadhyāsakāraṇamiti kāryaklpyā| tasyāstatkāraṇatve mānābhāvāt| na cādhiṣṭhānasamprayogābhāve rajatādyanutpāttistatra mānam| tato duṣṭendriyasamprayogasyaivādhyāsakāraṇatvaprapteḥ|
analyzed: tathā hi na tāvat bhrama rūpa vṛtti vyatirekeṇa idam ākārā vṛttiḥ anubhava siddhā na api adhiṣṭhāna sāmānya jñānam adhyāsa kāraṇam iti kārya klpyā tasyāḥ tad kāraṇa tve māna abhāvāt na ca adhiṣṭhāna samprayoga abhāve rajata ādi anutpāttiḥ tatra mānam tatas duṣṭa indriya samprayogasya eva adhyāsa kāraṇa tva prapteḥ

original: na ca samprayogo na sarvatra bhramavyāpī, adhiṣṭhānasphuraṇaṃ tu svataḥprakāśamāne pratyagātmani mahaṅkārādhyāsamapi vyāpnotīti vācyam| tasyāpi ghaṭādyadhyāsāvyāpitvāt| ghaṭādipratyakṣāt prāk tadadhiṣṭhānabhūtanīrūpabrahmātragocaracākṣuṣavṛtterasambhavāt| svarūpaprakāśasyāvṛtatvāt|
analyzed: na ca samprayogaḥ na sarvatra bhrama vyāpī adhiṣṭhāna sphuraṇam tu svatas prakāśamāne pratyagātmani vyāpnoti iti vācyam tasya api ghaṭa ādi adhyāsa avyāpi tvāt ghaṭa ādi pratyakṣāt prāk tad adhiṣṭhāna bhūta nīrūpa brahma atra gocara cākṣuṣa vṛtteḥ asambhavāt svarūpa prakāśasya āvṛta tvāt

original: āvṛtānāvṛtasādhāraṇyenādhiṣṭhānaprakāśamātrasyādhyāsākāraṇatve śuktīdamaṃśasamprayogāt prāgapi tadavacchinnacaitanyarūpaprakāśasyāvṛtasya sadbhāvena tadā'pyadhyāsāpatteḥ| na cādhyāsasāmānye adhiṣṭhānaprakāśasāmānyaṃ hetuḥ, prātibhāsikādhyāse'bhivyaktādhiṣṭhānaprakāśa iti nātiprasaṅgaḥ,sāmānye sāmānyasya viśeṣe viśeṣasya hetutvaucityāditi vācyam|
analyzed: āvṛta anāvṛta sādhāraṇyena adhiṣṭhāna prakāśa mātrasya adhyāsa akāraṇa tve śukti idam aṃśa samprayogāt prāk api tad avacchinna caitanya rūpa prakāśasya āvṛtasya sadbhāvena tadā api adhyāsa āpatteḥ na ca adhyāsa sāmānye adhiṣṭhāna prakāśa sāmānyam hetuḥ prātibhāsika adhyāsa abhivyakta adhiṣṭhāna prakāśaḥ iti na atiprasaṅgaḥ sāmānye sāmānyasya viśeṣe viśeṣasya hetu tva aucityāt iti vācyam

original: evamapi prātibhāsikaśaṅkhapītimakūpajalanailyādyadhyāsāvyāpanāt| rūpānupahita cākṣuṣapratyayāyogena tadānīṃ śaṅkhādigataśauklyopalambhābhāvena cādhyāsātprāk śaṅkhādinīrūpādhiṣṭhānagocaravṛttyasambhavāt|
analyzed: evam api prātibhāsika śaṅkha pītimakūpa jala nailya ādi adhyāsa vyāpanāt rūpa anupahita cākṣuṣa pratyaya ayogena tadānīm śaṅkha ādi gata śauklya upalambha abhāvena ca adhyāsāt prāk śaṅkhādinī rūpa adhiṣṭhāna gocara vṛtti asambhavāt

original: na ca prātibhāsikeṣvapi rajatādyadhyāsamātre nirukto viśeṣaheturāstāmiti vācyam| tathā sati samprayogāt prāk pītaśaṅkhādyadhyāsāprasaṅgāya tadadhyāse duṣṭendriyasamprayogaḥ kāraṇamityavaśyaṃ vaktavyatayā tasyaiva sāmānyataḥ prātibhāsikādhyāsamātre lāghavāt kāraṇatvasiddhau, tata eva rajatādhyāsakādācitkatvasyāpi nirvāhādadhiṣṭhānaprakāśasya
analyzed: na ca prātibhāsikeṣu api rajata ādi adhyāsa mātre niruktaḥ viśeṣa hetuḥ āstām iti vācyam tathā sati samprayogāt prāk pīta śaṅkha ādi adhyāsa aprasaṅgāya tad adhyāse duṣṭa indriya samprayogaḥ kāraṇam iti avaśyam vaktavya tayā tasya eva sāmānyatas prātibhāsika adhyāsa mātre lāghavāt kāraṇa tva siddhau tatas eva rajata adhyāsa kādācitkatvasya api nirvāhāt adhiṣṭhāna prakāśasya

original: sāmānyato viśeṣato vā'dhyāsakāraṇatvasyāsiddheḥ|
analyzed: sāmānyatas viśeṣataḥ vā adhyāsa kāraṇatvasya asiddheḥ

original: nanu sādṛśyanirapekṣe adhyāsāntare akāraṇatve'pi tatsāpekṣe rajatādyadhyāse rajatādisādṛśyabhūtarūpaviśeṣādiviśeṣṭadharmijñānarūpamadhiṣṭānasāmānyajñānaṃ kāraṇamavaśyaṃ vācyam| duṣṭendriyasamprayogamātrasya kāraṇatve śuktivadiṅgāle'pi tadjatādhyāsaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: nanu sādṛśya nirapekṣe adhyāsa antare akāraṇa tve api tad sāpekṣe rajata ādi adhyāse rajata ādi sādṛśya bhūta rūpa viśeṣa ādi viśeṣṭa dharmi jñāna rūpam adhiṣṭāna sāmānya jñānam kāraṇam avaśyam vācyam duṣṭa indriya samprayoga mātrasya kāraṇa tve śukti vat iṅgāla ipi tadjata adhyāsa prasaṅgāt

original: na ca sādṛśyamapi viṣayadoṣatvena kālaṇamiti vācyam| visadṛśe'pi sādṛśyabhrame satyadhyāsasadbhāvāt jaladhisalilapūre dūre nīlaśilātalatvāropadarśanāt| na ca `taddhetoreva' iti nyāyāt sādṛśyajñānasāmagnyevādhyāsakāraṇamastviti yuktam| jñānasāmagpyā ārthakāraṇatvasya kvacidapyadṛṣṭeḥ| tatassādṛśyajñānatvasyaiva laghutvācca|
analyzed: na ca sādṛśyam api viṣaya doṣa tvena kālaṇam iti vācyam visadṛśe api sādṛśya bhrame sati adhyāsa sadbhāvāt jaladhi salila pūre dūre nīla śilā tala tva āropa darśanāt na ca tad hetoḥ eva iti nyāyāt sādṛśya jñāna sāmagnī eva adhyāsa kāraṇam astu iti yuktam jñāna sāmagpyāḥ ārtha kāraṇa tvasya kvacid api adṛṣṭeḥ tatas sādṛśya jñāna tvasya eva laghu tvāt ca

original: na ca svataśśubhre'pi śubhrakaladhautabhṛṅgāragate'pi svacche jale eva nailyādhyāsaḥ, na muktāphale iti vyavasthāvat vastusvabhāvādeva śuktau rajatādhyāsaḥ neṅgālādāviti vyavasthā, na tu sādṛśyajñānāpekṣaṇāditi vācyam|
analyzed: na ca svatas śubhre api śubhra kaladhauta bhṛṅgāra gate api svacche jale eva nailya adhyāsaḥ na muktāphale iti vyavasthā vat vastu svabhāvāt eva śuktau rajata adhyāsaḥ na iṅgāla ādau iti vyavasthā na tu sādṛśya jñāna apekṣaṇāt iti vācyam

original: svataḥ paṭakhaṇḍe puṇḍarīkamukulatvānadhyāse'pi tatraiva kartanādighaṭitatadākāre tadadhyāsadarśanena tadadhyāsasya vastusvabhāvamanunurudhya sādṛśyajñānabhāvābhāvānurodhitvaniścayāt| anyathā'nyadā'pi tatra tadadhyāsaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: svatas paṭa khaṇḍe puṇḍarīka mukula tva anadhyāsaḥ api tatra eva kartana ādi ghaṭita tad ākāre tad adhyāsa darśanena tad adhyāsasya vastu svabhāvam anunurudhya sādṛśya jñāna bhāva abhāva anurodhi tva niścayāt anyathā anyadā api tatra tad adhyāsa prasaṅgāt

original: na cātrāpi `dravyapratyakṣe dravyasaṃyogaḥ kāraṇam' iti sāmānyaniyamamātropagame anyasaṃyogādanyadravyapratyakṣāpattiriti atiprasaṅgo'stīti vācyam| `tattad‌dravyapratyakṣe tattadadravyasaṃyogaḥ kāraṇam' iti niyamābhyupagamāt| anyathā tṛtīyaniyame'peyatiprasaṅgasya durvāratvāt| tasmānnāsti klṛptacaniyamabhaṅgaprasaṅgaḥ|
analyzed: na ca atra api dravya pratyakṣe dravya saṃyogaḥ kāraṇam iti sāmānya niyama mātra upagame anya saṃyogāt anya dravya pratyakṣa āpattiḥ iti atiprasaṅgaḥ usti iti vācyam tad tad dravya pratyakṣe tad tad adravya saṃyogaḥ kāraṇam iti niyama abhyupagamāt anyathā durvāra tvāt tasmāt nā asti klṛpta ca niyama bhaṅga prasaṅgaḥ

original: kiṃ cātra klṛptaniyamabhaṅge'pi na doṣaḥ `idaṃ rajataṃ paśyāmi, nīlaṃ jalaṃ paśyāmi' ityāderananyathāsiddhasyānu bhavasya prathamagṛhītānāmapi `pratyakṣamātre viṣayasannikarṣaḥ kāraṇam' ityādiniyamānāṃ vyāvahārikaviṣaye saṅkocakalpanamantareṇopapādanāsambhavāt|
analyzed: kim ca atra klṛpta niyama bhaṅge api na doṣaḥ idam rajatam paśyāmi nīlam jalam paśyāmi ityādeḥ ananyathāsiddhasya anu bhavasya prathama gṛhītānām api pratyakṣa mātre viṣaya sannikarṣaḥ kāraṇam ityādi niyamānām vyāvahārika viṣaye saṅkoca kalpanam antareṇa upapādana asambhavāt

original: na caivaṃsati `pramāyāṃ sannikarṣaḥ kāraṇaṃ, na bramaḥ' ityapi saṅkocakalpanāsambhavād asannikṛṣṭasyaiva deśāntarasthasya rajatasya ihāropāpattiriti anyathākhyātivādaprasārikā| abhivyaktacaitanyāvaguṇṭhanaśūnyasya deśāntarasthasya rajarasyāparokṣyanupapatteḥ| khyātibādhānupapattyādibhirbhramaviṣayasyānirvacanīyatvasiddheśca|
analyzed: na ca evam sati pramāyām sannikarṣaḥ kāraṇam na bramaḥ iti api saṅkoca kalpanā sambhavāt asannikṛṣṭasya eva deśa antara sthasya rajatasya iha āropa āpattiḥ iti anyathā khyāti vāda prasārikā abhivyakta caitanya avaguṇṭhana śūnyasya deśa antara sthasya rajarasya aparokṣī anupapatteḥ khyāti bādhā anupapatti ādibhiḥ bhrama viṣayasya anirvacanīya tva siddheḥ ca

original: na cādhiṣṭhānasamprayogamātrat prātibhāsikasyaindriyakatvopagame śuktirajatādhyāsasamaye tatraiva kālāntare adhyasanīyasya raṅgasyāpi cākṣuṣatvaṃ kṛto na syāditi vācyam| rajatādhyāsasamaye raṅgarajatasādhāraṇacākacakyadarśanāviśeṣe'pi yato rāgādirūpapuruṣadoṣābhāvāditastatra tadā na raṅgādhyāsaḥ, tata eva mayā tadviṣayavṛttyanudayasyābhyupagamāt|
analyzed: na ca adhiṣṭhāna samprayoga mātrat prātibhāsikasya aindriyaka tva upagame śukti rajata adhyāsa samaye tatra eva kāla antare adhyasanīyasya raṅgasya api cākṣuṣa tvam kṛtaḥ na syāt iti vācyam rajata adhyāsa samaye raṅga rajata sādhāraṇa cākacakya darśana aviśeṣa api yatas rāga ādi rūpa puruṣa doṣa abhāvāt itas tatra tadā na raṅga adhyāsaḥ tatas eva mayā tad viṣaya vṛtti anudayasya abhyupagamāt

original: tasmādidamaṃśasaṃbhinnarajatagocaraikaiva vṛttirindriyajanyā| na tataḥ prāgidamākārā vṛttiriti nātraiveyamajñānanivartakatvasadasadbhāvacintā kāryeti|
analyzed: tasmāt idam aṃśa saṃbhinna rajata gocarā ekā eva vṛttiḥ indriya janyā na tatas prāk idam ākārā vṛttiḥ iti na atra eva iyam ajñāna nivartaka tva sat asadbhāva cintā kāryā iti

original: anye tu `adhiṣṭhānajñānamadhyāsakāraṇam' iti idamākārāṃ vṛttimupetya tadabhivyaktenaiva sākṣiṇā tadadhyastasya rajatasyāvabhāsasanbhavāt tadbhāsakasākṣyabhivyañjikayā tayaivedaṃvṛttyā rajataviṣayasaṃskārādhānopapatteśca rajatākāravṛttirvyartheti manyante||
analyzed: anye tu adhiṣṭhāna jñānam adhyāsa kāraṇam iti idam ākārām vṛttim upetya tad abhivyaktena eva sākṣiṇā tad adhyastasya rajatasya avabhāsa sanbhavāt tad bhāsaka sākṣi abhivyañjikayā tayā eva idam vṛttyā rajata viṣaya saṃskāra ādhāna upapatteḥ ca rajata ākāra vṛttiḥ vyarthā iti manyante

original: jñānadvayapakṣe `idam' ityekā vṛttiradhyāsakāraṇabhūtā| `idaṃ rajatam' iti dvitīyā vṛttiradhyastarajataviṣayā, na tvidamaṃśaṃ vinā'dhyastamātragocarā sā| `idaṃ rajataṃ jānāmi' iti tasyā idamarthatādātmyāpannarajataviṣayatvānubhavāditi kecit|
analyzed: jñāna dvaya pakṣe idam iti ekā vṛttiḥ adhyāsa kāraṇa bhūtā idam rajatam iti dvitīyā vṛttiḥ adhyasta rajata viṣayā na tu idam aṃśam vinā adhyasta mātra gocarā sā idam rajatam jānāmi iti tasyāḥ idam artha tādātmya āpanna rajata viṣaya tva anubhavāt iti kecid

original: anye tu yathā idamaṃśāvacchinnacaitanyasthā'vidyā rajatākāreṇa vivartate evamidamaṃśaviṣayavṛttijñānāvacchinnacaitanyasthā'vidyā rajatajñānabhāsākāreṇa vivartate, na tvidamaṃśavṛttivadanadhyastaṃ rajatajñānamasti|
analyzed: anye tu yathā idam aṃśa avacchinna caitanya sthā avidyā rajata ākāreṇa vivartate evam idam aṃśa viṣaya vṛtti jñāna avacchinna caitanya sthā avidyā rajata jñāna bhāsa ākāreṇa vivartate na tu idam aṃśa vṛtti vat anadhyastam rajata jñānam asti

original: tathā ca rajatasya adhiṣṭhānagatedaṃtvasaṃsargabhānavattjajñānasyāpyadhiṣṭhānagatedaṃtvaviṣayatvasaṃsargabhānopapatteḥ na tasyāpīdaṃviṣayatvamabhyupagantavyam|
analyzed: tathā ca rajatasya adhiṣṭhāna gata idaṃtva saṃsarga bhānavat tja jñānasya api adhiṣṭhāna gata idaṃtva viṣayatva saṃsarga bhāna upapatteḥ na tasya api idam viṣaya tvam abhyupagantavyam

original: na ca rajatatvavadadhyastasya rajatedaṃtvasaṃsargasya rajatajñānagocaratvāt tatpratiyogina idaṃtvasyāpi tadviṣayatvaṃ vaktavyamiti vācyam| svatādātmyāśrayasya idaṃtvaviṣayatvādeva tasya tatsaṃsargaviṣayatve atiprasaṅgābhāvāt|
analyzed: na ca rajata tva vat adhyastasya rajata idaṃtva saṃsargasya rajata jñāna gocara tvāt tad pratiyoginaḥ idaṃtvasya api tad viṣayatvam vaktavyam iti vācyam sva tādātmya āśrayasya idaṃtva viṣaya tvāt eva tasya tad saṃsarga viṣayatve atiprasaṅga abhāvāt

original: na cādhiṣṭhānādhyāsayorekasmin jñiāne prakāśaniyamasya sambhāvanābhāṣyavivaraṇe pratipādanād ekavṛttiviṣayatvaṃ vaktavyamiti vācyam| vṛttibhede'pīdamākāravṛttyabhivyakte ekasmin sākṣiṇi tayoḥ prakāśopagamādityāhuḥ||18||
analyzed: na ca adhiṣṭhāna adhyāsayoḥ ekasmin jñiāne prakāśa niyamasya sambhāvanā bhāṣya vivaraṇe pratipādanāt eka vṛtti viṣaya tvam vaktavyam iti vācyam vṛtti bhede pi idam ākāra vṛtti abhivyakte ekasmin sākṣiṇi tayoḥ prakāśa upagamāt iti āhuḥ

original: nanu sarvapadārthānāṃ sākṣiprasādādeva prakāśopapatteḥ kiṃ vṛttyā, ghaṭādiviṣayakasaṃskārādhānādyupapattaye tadapekṣaṇe'pi tannirgamābhyupagamo vyarthaḥ| parokṣasthala ivānirgatavṛttyavacchinnasākṣiṇaiva ghaṭāderapi prakāśopapatteḥ|
analyzed: nanu sarva padārthānām sākṣi prasādāt eva prakāśa upapatteḥ kim vṛttyā ghaṭa ādi viṣayaka saṃskāra ādhāna ādi upapattaye tad apekṣaṇe api tad nirgama abhyupagamaḥ vyarthaḥ parokṣa sthale iva anirgata vṛtti avacchinna sākṣiṇā eva ghaṭa ādeḥ api prakāśa upapatteḥ

original: na ca tathā sati parokṣāparokṣavailakṣaṇyānupapattiḥ| śābdānumityoriva karaṇaviśeṣaprayuktavṛttivaijātyādeva tadupapatteḥ||
analyzed: na ca tathā sati parokṣa aparokṣa vailakṣaṇya anupapattiḥ śābda anumityoḥ iva karaṇa viśeṣa prayukta vṛtti vaijātyāt eva tad upapatteḥ

original: atra kecidāhuḥ pratyakṣasthale viṣayādhiṣṭhānatayā tadavacchinnameva caitanyaṃ viṣayaprakāśaḥ| sākṣāttādātmyarūpasambandhasambhave svarūpasambandhasya vā'nyasya vā kalpanā'yogāditi tadabhivyakatyarthaṃ yukto vṛttinirgamābhyupagamaḥ|
analyzed: atra kecid āhuḥ pratyakṣa sthale viṣaya adhiṣṭhāna tayā tad avacchinnam eva caitanyam viṣaya prakāśaḥ sākṣāt tādātmya rūpa sambandha sambhave svarūpa sambandhasya vā anyasya vā kalpanā yogāt iti tad abhivyakati artham yuktaḥ vṛtti nirgama abhyupagamaḥ

original: parokṣasthale vyavahite vahnyādau vṛttisaṃsargāyogādindriyavadanvayavyatirekaśālino vṛttinirgamadvārasyānupalambhāccānirgatavṛttyavacchinnacaitanyameva svarūpasambandhena viṣayagocaramagatyā'rthādabhyupagamyate iti||
analyzed: parokṣa sthale vyavahite vahni ādau vṛtti saṃsarga ayogāt indriya vat anvaya vyatireka śālinaḥ vṛtti nirgama dvārasya anupalambhāt ca anirgata vṛtti avacchinna caitanyam eva svarūpa sambandhena viṣaya gocaram agatyā arthāt abhyupagamyate iti

original: itare tu śabdānumānāvagatebhyaḥ pratyakṣāvagate spaṣṭatā tāvadanubhūyate| na hi rasālaparimalādiviśeṣe śatavāramāptopadiṣṭe'pi pratyakṣāvagata iva spaṣṭatā'sti| tadanantaramapi `kathaṃ tad?'iti jijñāsā'nuvṛtteḥ|
analyzed: itare tu śabda anumāna avagatebhyaḥ pratyakṣa avagate spaṣṭa tā tāvat anubhūyate na hi rasāla parimala ādi viśeṣe śata vāram āpta upadiṣṭe api pratyakṣa avagate iva spaṣṭa tā asti tad anantaram api katham tat iti jijñāsā anuvṛtteḥ

original: na ca śabdānmādhuryamātrāvagame'pi rasālamādhuryādivṛttyavāntarajātiviśeṣavāciśapabdābhāvāt, tatsattve'pi śrotrāttasyāgṛhītasaṅgatikatvāt śabdādasādhāraṇajātiviśeṣāvacchinnamādhuryāvagamo nāstīti jijñāsā'nuvṛttiryukteti śaṅkyam| `rasāle sarvātiśāyī mārdhuyāviśeṣo'sti'ityasmācchabdāttadgatāvāntarajātiviśeṣasyāpyavagamāt|
analyzed: na ca śabdāt mādhurya mātra avagame pi rasāla mādhurya ādi vṛtti avāntara jāti viśeṣa vāci śa pabda abhāvāt tad sattve pi śrotrāt tasya agṛhīta saṅgatika tvāt śabdāt asādhāraṇa jāti viśeṣa avacchinna mādhurya avagamaḥ na asti iti jijñāsā anuvṛttiḥ yuktā iti śaṅkyam rasāle sarva atiśāyī mārdhuyā viśeṣaḥ usti iti asmāt śabdāt tad gata avāntara jāti viśeṣasya api avagamāt

original: na hyayaṃ viśeṣaśabdastadgataviśeṣaṃ vihāyānyagataṃ viśeṣaṃ tatra bodhayati| aprāmāṇyāpatteḥ| na ca tad‌gatameva viśeṣaṃ viśeṣatvena sāmānyena rūpeṇa bodhayati, na viśiṣyeti jijñāseti vācyam| pratyakṣeṇāpi madhurarasaviśeṣaṇasya jītiviśeṣasya svarūpata eva viṣayīkaraṇena jītiviśeṣagataviśeṣāntarāviṣayīkaraṇād jijñāsā'nuvṛttiprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: na hi ayam viśeṣa śabdaḥ tad gata viśeṣam vihāya anya gatam viśeṣam tatra bodhayati aprāmāṇya āpatteḥ na ca tad gatam eva viśeṣam viśeṣa tvena sāmānyena rūpeṇa bodhayati na viśiṣya iti jijñāsā iti vācyam pratyakṣeṇa api madhura rasa viśeṣaṇasya jīti viśeṣasya svarūpataḥ eva viṣayīkaraṇena jīti viśeṣa gata viśeṣa antara a viṣayīkaraṇāt jijñāsā anuvṛtti prasaṅgāt

original: tasmāt pratyakṣagrāhye'bhivyaktāparokṣyaikarasacaitanyāvaguṇṭhanātspaṣṭatā jijñāsānivartanakṣamā, śabdādigamye tu tadabhāvādaspaṣṭateti vyavasthā'bhyupagantavyā| ata eva sākṣivedyasya sukhādeḥ spaṣṭatā| śābdavṛttivedyasyāpi brahmaṇo mananādeḥ prāgajñānānivṛttāvaspaṣṭatā, tadanantaraṃ tannivṛttau spaṣṭateti vṛttinirgamamupapādayanti||
analyzed: tasmāt pratyakṣa grāhya abhivyakta aparokṣya eka rasa caitanya avaguṇṭhanāt spaṣṭa tā jijñāsā nivartana kṣamā śabda ādi gamye tu tad abhāvāt aspaṣṭa tā iti vyavasthā abhyupagantavyā atas eva sākṣi vedyasya sukha ādeḥ spaṣṭa tā śābda vṛtti vedyasya api brahmaṇaḥ manana ādeḥ prāk ajñāna anivṛttau aspaṣṭa tā tad anantaram tad nivṛttau spaṣṭa tā iti vṛtti nirgamam upapādayanti

original: nanvetāvatā'pi viṣayāvarakājñānanivṛttyarthaṃ vṛttinirgama ityuktam| tadayuktam| viṣayāvacchinnacaitanyagatasya tadāvarakājñānasyānirgatavṛttyā nivṛttyabhyupagame'pyanatiprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: nanu etāvatā api viṣaya āvaraka ajñāna nivṛtti artham vṛtti nirgamaḥ iti uktam tat ayuktam viṣaya avacchinna caitanya gatasya tad āvaraka ajñānasya anirgata vṛttyā nivṛtti abhyupagame pi anatiprasaṅgāt

original: naca tathā sati devadattīyaghaṭajñānena yajñadattīyaghaṭājñānasyāpi nivṛttiprasaṅgaḥ, samānaviṣayakatvasya sattvāt|ahamarthaviṣayacaitanyaniṣṭhayerjñānājñānayorbhinnāśrayatvena tayorvirodhe samānāśrayatvasyātantratvāditi vācyam|
analyzed: naca tathā sati devadattīya ghaṭa jñānena yajñadattīya ghaṭa ajñānasya api nivṛtti prasaṅgaḥ samāna viṣayaka tvasya sattvāt ahamartha viṣaya caitanya jñānayoḥ bhinna āśraya tvena tayoḥ virodhe samāna āśraya tvasya atantra tvāt iti vācyam

original: samānāśrayaviṣayatvaṃ jñānājñānayorvirodhaprayojakamaṅgīkṛtya vṛttinirgamanābhyupagame'pi devadattīyaghaṭavṛtteḥ yajñadattīyaghaṭājñānasya ca ghaṭāvacchinnacaitanyaikāśrayatvaprāptyātiprasaṅgatādavasthyena `yadajñānaṃ yaṃ puruṣaṃ pratipadviṣayāvarakaṃ, tat tadīyatadviṣayabhānanivartyam' iti pṛthageva virodhaprayojakasya vaktavyatayā
analyzed: samāna āśraya viṣaya tvam jñāna ajñānayoḥ virodha prayojakam aṅgīkṛtya vṛtti nirgamana abhyupagame api devadattīya ghaṭa vṛtteḥ yajñadattīya ghaṭa ajñānasya ca ghaṭa avacchinna caitanya eka āśraya tva prāptyā atiprasaṅga tādavasthyena yat ajñānam yam puruṣam pratipad viṣaya āvarakam tat tadīya tad viṣaya bhāna nivartyam iti pṛthak eva virodha prayojakasya vaktavyatayā

original: samānāśrayatvasyānapekṣaṇāt||
analyzed: samāna āśraya tvasya anapekṣaṇāt

original: atrāhuḥ vṛttinirgamanānabhyupagame jñānājñānayorvirodhaprayojakameva durnirūpam| `yadajñānaṃ yaṃ puruṣaṃ prati'ityādyuktamiti cet,na| parokṣajñānenāpi viṣayagatājñānanivṛttiprasaṅgāt| aparokṣatvamapi nivartakajñānaviśeṣaṇamiti cet,| kiṃ tadaparokṣatvam?| na tāvajjātiḥ|
analyzed: atra āhuḥ vṛtti nirgamana anabhyupagame jñāna ajñānayoḥ virodha prayojakam eva durnirūpam yat ajñānam yam puruṣam prati ityādi uktam iti ced na parokṣa jñānena api viṣaya gata ajñāna nivṛtti prasaṅgāt aparokṣa tvam api nivartaka jñāna viśeṣaṇam iti ced kim tat aparokṣa tvam na tāvat jātiḥ

original: `daṇḍyayamāsīt' iti saṃskāropanītadaṇḍaviśiṣṭapuruṣaviṣayakasya cākṣuṣajñānasya daṇḍāṃśe'pi tatsattve tatrāpi viṣayagatājñānanivṛttyāpātāt| `daṇḍaṃ sākṣātkaromi' iti tadaṃśe'pyāparokṣyānubhavāpatteśca|
analyzed: daṇḍī ayam āsīt iti saṃskāra upanīta daṇḍa viśiṣṭa puruṣa viṣayakasya cākṣuṣa jñānasya daṇḍa aṃśe pi tad sattve tatra api viṣaya gata ajñāna nivṛtti āpātāt daṇḍam sākṣātkaromi iti tad aṃśe pya aparokṣya anubhava āpatteḥ ca

original: ananubhave'pi saṃskāraṃ sannikarṣaṃ parikalpya indriyasannikarṣajanyatayā tatra kālpanikāparokṣyābhyupagame anumityādāvapi liṅgajñānādikaṃ sannikarṣaṃ parikalpya tadaṅgīkārāpatteḥ| daṇḍāṃśe āparokṣyāsattve tu tasya jātitvāyogād| jātervyāpyavṛttitvani yamāt| tadaniyame'pyavacchedakopādhibhedānirūpaṇena tasyāvyāpyavṛttijātitvāyogācca|

original: atastatrāgameva śikṣyata iti cet, tarhi ihāpi brahmapahrapañcayorupādānopādeyabhāvena parasparasaṃsṛṣṭatayā'nyadharmasyānyatrāvabhāsaḥ sambhāvyate iti śaṅkitadoṣaṃ pratyakṣam

analyzed: nanu āgamasya pratyakṣāt balīyaḥ tve yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ iti atra pratyakṣa avirodhāya yajamāna śabdasya prastare gauṇī vṛttiḥ na kalpanīyā tathā somena iti atra traiyadhikaraṇyena anvaye yāge iṣṭa sādhanatvam somalatāyām yāga sādhanatvam ca bodhanīyam iti vyāpāra bhedena vākya bheda āpatteḥ
