original: kathaṃ tarhi śruteḥ prabalyam?| ucyate nirdoṣatvāt paratvācca| śrutimātrasya pratyakṣāt prābalyamityutsargaḥ| kiṃ tu śrutabādhitamapi pratyakṣaṃ kathaṃcit svocitaviṣayopahāreṇa sambhāvanīyam nirviṣayajñānāyogāt| ata evādvaitaśrutivirodhena tattvāvedanāt pracyāvitaṃ satyatvam arthakriyāsamarthavyāvahārikaviṣayasamarahpaṇenopapādyate|
analyzed: katham tarhi śruteḥ prabalyam ucyate nirdoṣa tvāt paratvāt ca śruti mātrasya pratyakṣāt prābalyam iti utsargaḥ kim tu śruta bādhitam api pratyakṣam kathaṃcid sva ucita viṣaya upahāreṇa sambhāvanīyam nirviṣaya jñāna ayogāt atas eva advaita śruti virodhena tattva āvedanāt pracyāvitam satya tvam arthakriyā samartha vyāvahārika viṣaya samarahpaṇena upapādyate

original: kiṃ bahunā `nedaṃ rajatam' iti sarvasiddhapratyakṣabādhitamapi śuktirajatapratyakṣamanubhavānurodhāt purodeśe śuktisaṃbhinnarajatopagamena samarthyate| na tu tadvirodhena vyavahitamāntaramasadeva vā rajataṃ viṣaya iti parikalpyate|
analyzed: kim bahunā na idam rajatam iti sarva siddha pratyakṣa bādhitam api śukti rajata pratyakṣam anubhava anurodhāt purodeśe śukti saṃbhinna rajata upagamena samarthyate na tu tad virodhena vyavahitam āntaram asat eva vā rajatam viṣayaḥ iti parikalpyate

original: evaṃ ca prastare yajamānabhedagrāhiṇo yāvadbrahmajñānamarthakriyāsaṃvādenānuvartamānasya pratyakṣasya prātibhāsikaviṣayatvābhyupagamenopapādanāyogād "yajamānaḥ prastara" iti śrutibādhyatve sarvathā nirviṣayatvaṃ syāditi tatparihārāya utsargamapodya śrutireva tatsiddhyadhikaraṇādipratipāditapparakāreṇānyathā nīyate|
analyzed: evam ca prastare yajamāna bheda grāhiṇaḥ yāvat brahma jñānam arthakriyā saṃvādena anuvartamānasya pratyakṣasya prātibhāsika viṣaya tva abhyupagamena upapādana ayogāt yajamānaḥ prastaraḥ iti śruti bādhya tve sarvathā nirviṣaya tvam syāt iti tad parihārāya utsargam apodya śrutiḥ eva tad siddhi adhikaraṇa ādi pratipādita pparakāreṇa anyathā nīyate

original: na cādvaitaśrutipratyakṣayoriva iha śrutipratyakṣayostāttvikavyāvahārikaviṣayatvopagamena pratyakṣopapādanaṃ kartuṃ śakyam| brahmātiriktasakalamithyātvapratipādakaṣaḍvidhatātparyaliṅgopapannānekaśrutiviruddhena ekonārthavādena prastare yajamānatādātmyasya tāttvikasya pratipādanāsambhavāt|
analyzed: na ca advaita śruti pratyakṣayoḥ iva iha śruti pratyakṣayoḥ tāttvika vyāvahārika viṣayatva upagamena pratyakṣa upapādanam kartum śakyam brahma atirikta sakala mithyātva pratipādaka ṣaḍvidha tātparya liṅga upapanna aneka śruti viruddhena eka ūna arthavādena prastare yajamāna tādātmyasya tāttvikasya pratipādana asambhavāt

original: evaṃ tattvamasivākyena tvaṃpadavācyasya sarvajñatvābhoktṛtvākartṛtvādiviśiṣṭabrahmasvarūpatvabodhane tatrāsarvajñatvabhoktṛtvādipratyakṣamatyantaṃ nirālambanaṃ syāditi tatparihārāya`ahaṃkāraśabalitasya bhoktṛtvādi, tato niṣkṛṣṭasyaśuddhasya udāsīnabrahmasvarūpatvam' iti vyavasthāmāśritya bhāgatyagalakṣaṇā''śrīyate|
analyzed: evam tattvamasi vākyena tvaṃpada vācyasya sarvajñatva abhoktṛ tva akartṛ tva ādi viśiṣṭa brahma svarūpa tva bodhane tatra asarvajñatva bhoktṛ tva ādi pratyakṣam atyantam nirālambanam syāt iti tad parihārāya ahaṃkāra śabalitasya bhoktṛ tva ādi tatas niṣkṛṣṭasya śuddhasya udāsīna brahma svarūpa tvam iti vyavasthām āśritya bhāga tyaga lakṣaṇā āśrīyate

original: evaṃ "kṛṣṇalaṃ śrapayed" ityādāvapi pratyakṣasyātyanta nirviṣayatvaprasaktau tatparihārāya śrutau lakṣaṇā uṣṇīkaraṇe| "neha nānā'sti kiñcana" ityatra pratyakṣasya kathaṃcidviṣayopapādanasambhave tu na prabalāyāḥ śrateranyathānayanamiti na kaścidapyavyavasthāprasaṅgaḥ|
analyzed: evam kṛṣṇalam śrapayet ityādau api pratyakṣasya atyanta nirviṣaya tva prasaktau tad parihārāya śrutau lakṣaṇā uṣṇīkaraṇe na iha nānā asti kiñcana iti atra pratyakṣasya kathaṃcid viṣaya upapādana sambhave tu na prabalāyāḥ śrateḥ anyathā nayanam iti na kaścid api avyavasthā prasaṅgaḥ

original: athavā "kṛṣṇalaṃ śrapayet" "somena yajeta"ityādau na pratyakṣānurodhena lakṣaṇā''śrayaṇam, ki tvanuṣṭhānāśaktyā| na hi kṛṣṇale uṣṇīkaraṇamātramiva mukhyaḥ pāko'nuṣṭhātuṃ śakyate| na vā somadravyakaraṇako yāga iva tadabhinno yāgaḥ kenacidanuṣṭhātuṃ śakyate|
analyzed: athavā kṛṣṇalam śrapayet somena yajeta ityādau na pratyakṣa anurodhena lakṣaṇa āśrayaṇam ki tu anuṣṭhāna aśaktyā na hi kṛṣṇale uṣṇīkaraṇa mātram iva mukhyaḥ pākaḥ anuṣṭhātum śakyate na vā soma dravya karaṇakaḥ yāgaḥ iva tad abhinnaḥ yāgaḥ kenacid anuṣṭhātum śakyate

original: na cānuṣṭheyatvābhimatasya pratyakṣavirodha evānuṣṭhānāśaktiriti śabdāntareṇa vyavahriyate iti vācyam| `śaśimaṇḍalaṃ kāntimat kuryād' iti vidhau anuṣṭheyatvābhimatasya śaśimaṇḍale kāntimattvasya pratyakṣāvirodhe'pyanuṣṭhānāśaktidarśanena tasyāstato bhinnatvāt| tathā ca tatra eva lakṣaṇā''śrayaṇam|
analyzed: na ca anuṣṭheya tva abhimatasya pratyakṣa virodhe eva anuṣṭhāna aśaktiḥ iti śabda antareṇa vyavahriyate iti vācyam śaśi maṇḍalam kāntimat kuryāt iti vidhau anuṣṭheya tva abhimatasya śaśi maṇḍale kāntimat tvasya pratyakṣa avirodhe pi anuṣṭhāna aśakti darśanena tasyāḥ tatas bhinna tvāt tathā ca tatra eva lakṣaṇa āśrayaṇam

original: tasmādapacchedanyāyādisiddhasya śrutabalīyastvasya na kaścid bādha iti|
analyzed: tasmāt apaccheda nyāya ādi siddhasya śruta balīyaḥ tvasya na kaścid bādhaḥ iti

original: atha kathamatrāpacchedanyāyapravṛttiḥ?| ucyate yathā jyotiṣṭome bahiṣpavamānārthaṃ prasarpatāmudgānurapacchede sati "yadyudgātā'paracchidyetādakṣiṇaṃ yajñamiṣṭvā tena punaryajeta" iti śrutinirīkṣaṇena jātā udgātrapacchedanimittakaprāyaścittakartavyatābuddhiḥ paścāt pratihartrapacchede sati "yadi pratihartā'pacchacidyeta sarvavedasaṃ dadyād" iti
analyzed: atha katham atra apaccheda nyāya pravṛttiḥ ucyate yathā jyotiṣṭome bahiṣpavamāna artham prasarpatām udgānuḥ apacchede sati yadi udgātā aparacchidyeta adakṣiṇam yajñam iṣṭvā tena punar yajeta iti śruti nirīkṣaṇena jātā udgātṛ apaccheda nimittaka prāyaścitta kartavya tā buddhiḥ paścāt pratihartṛ apacchede sati yadi sarvavedasam dadyāt iti

original: śrutinirīkṣaṇena jātayā tadviruddhapratihartrapacchedanimittaprāyaścittakartavyatābuddhyā bādhyate|
analyzed: śruti nirīkṣaṇena jātayā tad viruddha pratihartṛ apaccheda nimitta prāyaścitta kartavya tā buddhyā bādhyate

original: evaṃ pūrva ghaṭādisatyatvapratyakṣaṃ parayā tanmithyātvaśrutijanyabuddhyā bādhyate| na codāhṛtasthale pūrvanaimittikakartavyatābuddheḥ paranaimittikakartavyatābuddhyā bādhe'pi pūrvanaimittikakartavyatājanakaṃ śāstraṃ yatrodgātṛmātrāpacchedaḥ, ubhayorapi yugapadapacchedau vā, udgātrapacchedasya paratvaṃ vā, tatra sāvakāśam, pratyakṣaṃ tu
analyzed: evam ghaṭa ādi satya tva pratyakṣam parayā tad mithyātva śruti janya buddhyā bādhyate na ca udāhṛta sthale pūrva naimittika kartavyatā buddheḥ para naimittika kartavyatā buddhyā bādhe pi pūrva naimittika kartavyatā janakam śāstram yatra udgātṛ mātra apacchedaḥ ubhayoḥ api yugapad apacchedau vā udgātṛ apacchedasya paratvam vā tatra sa avakāśam pratyakṣam tu

original: advaitaśrutyā bādhe viṣayāntarābhāvānnirālambanaṃ syāditi vaiṣamyaṃ śaṅkanīyam| yatra ghaṭādau śrutyā bādhye pratyakṣaṃ pravartate, tatraiva vyāvahārikaṃ viṣayaṃ labdhvā kṛtārthasya tasya parāpacchedasthale sarvathā bādhitasya pūrvāpacchedaśāstrasyeva viṣayāntarānveṣaṇābhāvād|
analyzed: advaita śrutyā bādhe viṣaya antara abhāvāt nirālambanam syāt iti vaiṣamyam śaṅkanīyam yatra ghaṭa ādau śrutyā bādhye pratyakṣam pravartate tatra eva vyāvahārikam viṣayam labdhvā kṛtārthasya tasya para apaccheda sthale sarvathā bādhitasya pūrva apaccheda śāstrasya iva viṣaya antara anveṣaṇa abhāvāt

original: ihāpi sarvapratyayavedyabrahmasattāyā sāvakāśaṃ pratyakṣamiti vaktuṃ śakyatvācca|
analyzed: iha api sarva pratyaya vedya brahma sattāyā sāvakāśam pratyakṣam iti vaktum śakya tvāt ca

original: yattvekasminnapi prayoge kramikābhyāṃ nimittābhyāṃ kratau tattannaimittikakartavyatayorbadaraphale śyāmaraktarūpayeriva krameṇotpādād rūpajñānadvayavat kartavyatājñānadvayamapi pramāṇaseveti na pareṇa pūrvajñānabādhe apacchedanyāya udāharaṇam|
analyzed: yat tu ekasmin api prayoge kramikābhyām nimittābhyām kratau tat tat naimittika kartavyatayoḥ badara phale śyāma rakta rūpa yeḥ iva krameṇa utpādāt rūpa jñāna dvaya vat kartavyatā jñāna dvayam api pramāṇa sevā iti na pareṇa pūrva jñāna bādhe apaccheda nyāyaḥ udāharaṇam

original: ata evāpacchedādhikaraṇe "naimittikaśāstrasya hyayamarthaḥ nimittopajananāt praganyathākartavyo'pi kraturnimitte satyanyathā kartavyaḥ" iti śāstradīpikāvacanamiti, tanna| aṅgasya sataḥ kartavyatvam| na ca paścādbhāvipratihartrapacchedavati kratau pūrvavṛttodgātrapacchedanimittakasya pāyaścittasyāṅgatvamasti|
analyzed: atas eva apaccheda adhikaraṇe naimittika śāstrasya hi ayam arthaḥ nimitta upajananāt kratuḥ nimitte sati anyathā kartavyaḥ iti śāstradīpikā vacanam iti tat na aṅgasya sataḥ kartavya tvam na ca paścādbhāvi pratihartṛ apacchedavati kratau pūrva vṛtta udgātṛ apaccheda nimittakasya pāyaścittasya aṅga tvam asti

original: āhavanīyaśāstrasya padahomātiriktahomaviṣayatvavad "yadyudgātā'pacchidyeta" iti śāstrasya paścādbhāvipratihartrapacchedarahitakratuviṣayatvāt|
analyzed: āhavanīya śāstrasya pada homa atirikta homa viṣaya tva vat yadi udgātā apacchidyeta iti śāstrasya paścādbhāvi pratihartṛ apaccheda rahita kratu viṣaya tvāt

original: uktaṃ hi nyāyaratnamālāyām
analyzed: uktam hi nyāyaratnamālāyām

original: `sādhāraṇasya śāstrasya viśeṣaviṣayādinā|
analyzed: sādhāraṇasya śāstrasya viśeṣa viṣaya ādinā

original: saṃkocaḥ klṛptarūpasya prāptabādho'rabhidhīyate||'
analyzed: saṃkocaḥ klṛpta rūpasya prāpta bādhoḥ abhidhīyate

original: ityuktalakṣaṇaprāptabādhavivecane, "tatraivaṃ sati śāstrārtho bhavati, paścādbhāvyudgātrapacchedavidhurapratihartrapacchedavataḥ kratossarvavedasadānamaṅgam, evamudgātrapacchede'pi draṣṭavyam" iti|
analyzed: iti ukta lakṣaṇa prāpta bādha vivecane tatra evam sati śāstra arthaḥ bhavati paścāt bhāvi udgātṛ apaccheda vidhura pratihartṛ apacchedavataḥ kratoḥ sarvavedasa dānam aṅgam evam udgātṛ apacchede api draṣṭavyam iti

original: yattu śāstradīpikāvacanamudāhṛtam, tadapi tenotpannamapi pūrvaprāyaścittajñānaṃ mithyā bhavati bādhitatvād, uttarasya tu na kiñcidbādhakamastīti pūrvakartavyatābādhyatvapratipādakagranthopasaṃhārapaṭhitatvād nimittopajananātpraṅ nimittopajananaṃ vinā nimittopajananābhāve sati anyathā kartavyo'pīti kṛtvācintāmātraparam|
analyzed: yat tu śāstradīpikā vacanam udāhṛtam tat api tena utpannam api pūrva prāyaścitta jñānam mithyā bhavati bādhita tvāt uttarasya tu na kiñcid bādhakam asti iti pūrva kartavya tā bādhya tva pratipādaka grantha upasaṃhāra paṭhita tvāt nimitta upajananāt praṅ nimitta upajananam vinā nimitta upajanana abhāve sati anyathā kartavyā upi iti kṛtvā acintā mātra param

original: na tūttaranimittopajananātprākpūrvanaimittikakartavyatā vastuta āsīdityevaṃparam| pūrvagranthasandarbhavirakodhāpatteḥ|
analyzed: na tu uttara nimitta upajananāt prāk pūrva naimittika kartavya tā vastutas āsīt iti evaṃparam pūrva grantha sandarbha virakodha āpatteḥ

original: āstāṃ mīmāṃsakamaryādā| śyāmataduttararaktarūpanyāyena kramikakartavyatādvayotpattyupagame ko virodhaḥ?|
analyzed: āstām mīmāṃsaka maryādā śyāma tad uttara rakta rūpa nyāyena kramika kartavya tā dvaya utpatti upagame kaḥ virodhaḥ

original: ucyate tathāhi kiṃ tat kartavyatvam, yat paranaimittikakartavyatotpattyā nivarteta| na tāvat pūrvanaimittikasya kṛtisādhyatvayogyatvam| tasya paścādapyanapāyāt| nāpi phalamukhaṃ kṛtisādhyatvam| tasya pūrvamapyajananāt| nāpi yadananuṣṭhānakratorvaikalyaṃ, tattvam, aṅgatvaṃ vā|
analyzed: ucyate tathā hi kim tat kartavya tvam yat para naimittika kartavya tā utpattyā nivarteta na tāvat pūrva naimittikasya kṛti sādhya tva yogya tvam tasya paścāt api anapāyāt nā api phala mukham kṛti sādhya tvam tasya pūrvam api ajananāt nā api yat ananuṣṭhāna kratoḥ vaikalyam tattvam aṅgatvam vā

original: ananuṣṭhāne kratuvaikalyaprayojakatvasya niyamaviśeṣarūpatvena karmāṅgatvasya phalopakāritayā sannipātitayā vā kāraṇatvaviśeṣarūpatvena ca tayoḥ kādācitkatvāyogena svābhāvikatvanirvāhāya paścādbhāviviruddhāpacchedābhāvavataḥ kratoḥ parvāpacchedanaimittikamaṅgam, tatraiva tadananuṣṭhānaṃ kratuvaikalyaprayojakamiti viśeṣaṇīyatayā
analyzed: ananuṣṭhāne kratu vaikalya prayojaka tvasya niyama viśeṣa rūpa tvena karma aṅga tvasya phala upakāri tayā sannipāti tayā vā kāraṇatva viśeṣa rūpa tvena ca tayoḥ kādācitkatva ayogena svābhāvika tva nirvāhāya paścādbhāvi viruddha apaccheda abhāvavataḥ kratoḥ parva apaccheda naimittikam aṅgam tatra eva tat ananuṣṭhānam kratu vaikalya prayojakam iti viśeṣaṇīya tayā

original: pāścāttyāpacchedāntaravati kratau pṛrvāpacchedanaimittike kratvaṅgasya, tadananuṣṭhāne kratuvaikalyaprayojakatvasya vā pāścāttyāpacchedotpatteḥ pūrvamasambhavāt| na hi vastu kiñcacidvastvantaraṃ prati kañcitkālaṃ vyāpya paścānneti vā, kañcitkālaṃ kāraṇaṃ paścānneti vā, kkacid dṛṣṭam, yuktaṃ vā|
analyzed: pāścāttya apaccheda antaravati kratau pṛrva apaccheda naimittike kratu aṅgasya tad ananuṣṭhāne kratu vaikalya prayojaka tvasya vā pāścāttya apaccheda utpatteḥ pūrvam asambhavāt na hi vastu kiñcacid vastu antaram prati kañcid kālam vyāpya paścāt na iti vā kañcid kālam kāraṇam paścāt na iti vā kkacid dṛṣṭam yuktam vā

original: nāpi kartavyatvaṃ nāma dharmāntarabhevāgamāpāyayogyaṃ kalpyam| mānābhāvāt| viruddhāpacchedaśāstrayoḥ padāhavanīyaśāstravavdyavasthopapatteḥ| tasmānnirālambanaṃ kramikakartavyatādvayotpattivacaḥ||
analyzed: nā api kartavya tvam nāma dharma antara bheva āgama apāya yogyam kalpyam māna abhāvāt viruddha apaccheda śāstrayoḥ tasmāt nirālambanam kramika kartavya tā dvaya utpatti vacaḥ

original: nanu copakramādhikaraṇanyāyenāsañcayātavirodhitvāt pratyakṣamevāgamād balīyaḥ kiṃ na syāt?|
analyzed: nanu ca upakrama adhikaraṇa nyāyena a sañcayāt virodhi tvāt pratyakṣam eva āgamāt balīyaḥ kim na syāt

original: ucyate yatraikavākyatā pratīyate, tatraikasminnevārthe paryavasānena bhāvyam, arthabhede pratītaikavākyatābhaṅgaprasaṅgāt|
analyzed: ucyate yatra ekavākyatā pratīyate tatra ekasmin eva arthe paryavasānena bhāvyam artha bhede pratīta ekavākya tā bhaṅga prasaṅgāt

original: atastatka prathamasañjātapratipakṣeṇa "prajāpatirvaruṇāyāśvamanayad" ityādyupakrameṇa parakṛtisarūpārthavādena dāturiṣṭau buddhimadhiropitāyāṃ tadviruddhārthaṃ "yāvato'śvān pratigṛhṇīyāttāvato vāruṇān catuṣkapālānnirvaped" ityupasaṃhāragataṃ padajātamupajātapratipakṣātvādyathāśrutārthasamarpaṇena tadekavākyatāmapratipadyamānamekavākyatānirvāhāya
analyzed: atas tat ka prathama sañjāta pratipakṣeṇa prajāpatiḥ varuṇāya aśvam anayat ityādi upakrameṇa parakṛti sarūpa artha vādena dātuḥ iṣṭau buddhim adhiropitāyām tad viruddha artham yāvatā uśvān pratigṛhṇīyāt tāvataḥ vāruṇān catuṣkapālān nirvapet iti upasaṃhāra gatam pada jātam upajāta pratipakṣā tvāt yathāśruta artha samarpaṇena tat ekavākya tām a pratipadyamānam ekavākya tā nirvāhāya

original: ṇijarthamantarbhāvya tadānuguṇyenaivātmānaṃ labhate iti upakramasya prābalyam| yatra tu parasparamekavākyatā na pratīyate| tatra pūrvavṛttamavigaṇayya labdhātmakaṃ viruddhārthakaṃ vākyaṃ svārthaṃ bodhayatyeveti na tatra pūrvavṛttasya prābalyam|

original: ata eva ṣoḍaśigrahaṇavākyaṃ pūrvavṛttamavigaṇayya tadagrahaṇavākyasyāpi svārthabodhakatvamupeyate, kintubhayorviṣayāntarābhāvād agatyā tatraiva vikalpānuṣṭhānamiṣyate|

original: na ca mithyātvaśrutyā varṇapadādisatyatvāṃśopamarde'pi upajīvyasvarūpāṃśopamardābhāvānnopajīvyavirodha iti vācyam| "neha nānāsti kiñcina" ityādiśrutibhiḥ svarūpeṇaiva prapañcābhāvābodhanāt||

analyzed: atra kecid āhuḥ vṛṣam ānaya ityādi vākyam śravaṇa doṣāt vṛṣabham ānaya ityādi rūpeṇa śṛṇvataḥ api śābda pramiti darśanena śābda pramitau varṇa pada ādi pratyakṣam pramā bhrama sādhāraṇam eva apekṣitam iti advaita āgamena varṇa pada ādi pratyakṣa mātram upajīvyam na tat pramā tathā ca varṇa pada ādi svarūpa upamarde pi na upajīvya virodhaḥ iti

original: anye tvāhuḥ śābdapramitau varṇapadādisvarūpasiddhyanapekṣāyāmapyayogyaśabdāt pramityanudayādyogyatāsvarūpasiddhyapekṣā'sti| tadapekṣāyāmapi nopajīvyavirodhaḥ| "neha nānāsti" itiśrutyā niṣedhe'pi yāvadbrahmajñānamanuvartamānasyārthakriyāsaṃvādino'sadvilakṣaṇaprapañcasvarūpasyāṅgīkārāt|
analyzed: anye tu āhuḥ śābda pramitau varṇa pada ādi svarūpa siddhi anapekṣāyām api ayogya śabdāt pramiti anudayāt yogyatā svarūpa siddhi apekṣā asti tad apekṣāyām api na upajīvya virodhaḥ na iha nānā asti iti śrutyā niṣedhe pi yāvat brahma jñānam anuvartamānasya arthakriyā saṃvādinā usat vilakṣaṇa prapañca svarūpasya aṅgīkārāt

original: anyathā pratyakṣādīnāṃ vyāvahārikapramāṇānāṃ nirviṣayatvaprasaṅgāt|

original: na ca svarūpeṇa niṣedhe'pi kathaṃ prapañcaṭasvarūpasyātmalābhaḥ| niṣedhasya pratiyogyapratikṣeparūpatve vyāghātāditi vācyam| śuktau `idaṃ rajatam,' `nedaṃ rajatam' iti pratītidvayānurodhenādhiṣṭhānagatādhyastābhāvasya bādhaparyantānuvṛttikāsadvilakṣaṇapratiyogisvarūpasahiṣṇutvābhyupagamāt|

original: etena prapañcasya svarūpeṇa niṣedhe śaśaśṛṅgavadasattvameva syāditi nirastam| pabrahmajñānanivartyasvarūpāṅgīkāreṇa vaiṣamyāt|
analyzed: etena prapañcasya svarūpeṇa niṣedhe śaśa śṛṅga vat asattvam eva syāt iti nirastam vaiṣamyāt

original: na cāsyādhyastasyādhiṣṭhāne svarūpeṇa niṣedhe anyatra tasya svarūpeṇa niṣedhaḥ svataḥ siddha iti tasya sarvadeśakālasambandhiniṣedhapratiyogitvāpattyā asattvaṃ durvāram| `sarvadeśakālasambandhiniṣedhapratiyogitvamasattvam' ityevāsattvanirvacanād, vidhāntareṇa tannirvacanāyogādeti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca asya adhyastasya adhiṣṭhāne sva rūpeṇa niṣedhe anyatra tasya sva rūpeṇa niṣedhaḥ svatas siddhaḥ iti tasya sarva deśa kāla sambandhi niṣedha pratiyogi tva āpattyā asattvam durvāram sarva deśa kāla sambandhi niṣedha pratiyogi tvam asattvam iti eva asattva nirvacanāt vidhā antareṇa tad nirvacana ayogāt eti vācyam

original: asataḥ sarvadeśakālasambandhiniṣedhapratiyogitvamupagacchatā, tasya tathātve pratyakṣasya sarvadeśakālayoḥ pratyakṣīkaraṇāyogena, āgamasya tādṛśāgamānupalambhena ca pramāṇayitumaśakyatayā'numānameva pramāṇayitavyamiti tadanumāne yat savdyāvṛttaṃ liṅgaṃ vācyam, tasyaiva prathamapratītasyāsattvanirvacanatvopapatterityāhuḥ||
analyzed: asataḥ sarva deśa kāla sambandhi niṣedha pratiyogi tvam upagacchatā tasya tathātve pratyakṣasya sarva deśa kālayoḥ pratyakṣīkaraṇa ayogena āgamasya tādṛśa āgama anupalambhena ca pramāṇayitum aśakya tayā anumānam eva pramāṇayitavyam iti tad anumāne yat liṅgam vācyam tasya eva prathama pratītasya asattva nirvacana tva upapatteḥ iti āhuḥ

original: aparetu "neha nānāsti" iti śruteḥ satyatvena prapañcaniṣedhe eva tātparyam, na svarūpeṇa| niṣedhasya svarūpāpratikṣepakatve tasya tanniṣedhatvāyogāt| tatpratikṣepakatve pratyakṣavirodhāt|
analyzed: apare tu na iha nānā asti iti śruteḥ satya tvena prapañca niṣedhe eva tātparyam na svarūpeṇa niṣedhasya svarūpa a pratikṣepaka tve tasya tad niṣedha tva ayogāt tad pratikṣepaka tve pratyakṣa virodhāt

original: na ca satyatvasyāpi `san ghaṭaḥ' ityādipratyakṣasiddhatvād na tenāpi rūpeṇa niṣedho yukta iti vācyam| pratyakṣasya śrutyavirodhāya satyatvābhāsarūpavyāvahārikasatyatvāviṣayatvopapatteḥ| ne caivaṃ sati parrimākhathakasatyatvasya brahmagatasya prapañce prasaktyabhāvāt tena rūpeṇa prapañcaniṣedhānupapattiḥ|

original: yathā śuktau rajatābhāsapratītireva satyarajataprasaktiriti tanniṣedhaḥ, ata eva `nedaṃ rajatam, kiṃ tu tat,' `neyaṃ madīyā gauḥ' kiṃ tu saiva,' `nātra vartamānaścaitraḥ, kiṃ tvapavarake' iti niṣidhyamānasyānyatra sattvamavagamyate, evaṃ satyatvābhāsapratītireva satyatvaprasaktiriti tanniṣedhopapatteḥ|
analyzed: yathā śuktau rajata ābhāsa pratītiḥ eva satya rajata prasaktiḥ iti tad niṣedhaḥ atas eva na idam rajatam kim tu tat na iyam madīyā gauḥ kim tu sā eva na atra vartamānaḥ caitraḥ kim tu apavarake iti niṣidhyamānasya anyatra sattvam avagamyate evam satya tva ābhāsa pratītiḥ eva satya tva prasaktiḥ iti tad niṣedha upapatteḥ

original: ato varṇapadayogyatādisvarūpopamardaśaṅkābhāvānnopajīvyavirodha ityāhuḥ||

original: anye tu brahmaṇi pāramārthikasatyatvam, prapañce vyavahārikasatyatvaṃ satyatvābhāsarūpam, śuktirajatādau prātibhāsikasatyatvaṃ tato'pi nikṛṣṭamiti sattātraividhyaṃ nopeyate, adhiṣṭhānabrahmagatapāramārthikasattā'nuvedhādeva ghaṭādau śuktirajatādau ca sattvābhimānopapattyā satyatvābhāsakalpanasya niṣpramāṇakatvāt|

original: na ca brahmagatapāramārthikasattā'tirekeṇa prapañce sattvābhāsānupagame vyavahitasatyarajatātirekeṇa śuktau rajatābhāsotpattiḥ kimanarthamupeyata iti vācyam| vyavahitasyāsannikṛṣṭasyāparokṣyāsambhavāt tannirvāhāya tadupagamāt||3||

original: nanvevaṃ pratibimbabhramasthale'pi grīvāsthamukhātirekeṇa darpaṇe mukhābhāsotpattirūpeyā syāt| svakīye grīvāsthamukhe nāsādyavacchinnapradeśāparokṣyasambhave'pi nayanagolakalalāṭādipradeśāparokṣyāyogāt| pratibimbabhrame nayanagolakādipradeśāparokṣyadarśanācca| na ca bimbātiriktapratibimbābhyupagame iṣṭāpattiḥ|

original: brahmapratibimbajīvasyāpi tato bhedena mithyātvāpatteḥ|
analyzed: brahma pratibimba jīvasya api tatas bhedena mithyātva āpatteḥ

original: atra vivaraṇānusāriṇaḥ prāhuḥ grīvāstha eva mukhe darpaṇopādhisannidhānadoṣād darpaṇasthatvapratyaṅmukhātvabimbabhedānāmadhyāsasambhavena na darpaṇe mukhasyādhyāsaḥ kalpanīyaḥ| gauravād| `darpaṇe mukhaṃ nāsti' iti saṃsargamātrabādhāt| mithyāvastvantaratve `nedaṃ mukham' iti svarūpabādhāpatteḥ|

original: `darpaṇe mama mukhaṃ bhāti' iti svamukhābhedapratyabhijñānācca|

original: na ca grīvāsthamukhasyādhiṣṭhānasyāparokṣyāsambhavaḥ| upādhipratihatanayanaraśmīnāṃ parāvṛtya bimbagrāhitvaniyamābhyupagamāllatādivad| tanniyamānabhyupagame paramāṇoḥ, kuhyādivyavahitasthūlasyāpicākṣuṣapratibimbabhramaprasaṅgāt| naca `avyavahitasthūlodbhūtarūpavata eva cākṣuṣapratibimbabhramaḥ, nānyasya' iti niyama iti vācyam|
analyzed: na ca grīvā stha mukhasya adhiṣṭhānasya aparokṣya asambhavaḥ upādhi pratihata nayana raśmīnām parāvṛtya bimba grāhi tva niyama abhyupagamāt latā ādi vat tad niyama an abhyupagame paramāṇoḥ kuhī ādi vyavahita sthūlasya api cākṣuṣa pratibimba bhrama prasaṅgāt na ca avyavahita sthūla udbhūta rūpavataḥ eva cākṣuṣa pratibimba bhramaḥ na anyasya iti niyamaḥ iti vācyam

original: bimbasthaulyodbhūtarūpayoḥ klṛptena cākṣuṣajñānajananena upayogasambhave vidhāntareṇopayogakalpanānupapatteḥ| kuḍyādivyavadhānasya pratihatanayanaraśmisambandhavighaṭanaṃ vinaiveha pratibandhakatve tathaiva ghaṭapratyakṣādisthale'pi tasya pratibandhakatvasambhavena cakṣuḥsannikarṣamātrasya kāraṇatvavilopaprasaṅgācca|
analyzed: bimba sthaulya udbhūta rūpayoḥ klṛptena cākṣuṣa jñāna jananena upayoga sambhave vidhā antareṇa upayoga kalpanā anupapatteḥ kuḍya ādi vyavadhānasya pratihata nayana raśmi sambandha vighaṭanam vinā eva iha pratibandhaka tve tathā eva ghaṭa pratyakṣa ādi sthale api tasya pratibandhaka tva sambhavena cakṣuḥ sannikarṣa mātrasya kāraṇa tva vilopa prasaṅgāt ca

original: darpaṇe mithyāmukhādhyāsavādinā'pi kāraṇatrayāntargatasaṃskārasiddhyarthaṃ nayanaraśmīnāṃ kadācit parāvṛtya svamukhagrāhakatvakalpanayaiva pūrvānubhavasya samarthanīyatvācca| na ca nāsādipradeśāvacchinnapūrvānubhavādeva saṃskāropapattiḥ|

original: tāvatā nayanagolakādipratibimbādhyāsānupapatteḥ taṭākasalile taṭaviṭapisamārūḍhāṣṭacarapuruṣapratibimbādhyāsasthale kathamapi pūrvānubhavasya durvacatvācca| evaṃ copādhipratihatanayanaraśmīnā bimbaṃ prāpya tadgrāhakatve 'vaśyaṃ vaktavya phalabalāddarpaṇādyabhihatānāmeva bimbaṃ prāpya tadgrāhakatvam, na śilādipratihatānām|
analyzed: tāvatā nayana golaka ādi pratibimba adhyāsa anupapatteḥ taṭāka salile taṭa viṭapi samārūḍha aṣṭacara puruṣa pratibimba adhyāsa sthale katham api pūrva anubhavasya durvaca tvāt ca evam ca upādhi pratihata nayana raśmīnā bimbam prāpya tad grāhaka tve vaśyam phala balāt darpaṇa ādi abhihatānām eva bimbam prāpya tad grāhaka tvam na śilā ādi pratihatānām

original: anatisvacchatāmrādipratihatānāṃ malinopādhisambandhadoṣād mukhādisaṃsthānaviśeṣāgrāhakatvaṃ sākṣātsūryaṃ prepsūnāmiva upādhiṃ prāpya nivṛttānāṃ na tathā sauratejasā pratihatiriti na pratibimbasūryāvalokane sākṣāttadavalokane ivāśkyatvam|
analyzed: an ati svaccha tāmra ādi pratihatānām malina upādhi sambandha doṣāt mukha ādi saṃsthāna viśeṣa a grāhaka tvam sākṣāt sūryam prepsūnām iva upādhim prāpya nivṛttānām na tathā saura tejasā pratihatiḥ iti na pratibimba sūrya avalokane sākṣāt tad avalokane iva āśkya tvam

original: jalādyupādisannikarṣe keṣā cidupādhipratihatānāṃ bimbaprāptāvapikeṣāṃ cittadantargamanenāntarasikatādigrahaṇamityādikalpanānna kaściddoṣa iti||

original: ata eva `svapne jāgradindriyāṇāmuparatāvapi taijasavyavahāropayuktāni sūkṣmaśarīrāvayavabhūtāni śūkṣmendriyāṇi santīti taissvāpnapadārthanāmaindriyakatvam, ityupapādanaśaṅkā'pi nirastā| jāgradindriyavyatiriktasūkṣmendriyāprasiddheḥ|

original: tatra yadi svapne'pi cakṣurādivṛttisañcāraḥ kalpyeta, tadā tatrāpi jāgara iva tasya svayañjyotiṣṭvaṃ durvivecaṃ syādityutadāhṛtā śrutiḥ pīḍyeta|

original: nanu svapne cakṣurādyuparamakalpane'pi antaḥkaraṇamanuparatamāsta iti pariśeṣāsiddherna svayañjyotiṣṭvavivekaḥ| maivam|

original: `kartā śāstrārthavattvād' ityadhikaraṇe nyāyanirṇayoktarītyā'ntaḥkaraṇasya cakṣurādikaraṇāntaranirapekṣasya jñānasādhanatvābhāvādvā, tattvapradīpikoktarītyā svapne tasyaiva gajādyākāreṇa pariṇāmena jñānakarmatayā'vasthitatvena tadānīṃ jñānasādhanatvāyogādvā pariśeṣopapatteḥ|
analyzed: kartā śāstra arthavat tvāt iti adhikaraṇe nyāyanirṇaya ukta rītyā antaḥkaraṇasya cakṣuḥ ādi karaṇa antara nirapekṣasya jñāna sādhana tva abhāvāt vā tattvapradīpikā ukta rītyā svapne tasya eva gaja ādi ākāreṇa pariṇāmena jñāna karmatayā avasthita tvena tadānīm jñāna sādhana tva ayogāt vā pariśeṣa upapatteḥ

original: na ca svapne'ntaḥkaraṇavṛttyabhāve utthitasya svapnadṛṣṭagajādyanusandhānānupapattiḥ| suṣuptiklṛptayā avidyāvṛttyā tadupapatteḥ|
analyzed: na ca svapnentaḥkaraṇa vṛtti abhāve utthitasya svapna dṛṣṭa gaja ādi anusandhāna anupapattiḥ suṣupti klṛptayā avidyā vṛttyā tad upapatteḥ

original: suṣuptau tadavasthopahitameva svarūpacaitanyamajñānasukhādiprakāśaḥ utthitasyānusandhānamupādhibhūtāvasthāvināśajanyasaṃskāreṇeti vedāntakaumudyabhimate suṣuptāvavidyāvṛttyabhāvapakṣe ihāpi svāpnagajādibhāsakacaitanyopādhibhūtasvapnāvasthāvināśajanyasaṃskārādanusandhānopapatteśca|
analyzed: suṣuptau tad avasthā upahitam eva svarūpa caitanyam ajñāna sukha ādi prakāśaḥ utthitasya anusandhānam upādhi bhūta avasthā vināśa janya saṃskāreṇa iti vedāntakaumudī abhimate suṣuptau avidyā vṛtti abhāva pakṣe iha api svāpna gaja ādi bhāsaka caitanya upādhi bhūta svapna avasthā vināśa janya saṃskārāt anusandhāna upapatteḥ ca

original: athavā "tadetat sattvaṃ yena svapnaṃ paśyati" ityādiśruterastu svapne'pi kalpatarūktarītyā svāpnagajādigocarāntaḥkaraṇavṛttiḥ| na ca tāvatā pariśeṣāsiddhiḥ| antaḥkaraṇasya `aham'itigṛhyamāṇasya sarvātmanā jīvaikyenādhyastatayā lokadṛṣṭyā tasya tavdyatirekāprasiddheḥ pariśeṣārthaṃ cakṣurādivyāpārābharāvamātrasyaivāpekṣitatvāt|
analyzed: athavā tat etat sattvam yena svapnam paśyati ityādi śruteḥ astu svapne pi kalpataru ukta rītyā svāpna gaja ādi gocara antaḥkaraṇa vṛttiḥ na ca tāvatā pariśeṣa asiddhiḥ antaḥkaraṇasya aham iti gṛhyamāṇasya sarva ātmanā jīva aikyena adhyasta tayā loka dṛṣṭyā tasya pariśeṣa artham cakṣuḥ ādi vyāpāra ābharāva mātrasya eva apekṣita tvāt

original: `prasiddhadṛśyamātraṃ dṛgavabhāsayogyam' iti niścayasattena pariśeṣārthamanyānapekṣaṇāt|
analyzed: prasiddha dṛśya mātram dṛś avabhāsa yogyam iti niścaya sattena pariśeṣa artham anya anapekṣaṇāt

original: tasmāt sarvathā'pi svapne cakṣurādivyāpārāsambhavāt svāpnagajādau cākṣuṣatvādyanubhavo brama eva|
analyzed: tasmāt sarvathā api svapne cakṣuḥ ādi vyāpāra asambhavāt svāpna gaja ādau cākṣuṣa tva ādi anubhavaḥ bramaḥ eva

original: nanu svapne'pi cakṣurunmīlane gajādyanubhavaḥ, tannimīlane neti jāgara iva gajādyanubhavasya cakṣurunmīlanādyanuvidhānaṃ pratīyate iti cet| `cakṣuṣā rajatādikaṃ paśyāmi' ityanubhavavadayamapi kaścit svapnabhramo bhaviṣyati yat kevalasākṣirūpe svāpnagajādyanubhave cakṣugadyanuvidhānaṃ tadanuvidhāyinī vṛttirvā'dhyasyate|
analyzed: nanu svapne api cakṣuḥ unmīlane gaja ādi anubhavaḥ tad nimīlane na iti jāgare iva gaja ādi anubhavasya cakṣuḥ unmīlana ādi anuvidhānam pratīyate iti ced cakṣuṣā rajata ādikam paśyāmi iti anubhava vat ayam api kaścid svapna bhramaḥ bhaviṣyati yat kevala sākṣi rūpe svāpna gaja ādi anubhave cakṣu gadi anuvidhānam tad anuvidhāyinī vṛttiḥ vā adhyasyate

original: kimiva hi durghaṭamapi bhramaṃ māyā na karoti viśeṣato nidrārūpeṇa pariṇatā, yasyā māhātmyāt svapne rathaḥ pratītaḥ kṣaṇena manuṣyaḥ pratīyate, sa ca kṣaṇena mārjāraḥ| svapnadraṣṭuśca na pūrvāparavirodhānusandhānam| tasmādanvayādyanuvidhānapratītitaulye'pi jāgradgajādyanubhava eva cakṣulādijanyaḥ, na svāpnagajādyanubhavaḥ||
analyzed: kim iva hi durghaṭam api bhramam māyā na karoti viśeṣataḥ nidrā rūpeṇa pariṇatā yasyāḥ māhātmyāt svapne rathaḥ pratītaḥ kṣaṇena manuṣyaḥ pratīyate sa ca kṣaṇena mārjāraḥ svapna draṣṭuḥ ca na pūrva apara virodha anusandhānam tasmāt anvaya ādi anuvidhāna pratīti taulye pi jāgrat gaja ādi anubhavaḥ eva cakṣula ādi janyaḥ na svāpna gaja ādi anubhavaḥ

original: dṛṣṭisṛṣṭivādinastu kalpitasyājñātasattvamanupapannamiti kṛtsnasya jāgratprapañcasya dṛṣṭisamasamayāṃ mṛṣṭimupetya ghaṭādidṛṣṭeścakṣuḥsannikarṣānuvidhānapratītiṃ dṛṣṭeḥ pūrvaṃ ghaṭādyabhāvenāsaṅgacchamānāṃ svapnavadeva samarthayamānāḥ jāgradgajādyanubhavo'pi na cākṣuṣa ityāhuḥ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭi sṛṣṭi vādinaḥ tu kalpitasya ajñāta sattvam anupapannam iti kṛtsnasya jāgrat prapañcasya dṛṣṭi sama samayām mṛṣṭim upetya ghaṭa ādi dṛṣṭeḥ cakṣuḥ sannikarṣa anuvidhāna pratītim dṛṣṭeḥ pūrvam ghaṭa ādi abhāvena asaṅgacchamānām svapna vat eva samarthayamānāḥ jāgrat gaja ādi anubhavaḥ api na cākṣuṣaḥ iti āhuḥ

original: nanu, dṛṣṭisṛṣṭimavalambaya kṛtsnasya jāgratprapañcasya kalpitatvopagame kastasya kalpakaḥ nirupādhirātmā vā, avidyopahito vā?| nādyaḥ| mokṣe'pi sādhanāntaranirapekṣasya kalpakasya sattvena prapañcānuvṛttyā saṃsārāviśeṣaprasaṅgāt| na dvitīyaḥ| avidyāyā api kalpanīyatvena tatkalpanātprāgeva kalpakasiddhervaktavyatvāt|
analyzed: nanu dṛṣṭi sṛṣṭim avalambaya kṛtsnasya jāgrat prapañcasya kalpita tva upagame kaḥ tasya kalpakaḥ nirupādhiḥ ātmā vā avidyā upahitaḥ vā na ādyaḥ mokṣe pi sādhana antara nirapekṣasya kalpakasya sattvena prapañca anuvṛttyā saṃsāra aviśeṣa prasaṅgāt na dvitīyaḥ avidyāyāḥ api kalpanīya tvena tad kalpanāt prāk eva kalpaka siddheḥ vaktavya tvāt

original: atra kecidāhuḥ pūrvapūrvakalpitāvidyopahita uttarottarāvidyākalpakaḥ| anidaṃprathamatvācca kalpakakalpanāpravāhasya nānavasthādoṣaḥ| na cāvidyāyā anāditvopagamācchuktirajatavatū kalpitatvaṃ na yujyate, anyathā sādyanādivibhāgānupapatteriti vācyam|
analyzed: atra kecid āhuḥ pūrva pūrva kalpita avidyā upahitaḥ uttara uttara avidyā kalpakaḥ anidaṃprathama tvāt ca kalpaka kalpanā pravāhasya na anavasthā doṣaḥ na ca avidyāyāḥ anādi tva upagamāt śukti rajata vatū kalpita tvam na yujyate anyathā sādi anādi vibhāga anupapatteḥ iti vācyam

original: yathā svapne kalpyamānaṃ gopurādi kiñcit pūrvasiddhatvena kalpyate, kiñacittadānīmutpādyamānatvena, evaṃ jāgare'pi kiñcit kalpyamānaṃ sāditvena kalpyate, kiñcidanyatheti tāvatā sādyanādivibhāgopapatteḥ| etena kāryakāraṇavibhāgo'pi vyākhyāta iti|
analyzed: yathā svapne kalpyamānam gopura ādi kiñcid pūrva siddha tvena kalpyate kiñcid tadānīm utpādyamāna tvena evam jāgare api kiñcid kalpyamānam sādi tvena kalpyate kiñcid anyathā iti tāvatā sādi anādi vibhāga upapatteḥ etena kārya kāraṇa vibhāgaḥ api vyākhyātaḥ iti

analyzed: ātma anyā eva avidyā nivṛttiḥ sā ca na satī advaita hāneḥ nā api asatī jñāna sādhya tva ayogāt nā api sat asat rūpā virodhāt nā api anirvācyā anirvācyasya sa ādeḥ ajñāne pādanaka tva niyamane muktau api tad upādāna ajñāna anuvṛtti āpatteḥ jñāna nivartya tva āpatteḥ ca kim tu ukta prakāra catuṣṭaya uttīrṇā pañcama prakārā iti ānandabodha ācāryāḥ

original: avidyāvattannivṛttirapyanirvācyaiva| na ca tadanuvṛttau tadupādānājñānasyāpyanuvṛttiniyamād anirmokṣaprasaṅgaḥ| tadanuvṛttau pramāṇābhāvāt| utpatteḥ prathamasamayamātrasaṃsargibhāvavikāratvavad nivṛtterapi caramasamayamātrasaṃsargibhāvavikāratvopapatteḥ|
analyzed: avidyā vat tad nivṛttiḥ api anirvācyā eva na ca tad anuvṛttau tad upādāna ajñānasya api anuvṛtti niyamāt anirmokṣa prasaṅgaḥ tad anuvṛttau pramāṇa abhāvāt utpatteḥ prathama samaya mātra saṃsargi bhāva vikāra tva vat nivṛtteḥ api carama samaya mātra saṃsargi bhāva vikāra tva upapatteḥ

original: ata eva yathā pūrvaṃ paścācca `nivartiṣyate, nivṛttaḥ' iti bhāvibhūtabhāvena vyavahriyamāṇāyā nivṛtteścaramasamayamātre `nivartate, naśyati, dhvaṃsate' iti vartamānavyapadeśaḥ| nivṛtteranuvṛttau tu ciraśakalita'pi ghaṭe `idānīṃ nivartate' ityādivyavahāraḥ syāt| ākhyātānāṃ prakṛtyarthagatavartamānatvādyarthābhidhāyitvāt|
analyzed: atas eva yathā pūrvam paścāt ca nivartiṣyate nivṛttaḥ iti bhāvi bhūta bhāvena vyavahriyamāṇāyāḥ nivṛtteḥ carama samaya mātre nivartate naśyati dhvaṃsate iti vartamāna vyapadeśaḥ nivṛtteḥ anuvṛttau tu ghaṭe idānīm nivartate ityādi vyavahāraḥ syāt ākhyātānām prakṛti artha gata vartamāna tva ādi artha abhidhāyi tvāt

original: kapālasaṃsthānaviśeṣādinā'numeyo ghaṭādidhvaṃso na pratyakṣa iti cet, tarhi tena mudgarapātakālīnasya utapattivad bhāvavikārarūpatayā pratiyogyāśritadhvaṃsasyānumānaṃ sambhavatīti na tataḥ paścādanuvartamānapratiyogyadhikaraṇāśritābhāvarūpadhvaṃsasiddhiḥ|
analyzed: kapāla saṃsthāna viśeṣa ādinā anumeyaḥ ghaṭa ādi dhvaṃsaḥ na pratyakṣaḥ iti ced tarhi tena mudgara pāta kālīnasya utapatti vat bhāva vikāra rūpatayā pratiyogi āśrita dhvaṃsasya anumānam sambhavati iti na tatas paścāt anuvartamāna pratiyogi adhikaraṇa āśrita abhāva rūpa dhvaṃsa siddhiḥ

original: `iha bhūtale ghaṭadhvaṃsaḥ' iti bhūtale dhvaṃsādhikaraṇatvavyavahārasya `iha bhūtale ghaṭa utapannaḥ' itivat bhāvavikārayuktapratiyogyadhikaraṇatvaviṣayatvopapatteḥ| ghaṭadhvaṃsānantaraṃ bhūtale ghaṭābhāvavyavahārasya ghaṭāpasaraṇānantaraṃ tadabhāvavyavahāravat samayaviśeṣasaṃsargyatyantābhāvālambanatopapattyā dhvaṃsaviṣayatvasyākalpanīyatvācca|
analyzed: iha bhū tale ghaṭa dhvaṃsaḥ iti bhū tale dhvaṃsa adhikaraṇa tva vyavahārasya iha bhū tale ghaṭaḥ iti vat bhāva vikāra yukta pratiyogi adhikaraṇa tva viṣayatva upapatteḥ ghaṭa dhvaṃsa anantaram bhū tale ghaṭa abhāva vyavahārasya ghaṭa apasaraṇa anantaram tad abhāva vyavahāra vat samaya viśeṣa saṃsargi atyanta abhāva ālambana tā upapattyā dhvaṃsa viṣayatvasya akalpanīya tvāt ca

original: evaṃ sati ghaṭotpatteḥ pūrvaṃ tadabharāvavyavahāro'pyatyantābhāvena caritārtha iti prāgabhāvo'pi na syāditi cet, so'pi mā bhūt| nanvevaṃ `prāgabhāvādhārakālaḥ pūrvakālaḥ, dhvaṃsādhāra uttarakālaḥ' iti nirvacanāsambhavāt kāle pūrvottarādivyavahāraḥ kimālambanassyāt| ghaṭādiṣu pratiyogitvādivyavahāravadakhaṇ‍ḍakiñciddharmagocaro'stu|
analyzed: evam sati ghaṭa utpatteḥ pūrvam tad abharau avyavahāraḥ api atyanta abhāvena caritārthaḥ iti prāgabhāvaḥ api na syāt iti ced saḥ api mā bhūt nanu evam prāgabhāva ādhāra kālaḥ pūrva kālaḥ dhvaṃsa ādhāraḥ uttara kālaḥ iti nirvacana asambhavāt kāle pūrva uttara ādi vyavahāraḥ kim ālambanaḥ syāt ghaṭa ādiṣu pratiyogi tva ādi vyavahāra vat akhaṇḍa kiñcid dharma gocaraḥ tu

original: abhāvarūpasthāyidhvaṃsābhyupagame'pi teṣu dhvaṃsatvāderakhaṇḍasya vaktavyatvāt| na ca janyābhāvatvarūpaṃ sakhaṇḍameva dhvaṃsatvam| dhvaṃsaprāgabhāvarūpasya ghaṭasya tad‌dhvaṃsatvāpatteḥ|
analyzed: abhāva rūpa sthāyi dhvaṃsa abhyupagame api teṣu dhvaṃsa tva ādeḥ akhaṇḍasya vaktavya tvāt na ca janya abhāva tva rūpam sakhaṇḍam eva dhvaṃsa tvam dhvaṃsa prāgabhāva rūpasya ghaṭasya tad dhvaṃsa tva āpatteḥ

original: na ca saptamapadārtharūpābhāvatvaṃ vivakṣitam| ghaṭasya prāgabhāvaṃ pratyapi dhvaṃsatvābhāvaprasaṅgena ghaṭakāle prāgabhāvottarakālatvavyavahārasya nirālambanatvāpatteḥ| na ca pratiyogyatiriktaḥ prāgabhāvadhvaṃsaḥ|
analyzed: na ca saptama padārtha rūpa abhāva tvam vivakṣitam ghaṭasya prāgabhāvam prati api dhvaṃsa tva abhāva prasaṅgena ghaṭa kāle prāgabhāva uttara kāla tva vyavahārasya nirālambana tva āpatteḥ na ca pratiyogi atiriktaḥ prāgabhāva dhvaṃsaḥ

original: tathā sati tulyanyāyatayā dhvaṃsaprāgabhāvo'pi pratiyogyatiriktaḥ syāditi prāgabhāvadhvaṃsasyāpi prāgabhāvo'nyaḥ, tasyāpi kaścid, dhvaṃsaḥ, tasyāpi prāgabhāvo'nya ityaprāmāṇikānavadhikadhvaṃsaprāgabhāvakalpanāpatteḥ| na cānyad dhvasatvamātmāśrayādiśūnyaṃ nirvaktuṃ śakyam| evaṃ prāgabhāvatvamapītyanyatra vistaraḥ|
analyzed: tathā sati tulya nyāyatayā dhvaṃsa prāgabhāvaḥ api pratiyogi atiriktaḥ syāt iti prāgabhāva dhvaṃsasya api prāgabhāvaḥ nyaḥ tasya api kaścid dhvaṃsaḥ tasya api prāgabhāvaḥ nyaḥ iti aprāmāṇika anavadhika dhvaṃsa prāgabhāva kalpanā āpatteḥ na ca anyat dhvasa tvam ātma āśraya ādi śūnyam nirvaktum śakyam evam prāgabhāva tvam api iti anyatra vistaraḥ

original: tasmānna pūrvaṃ prāgabhāvaḥ, na ca paścāt dhvaṃsābhāvaḥ| madhye paraṃ kiyatkālamanirvacanīyotpattisthitidhvaṃsarūpabhāvavikāravān ghaṭādyadhyāsaḥ. evaṃ cāvidyānivṛttirapi brahmasākṣātkārodayānantarakṣaṇavartī kaścidbhāvavikāra iti tasyā muktāvanuvṛttyabhāvānna tadanirvācyatve kaściddoṣa ityadvaitavidyācāryāḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: tasmāt na pūrvam prāgabhāvaḥ na ca paścāt dhvaṃsa abhāvaḥ madhye param kiyatkālam anirvacanīya utpatti sthiti dhvaṃsa rūpa bhāva vikāravān ghaṭa ādi adhyāsaḥ evam ca avidyā nivṛttiḥ api brahma sākṣātkāra udaya anantara kṣaṇa vartī kaścid bhāva vikāraḥ iti tasyāḥ muktau anuvṛtti abhāvāt na tad anirvācya tve kaścid doṣaḥ iti advaita vidyā ācāryāḥ 20

original: nanvevamavidyānivṛtteḥ kṣaṇikatvaṃ mokṣaḥ sthirapuruṣārtho na syāditi ced, bhrānto'si| na hyavidyānivṛttiḥ svayameva puruṣārtha iti tasyā jñānasādhyatvamupeyate| tasyāḥ sukhaduḥkhābhāvetaratvāt|
analyzed: nanu evam avidyā nivṛtteḥ kṣaṇikatvam mokṣaḥ sthira puruṣa arthaḥ na syāt iti ced bhrāntaḥ asi na hi avidyā nivṛttiḥ svayam eva puruṣa arthaḥ iti tasyāḥ jñāna sādhya tvam upeyate tasyāḥ sukha duḥkha abhāva itaratvāt

original: kiṃ tvakhaṇḍānandāvarakasaṃsāraduḥkhahetvavidyocchede akhaṇḍānandasphuraṇam, saṃsāraduḥkhocchedaśca bhavatīti tadupayogitayā tasyāstattvajñānasādhyatvamupeyate||

original: citsukhācāryāstu duḥkhābhāvo'pi muktau na svataḥpuruṣārthaḥ| sarvatra duḥkhābhāvasya svarūpasukhābhivyaktipratibandhakābharāvatayā sukhaśeṣatvāt sukhasyaiva svataḥpuruṣārthatvam|

original: anyeṣāṃ sarveṣāmapi taccheṣatvamiti sukhasādhanatājñānasyaiva pravartakatve sambhavati duḥkhābhāvasyāpi svataḥparuṣārthatvaṃ parikalpya tatsādhanaprarvatakasaṅgrahāya iṣṭasādhanatājñānasya icchāviṣayatvapraveśena gurughaṭitasya pravartakatvakalpanāyogāt|
analyzed: anyeṣām sarveṣām api tad śeṣatvam iti sukha sādhanatā jñānasya eva pravartaka tve sambhavati duḥkha abhāvasya api svatas paruṣa artha tvam parikalpya tad sādhana prarvataka saṅgrahāya iṣṭasādhanatā jñānasya icchā viṣaya tva praveśena guru ghaṭitasya pravartaka tva kalpanā yogāt

original: na ca duḥkhābhāva eva svataḥpuruṣārthaḥ| taccheṣatayā sukhaṃ kāmyamiti vaiparītyāpattiḥ| bahukāladuḥkhasādhye'pi kṣaṇikasukhajanake ninditagrāmyadharmādau pravṛttidarśanāt| tatra kṣaṇikasukhakālīnaduḥkhābhāvasya puruṣārthatve tadarthaṃ bahukāladuḥkhānubhavāyogāt| na ca tatra kṣaṇikasukhasya puruṣārthatve'pi doṣataulyam|
analyzed: na ca duḥkha abhāvaḥ eva svatas puruṣa arthaḥ tad śeṣatayā sukham kāmyam iti vaiparītya āpattiḥ bahu kāla duḥkha sādhye api kṣaṇika sukha janake nindita grāmyadharma ādau pravṛtti darśanāt tatra kṣaṇika sukha kālīna duḥkha abhāvasya puruṣa artha tve tad artham bahu kāla duḥkha anubhava ayogāt na ca tatra kṣaṇika sukhasya puruṣa artha tve pi doṣa taulyam

original: bhāvarūpe sukhe utkarṣapakarṣayoranubhavasiddhatvena kṣaṇamapyatyutkṛṣṭasukhārthaṃ bahukāladuḥkhānubhavopapatteḥ| duḥkhābhāve cotkarṣāpakarṣāsambhavāt| tasmānmuktau saṃsāraduḥkhanivṛttirapyavidyānivṛttivat sukhaśeṣa ityanavacchinnānandaprāptireva svataḥpuruṣārtha ityāhuḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: bhāva rūpe sukhe utkarṣa pakarṣayoḥ anubhava siddha tvena kṣaṇam api ati utkṛṣṭa sukha artham bahu kāla duḥkha anubhava upapatteḥ duḥkha abhāve ca utkarṣa apakarṣa asambhavāt tasmāt muktau saṃsāra duḥkha nivṛttiḥ api avidyā nivṛtti vat sukha śeṣaḥ iti anavacchinna ānanda prāptiḥ eva svatas puruṣa arthaḥ iti āhuḥ 30

original: anye tu saṃsāradaśāyāṃ `nāsti na prakāśate' iti vyavahārayogyatvarūpājñānāvaraṇaprayuktasya `mama niratiśayānando nāsti' iti pratyayasya sarvāsiddhatvāt tadālambanabhūtaḥ kaścid brahmānandasyābhāvaḥ kālpaniko yāvadavidyamanuvartate|
analyzed: anye tu saṃsāra daśāyām na asti na prakāśate iti vyavahāra yogya tva rūpa ajñāna āvaraṇa prayuktasya mama niratiśaya ānandaḥ na asti iti pratyayasya sarva asiddha tvāt tad ālambana bhūtaḥ kaścid brahma ānandasya abhāvaḥ kālpanikaḥ yāvat avidyam anuvartate

original: apare tu avedyasyāpuruṣārthatvātsaṃsāradaśāyāṃ sadapyanavacchinnasukhamāparokṣyābhāvānna puruṣārthaḥ| na ca svarūpajñānenāparokṣyaṃ tadā'pyasti, tasya sarvadā svarūpasukhābhinnatvāt| vṛttijñānenāparokṣyaṃ tu na muktāvapīti vācyam| na hi svavyavahārānukūlacaitanyābhedamātramāparokṣyam|
analyzed: apare tu avedyasya a puruṣārtha tvāt saṃsāra daśāyām sat api anavacchinna sukham āparokṣya abhāvāt na puruṣa arthaḥ na ca svarūpa jñānena āparokṣyam tadā api asti tasya sarvadā svarūpa sukha abhinna tvāt vṛtti jñānena āparokṣyam tu na muktau api iti vācyam na hi sva vyavahāra anukūla caitanya abheda mātram āparokṣyam

original: ghaṭāvacchinnacaitanyābhivyaktau tadabhinnasya ghaṭagandhasyāpi āparokṣyāpatteḥ| kiṃ tvanāvṛtārthasya tadabhedaḥ. tathā cānāvṛtatvāṃśastattvasākṣātkāre satyeveti niratiśayasukhāparokṣyasya puruṣārthasya vidyāprāpyatvaṃ yuktamityāhuḥ||
analyzed: ghaṭa avacchinna caitanya abhivyaktau tad abhinnasya ghaṭa gandhasya api āparokṣya āpatteḥ kim tu anāvṛta arthasya tad abhedaḥ tathā ca anāvṛta tva aṃśaḥ tattva sākṣātkāre sati eva iti niratiśaya sukha aparokṣyasya puruṣa arthasya vidyā prāpya tvam yuktam iti āhuḥ

original: itare tu astu vyavahārānukūlacaitanyābhedamātramāparokṣyam| tathā'pyajñānamahimnā jīvabhedavaccidānandabhedo'pi adhayasta iti saṃsāradaśāyāṃ puruṣāntarasya puruṣāntaracaitanyāparokṣyavad anavacchinnasukhāparokṣyamapi nāsti| ajñānanivṛttau tu cidānandabhedupravilayāttadāparokṣyamiti tasya vidyāsādhyatvamityāhuḥ||4||
analyzed: itare tu astu vyavahāra anukūla caitanya abheda mātram āparokṣyam tathā api ajñāna mahimnā jīva bheda vat cidānanda bhedaḥ upi adhayaḥ te iti saṃsāra daśāyām puruṣa antarasya puruṣa antara caitanya aparokṣya vat anavacchinna sukha aparokṣyam api nā asti ajñāna nivṛttau tu cidānanda bhedu pravilayāt tad āparokṣyam iti tasya vidyā sādhya tvam iti āhuḥ

original: atha vidyodaye satyupādhivilayādapetajīvabhāvasya kim īśvarabhāvāpattirbhavati, uta śuddhacaitanyamātrarūpeṇāvasthānam? iti vivecanīyam| ucyate
analyzed: atha vidyā udaye sati upādhi vilayāt apeta jīva bhāvasya kim īśvara bhāva āpattiḥ bhavati uta śuddha caitanya mātra rūpeṇa avasthānam iti vivecanīyam ucyate

original: ekajīvavāde tadekājñānakalpitasya jīveśvaravibhāgādikṛtsnabhedaprapañcasya tadvidyodayo vilayānnirviśeṣacaitanyarūpeṇaivāvasthānam|
analyzed: eka jīva vāde tad eka ajñāna kalpitasya jīva īśvara vibhāga ādi kṛtsna bheda prapañcasya tad vidyā udayaḥ vilayāt nirviśeṣa caitanya rūpeṇa eva avasthānam

original: anekajīvavādamabhyupagamya baddhabhuktavyavasthā'ṅgīkāre'pi yadyapi kasyacidvidyodaye tadavidyākṛtaprapañca'nuvartate, tathā'pi `jīva iveśvaro'pi pratibimbaviśeṣaḥ' itipakṣe muktasya bimbabhūtaśuddhacaitanyarūpeṇaivāvasthānam|
analyzed: aneka jīva vādam abhyupagamya baddha bhukta vyavasthā aṅgīkāre pi yadi api kasyacid vidyā udaye tad avidyā kṛta prapañcaḥ anuvartate tathā api jīvaḥ iva īśvaraḥ api pratibimba viśeṣaḥ iti pakṣe muktasya bimba bhūta śuddha caitanya rūpeṇa eva avasthānam

original: anekopādhiṣvekasya pratibimbesati ekopādhivilaye tatpratibimbasya bimbabhāvenaivāvasthānaucityena pratibimbāntaratvāpatterapi durvāratvenāvacchedapakṣa iva muktasya punarbandhāpatteḥ| ata evānekajīvavāde avacchedapakṣo nādriyate| yadavacchedena muktistadavacchedenāntaḥkaraṇāntarasaṃsarge punarapi bandhāpatteḥ|
analyzed: aneka upādhiṣu ekasya pratibimbe sati eka upādhi vilaye tad pratibimbasya bimba bhāvena eva avasthāna aucityena pratibimba antara tva āpatteḥ api durvāra tvena avaccheda pakṣe iva muktasya punar bandha āpatteḥ atas eva aneka jīva vāde avaccheda pakṣaḥ nā ādriyate yad avacchedena muktiḥ tad avacchedena antaḥkaraṇa antara saṃsarge punar api bandha āpatteḥ

original: `pratibimbo jīvaḥ, bimbasthānīya īśvaraḥ, ubhayānusyūtaṃ śuddhacaitanyam' iti pakṣe tu muktasya yāvatsarvamukti sarvajñatvasarvakartṛtvasarveśvaratvasatyakāmatvādiguṇaparameśvarabhāvāpattiriṣyate|
analyzed: pratibimbaḥ jīvaḥ bimba sthānīyaḥ īśvaraḥ ubhaya anusyūtam śuddha caitanyam iti pakṣe tu muktasya yāvatsarvamukti sarvajñatva sarva kartṛ tva sarva īśvara tva satyakāma tva ādi guṇa parameśvara bhāva āpattiḥ iṣyate

original: yathā anekeṣu darpaṇeṣu ekasya mukhasya pratibimbe sati ekadarpaṇāpanaye tatpratibimbo bimbabhāvenāvatiṣṭhate, na tu mukhamātrarūpeṇa, tadānīmapi darpaṇāntarasannidhānaprayuktasya mukhe bimbatvasyānapāyāt, tathaikasya brahmacaitanyasyānekeṣūpādhiṣu pratibimbe sati e smin pratibimbe vidyodaye tena tadupādhivilaye tatpratibimbasya
analyzed: yathā anekeṣu darpaṇeṣu ekasya mukhasya pratibimbe sati eka darpaṇa apanaye tad pratibimbaḥ bimba bhāvena avatiṣṭhate na tu mukha mātra rūpeṇa tadānīm api darpaṇa antara sannidhāna prayuktasya mukhe bimba tvasya anapāyāt tathā ekasya brahma caitanyasya anekeṣu upādhiṣu pratibimbe sati smin pratibimbe vidyā udaye tena tad upādhi vilaye tad pratibimbasya

original: bimbabhāvenāvasthānāvaśyambhāvāt| na ca muktasyāvidyā'bhāvāt satyakāmatvādiguṇaviśiṣṭasarveśvaratvānupapattiḥ| tadavidyā'bhāve'pi tadānīṃ baddhapuruṣāntarāvidyāsattvāt| na hīśvarasyeśvaratvaṃ satyakāmādiguṇavaiśiṣṭyaṃ ca svāvidyākṛtam, tasya nirañjanatvāt, kiṃ tu baddhapuruṣāvidyākṛtameva tatsarvameṣṭavyam|
analyzed: bimba bhāvena avasthāna avaśyambhāvāt na ca muktasya avidyā bhāvāt satya kāma tva ādi guṇa viśiṣṭa sarva īśvara tva anupapattiḥ tad avidyā bhāve pi tadānīm baddha puruṣa antara avidyā sattvāt na hi īśvarasya īśvara tvam satya kāma ādi guṇa vaiśiṣṭyam ca sva avidyā kṛtam tasya nirañjana tvāt kim tu baddha puruṣa avidyā kṛtam eva tat sarvam eṣṭavyam

original: na ca "yathākraturasmin loke puruṣo bhavati tathetaḥ pretya bhavati" "taṃ yathāyathopāsate" ityādiśrutiṣu saguṇopāsakānāmapīśvarasāyujyaśravaṇād mukteḥ saguṇavidyāphalāviśeṣapattiḥ| saguṇopāsakānāmakhaṇḍasākṣātkārābhāvād nāvidyānivṛttiḥ, na vā tanmūlāhaṅkārādervilayaḥ| āvaraṇānivṛtternākhaṇḍānandasphuraṇam|
analyzed: na ca yathākratuḥ asmin loke puruṣaḥ bhavati tathā itas pretya bhavati tam yathā yathā upāsate ityādi śrutiṣu saguṇa upāsakānām api īśvara sāyujya śravaṇāt mukteḥ saguṇa vidyā phala aviśeṣa pattiḥ saguṇa upāsakānām akhaṇḍa sākṣātkāra abhāvāt na avidyā nivṛttiḥ na vā tad mūla ahaṅkāra ādeḥ vilayaḥ āvaraṇa anivṛtteḥ na akhaṇḍa ānanda sphuraṇam

original: `jagadvyāpāravarjaṃ prakaraṇādasannihitatvācca' `bhogamātrasamyāliṅgācca' ityādisūtroktanyāyena teṣāṃ parameśvareṇa bhogasamye'pi saṅkalpamātrāt svabhogopayuktadivyadehendriyavanitādisṛṣṭisāmarthye'pi sakalajagatsṛṣṭisaṃhārādisvātantryalakṣaṇaṃ na niravagrahamaiśvaryam|
analyzed: jagat vyāpāra varjam prakaraṇāt asannihita tvāt ca bhogamātra samyā liṅgāt ca ityādi sūtra ukta nyāyena teṣām parameśvareṇa bhoga samye pi saṅkalpa mātrāt sva bhoga upayukta divya deha indriya vanitā ādi sṛṣṭi sāmarthye pi sakala jagat sṛṣṭi saṃhāra ādi svātantrya lakṣaṇam na niravagraham aiśvaryam

original: muktānāṃ tu nissādhibandhamīśvarabhāvaṃ prāptānāṃ tatsarvamiti mahato viśeṣasya sadbhāvāt| na ca parameśvarasya raghunāthādyavatāre tamasvitvaduḥkhasaṃsargādiśravaṇād muktānāmīśvarabhāve punarbandhāpattiḥ| tasya vipraśāpāmoghatvādisvakṛtamaryādāparipālanāya kathaṃcid bhṛguśāpādisatyatvaṃ pratyāyayituṃ naṭavadīśvarasya tadabhinayamātraparatvāt|
analyzed: muktānām tu nissādhi bandham īśvara bhāvam prāptānām tat sarvam iti mahataḥ viśeṣasya sadbhāvāt na ca parameśvarasya raghunātha ādi avatāre tamasvi tva duḥkha saṃsarga ādi śravaṇāt muktānām īśvara bhāve punar bandha āpattiḥ tasya vipra śāpa amogha tva ādi sva kṛta maryādā paripālanāya kathaṃcid bhṛgu śāpa ādi satya tvam pratyāyayitum naṭa vat īśvarasya tad abhinaya mātra paratvāt

original: anyathā tasya nityamuktatvaniravagrahasvātantryasamābhyadhikarāhityādiśrutivirodhāt| tasmādyāvatsarvamukti parameśvarabhāvo muktasyeti bimbeśvarabhāve na kaściddoṣaḥ||
analyzed: anyathā tasya nitya mukta tva niravagraha svātantrya sama abhyadhika rāhitya ādi śruti virodhāt tasmāt yāvatsarvamukti parameśvara bhāvaḥ muktasya iti bimbeśvara bhāve na kaścid doṣaḥ

original: ayameva pakṣaḥ śrutisūtrabhāṣyādyanuguṇaḥ| tathā hi samanvayādhyāye tāvad "dahara uttarebhyaḥ" ityādhikaraṇe "atha yadidamasmin brahmapure daharaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ veśma daharo'smin antarākāśaḥ" ityādiśrutinirdiṣṭo daharākāśo na bhūtākāśa, nāpi jīvaḥ, kiṃ tu parameśvaraḥ, uttarebhyo vākyaśeṣebhyaḥ|
analyzed: ayam eva pakṣaḥ śruti sūtra bhāṣya ādi anuguṇaḥ tathā hi samanvaya adhyāye tāvat daharaḥ uttarebhyaḥ ityā adhikaraṇe atha yat idam asmin brahmapure daharam puṇḍarīkam veśma daharaḥ asmin antarākāśaḥ ityādi śruti nirdiṣṭaḥ daharākāśaḥ na bhūtākāśa na api jīvaḥ kim tu parameśvaraḥ uttarebhyaḥ vākyaśeṣebhyaḥ

original: "ubhe asmin dyāvāpṛthivī antareva samāhite yāvānvā ayamākāśastāvāneṣo'ntarhṛdaya ākāśa eṣa ātmā'pahatapāpmā vijaro vimṛtyurviśoko vijighatso'pipāsaḥ satyakāmaḥ satyasaṅkalpaḥ" ityādinā pratipādyamānebhyo dyāvāpṛthivyādyādhāratvalakṣaṇaguṇebhyo hetubhya iti nirṇīya `uttarāccedāvirbhūtasvarūpastu' itisūtrāntareṇa
analyzed: ubhe asmin dyāvāpṛthivī antar eva samāhite yāvān vai ayam ākāśaḥ tāvān eṣaḥ antar hṛdaye ākāśaḥ eṣaḥ ātmā apahata pāpmā vijaraḥ vimṛtyuḥ viśokaḥ vijighatsaḥ pipāsaḥ satya kāmaḥ satya saṅkalpaḥ ityādinā pratipādyamānebhyaḥ dyāvāpṛthivī ādi ādhāra tva lakṣaṇa guṇebhyaḥ hetubhyaḥ iti nirṇīya uttarāt ced āvirbhūta svarūpaḥ tu iti sūtra antareṇa

original: daharavidyānantaramindraprajāpatisaṃvāde "ya ātmā'pahataprāpmā" ityādinā apahatapāpmatvādiguṇāṣṭakayuktamātmānamupadeśyamupakṣipya "ya eṣo'kṣiṇi puruṣo dṛśyate eṣa ātmā"iti jāgradavasthāyāṃ draṣṭṛtvenākṣisannihitasya "ya eṣa svapne mahīyamānaścarati eṣa ātmā" iti svapnāvasthāpannasya "tadyatraitatsuptassamastassamprasannaḥ svapnaṃ na vijānāti eṣa
analyzed: dahara vidyā anantaram indra prajāpati saṃvāde yaḥ ātmā apahata prāpmā ityādinā apahata pāpma tva ādi guṇa aṣṭaka yuktam ātmānam upadeśyam upakṣipya yaḥ eṣa ukṣiṇi puruṣaḥ dṛśyate eṣaḥ ātmā iti jāgrat avasthāyām draṣṭṛ tvena akṣi sannihitasya yaḥ eṣa svapne mahīyamānaḥ carati eṣaḥ ātmā iti svapna avasthā āpannasya tat yatra etat suptaḥ samastaḥ samprasannaḥ svapnam na vijānāti eṣa etat suptaḥ samastaḥ samprasannaḥ svap

original: ātmā" iti suṣupabtyavasthāpannasya "eṣa samprasādo'smāccharīrāt samutthāya paraṃ jyotirupasampadya svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate sa uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ" ityavasthātrayottīrṇasya ca jīvasyopadeśāj jīve'pyasti apahatapāpmatvādiguṇāṣṭakamiti na taddaharākāśasya parameśvaratvanirṇāyakam|
analyzed: ātmā iti suṣupa bti avasthā āpannasya eṣa samprasādaḥ usmāt śarīrāt samutthāya param jyotiḥ upasampadya svena rūpeṇa abhiniṣpadyate saḥ uttamaḥ puruṣaḥ iti avasthā traya uttīrṇasya ca jīvasya upadeśāt jīve pi asti apahata pāpma tva ādi guṇa aṣṭakam iti na tat daharākāśasya parameśvara tva nirṇāyakam

original: "ya eṣa svapne" ityādiparyāyeṣu pratiparyāyam "etaṃ tveva te bhūyo'nuvyākhyāsyāmi" iti śravaṇena sphuṭasvapnādijīvaliṅgānāṃ dvitīyādiparyāyaṇāmeva jīvaviṣayatvam, prathamaparyāyasya ca brahmaviṣayatvamiti codyānavakāśādityāśaṅkya tatra caturthaparyāye nirūpyamāṇaḥ sakalabandhavinirmuktatvenāvirbhūtasvarūpo jīvaḥ pratipādyaḥ|
analyzed: yaḥ eṣa svapne ityādi paryāyeṣu prati paryāyam etam tu eva te bhūyas anuvyākhyāsyāmi iti śravaṇena sphuṭa svapna ādi jīva liṅgānām dvitīya ādi paryāyaṇām eva jīva viṣaya tvam prathama paryāyasya ca brahma viṣaya tvam iti codya an avakāśāt iti āśaṅkya tatra caturtha paryāye nirūpyamāṇaḥ sakala bandha vinirmukta tvena āvirbhūta svarūpaḥ jīvaḥ pratipādyaḥ

original: na tu saṃsārikāvasthābhedakaluṣitaḥ| tatra satyasaṅkalpatvādiguṇabādhāt| avasthātrayopanyāsasya tattadavasthādoṣābhidhānena caturthaparyāyopadeśaśoṣatvapratipatteriti samādadhānaḥ sūtrakāraścaturthaparyāye pratipādyasya muktasyeśvarabhāvāpattiṃ spaṣṭamāha|
analyzed: na tu saṃsārika avasthā bheda kaluṣitaḥ tatra satya saṅkalpa tva ādi guṇa bādhāt avasthā traya upanyāsasya tad tad avasthā doṣa abhidhānena caturtha paryāya upadeśa śoṣa tva pratipatteḥ iti samādadhānaḥ sūtrakāraḥ caturtha paryāye pratipādyasya muktasya īśvara bhāva āpattim spaṣṭam āha

original: tadabhāve mukte'pi satyasaṅkalpatvādyayogād anukrāntasya guṇāṣṭakasya īśvarādanyatrāpi bhāve kṛtaśaṅkāparihārālābhācca|
analyzed: tad abhāve muktaḥ ipi satya saṅkalpa tva ādi ayogāt anukrāntasya guṇa aṣṭakasya īśvarāt anyatra api bhāve kṛta śaṅkā parihāra alābhāt ca

original: tasmin sūtre `tasmādavidyāpratyupasthāpitamapāramārthikaṃ jaivaṃ rūpaṃ kartṛtvabhoktṛtvarāgadveṣādidoṣakaluṣitamanekānarthayogi tadvilayanena tādviparītamapahatapāpmatvādiguṇakaṃ pārameśvaraṃ rūpaṃ vidyayā pratipadyate' iti bhāṣyakāro'pyatispaṣṭaṃ muktasya saguṇeśvarabhāvāpattimāha|
analyzed: tasmin sūtre tasmāt avidyā pratyupasthāpitam apāramārthikam jaivam rūpam kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tva rāga dveṣa ādi doṣa kaluṣitam aneka anartha yogi tad vilayanena tād viparītam apahata pāpma tva ādi guṇakam pārameśvaram rūpam vidyayā pratipadyate iti bhāṣyakāraḥ upi ati spaṣṭam muktasya saguṇa īśvara bhāva āpattim āha

original: avirodhādhyāye'pi "eṣa hyeva sādhu karma kārayati taṃ yamebhyo lokebhya unninīṣata eṣa u evāsādhu karma kārayati taṃ yamadho ninīṣate" ityādiśrutestattatkarmakartṛtvena tattatkarmakārayitṛtvena ca upakāryopakārakabhāvenāvagatayorjīveśvarayoraṃśāṃśibhāvarūpasambandhanirūpaṇārthatvenāvatārite `aṃśo nānāvyapadeśāt' ityadhikaraṇe
analyzed: avirodha adhyāye api eṣa hi eva sādhu karma kārayati tam yam ebhyaḥ lokebhyaḥ unninīṣate eṣaḥ u eva asādhu karma kārayati tam yam adhas ninīṣate ityādi śruteḥ tad tad karma kartṛ tvena tad tad karma kārayitṛ tvena ca upakārya upakāraka bhāvena avagatayoḥ jīva īśvarayoḥ aṃśa aṃśi bhāva rūpa sambandha nirūpaṇa artha tvena avatārite aṃśaḥ nānā vyapadeśāt iti adhikaraṇe

original: `jīvasyeśvarāṃśatvābhyupagame tadīyena saṃsāraduḥkhabhogena īśvarasyāpi duḥkhitvaṃ syāt| yathā loke hastapādādyanyatamāṃśagatena duḥkhenāṃśino devadattasyāpi duḥkhitvaṃ, tadvat| tataśca tatprāptānāṃ mahattaraṃ duḥkha prāpnuyāt, tato varaṃ pṛrvāvasthā saṃsāra evāstviti samyag jñānānarthakyaprasaṅgaḥ' iti śaṅkāgranthena bhāmatyādiṣu spaṣṭīkṛtam|
analyzed: jīvasya īśvara aṃśa tva abhyupagame tadīyena saṃsāra duḥkha bhogena īśvarasya api duḥkhi tvam syāt yathā loke hasta pāda ādi anyatama aṃśa gatena duḥkhena aṃśinaḥ devadattasya api duḥkhi tvam tadvat tatas ca tad prāptānām mahattaram duḥkha prāpnuyāt tatas varam pṛrva avasthā saṃsāraḥ eva astu iti samyak jñāna ānarthakya prasaṅgaḥ iti śaṅkā granthena bhāmatī ādiṣu spaṣṭīkṛtam

original: bimbapratibimbabhāvakṛtāsaṅkaramupādāya samāhitena bhāṣyakāro muktasya īśvarabhāvāpattiṃ spaṣṭīcakāra|
analyzed: bimba pratibimba bhāva kṛta asaṅkaram upādāya samāhitena bhāṣyakāraḥ muktasya īśvara bhāva āpattim spaṣṭīcakāra

original: sādhanādhyāye'pi `sandhye sṛṣṭirāha hi' ityadhikaraṇe svapnaprapañcasya mithyātve vyavasthāpite tatra mithyābhūte svapnaprapañce jīvasya kartṛtvamāśaṅkya `parābhidhyānāttu tirohitaṃ tato hyasya bandhaviparyayau' itisūtreṇa `jīvasyeśvarābhinnatvāt sadapi satyasaṅkalpatvādikamavidyādoṣāttirohitamiti na tasya svapnaprapañce sraṣṭṭatvaṃ sambhavati'
analyzed: sādhana adhyāye api sandhye sṛṣṭiḥ āha hi iti adhikaraṇe svapna prapañcasya mithyātve vyavasthāpite tatra mithyābhūte svapna prapañce jīvasya kartṛ tvam āśaṅkya para abhidhyānāt tu tirohitam tatas hi asya bandha viparyayau iti sūtreṇa jīvasya īśvara abhinna tvāt sat api satya saṅkalpa tva ādikam avidyā doṣāt tirohitam iti na tasya svapna prapañce sraṣṭṛ tvam sambhavati

original: iti vadan sūtrakāraḥ `tatpunastirohitaṃ sat paramabhidhyāyato yatamānasya jantorvidhūtadhvāntasya timiratiraskṛteva dṛkchaktirauṣadhaviryādīśvaraprasādātsaṃsiddhasya kasyacidevāvirbhavati, na svabhāvata eva sarveṣāṃ jantūnām' iti tatsūtrābhiprāyaṃ varṇayan bhāṣyakāraśca muktasya svapnasṛṣṭyādyupayogisatyasaṅkalpatvādyabhivyaktyaṅgīkāreṇa
analyzed: iti vadan sūtrakāraḥ tat punar tirohitam sat param abhidhyāyataḥ yatamānasya jantoḥ vidhūta dhvāntasya timira tiraskṛtā iva dṛkchaktiḥ auṣadha viryāt īśvara prasādāt saṃsiddhasya kasyacid eva āvirbhavati na svabhāvataḥ eva sarveṣām jantūnām iti tad sūtra abhiprāyam varṇayan bhāṣyakāraḥ ca muktasya svapna sṛṣṭi ādi upayogi satya saṅkalpa tva ādi abhivyakti aṅgīkāreṇa

original: parameśvarabhāvāpattiṃ spaṣṭīcakāra|
analyzed: parameśvara bhāva āpattim spaṣṭīcakāra

original: phalādhyāye'pi "svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate" iti mucyamānaviṣayāyāṃ śrutau `kena rūpeṇābhiniṣpattirvivakṣitā' iti bubhutsāyā `brāhmeṇa jaiminirupanyāsādibhyaḥ' itisūtreṇa brāhmaṃ rūpamapahatapāpmatvādi satyasaṅkalpatvādyavasānaṃ sarvajñatvasarveśvaratvādi ca, tenābhiniṣpattiḥ "ya ātmā'pahatapāpmā" ityādyupanyāsena "sa tatra paryeti jakṣan krīḍan
analyzed: phala adhyāye api svena rūpeṇa abhiniṣpadyate iti mucyamāna viṣayāyām śrutau kena rūpeṇa abhiniṣpattiḥ vivakṣitā iti bubhutsāyāḥ brāhmeṇa jaiminiḥ upanyāsa ādibhyaḥ iti sūtreṇa brāhmam rūpam apahata pāpma tva ādi satya saṅkalpa tva ādi avasānam sarvajña tva sarva īśvara tva ādi ca tena abhiniṣpattiḥ yaḥ ātmā apahata pāpmā ityādi upanyāsena sa tatra paryeti jakṣan krīḍan

original: ramamāṇaḥ strībhirvā yānairvā" ityādyaiśvaryāvedanena ceti jaiminimatam| `cititanmātreṇa tadātmakatvādityauḍḍalomiḥ' ityanantarasūtreṇa "evaṃ vā are'yamātmā'nantaro'bāhyaḥ kṛtsnaḥ prajñānaghana eva" ityādiśrutyā `caitanyamātramātmasvarūpam' ityavagateḥ `tanmātreṇābhiniṣpattiḥ'iti matāntaraṃ copanyasya `evamapyupanyāsātpūrvabhāvādavirodhaṃ
analyzed: ramamāṇaḥ strībhiḥ vā yānaiḥ vā ityādi aiśvarya āvedanena ca iti jaimini matam citi tanmātreṇa tad ātmaka tvāt iti auḍḍalomiḥ iti anantara sūtreṇa evam vai areyam ātmā anantaraḥ bāhyaḥ kṛtsnaḥ prajñāna ghanaḥ eva ityādi śrutyā caitanya mātram ātma svarūpam iti avagateḥ tanmātreṇa abhiniṣpattiḥ iti mata antaram ca upanyasya evam api upanyāsāt pūrva bhāvāt avirodham

original: bādarāyaṇaḥ' iti siddhāntasūtreṇa `vastudṛṣṭyācaitanyamātratve'pi pūrvoktaguṇakalāpasya upanyāsādyavagatasya māyāmayasya baddapuruṣavyavahāradṛṣṭyā sambhavāda na śrutidvayavirodhaḥ' iti avirodhaṃ vadan sūtrakāraḥ, sūtratrayamidamuktārthaparatvena vyākurvan bhāṣyakāraśca muktasyeśvarabhāvāpattiṃ spaṣṭamanumene|
analyzed: bādarāyaṇaḥ iti siddhānta sūtreṇa vastu dṛṣṭyā caitanya mātra tve pi pūrvokta guṇa kalāpasya upanyāsa ādi avagatasya māyā mayasya badda puruṣa vyavahāra dṛṣṭyā na śruti dvaya virodhaḥ iti avirodham vadan sūtrakāraḥ sūtra trayam idam ukta artha paratvena vyākurvan bhāṣyakāraḥ ca muktasya īśvara bhāva āpattim spaṣṭam anumene

original: bhābhatīnibandhaprabhṛtayaśca śrutyupabṛṃhitamidaṃ sūtrajātaṃ, bhagavato bhāṣyakārasya udāhṛtaṃ vacanajātaṃ ca tathaivānvavartanta| na ca śrutyupabṛṃhitasya etāvataḥ sūtrabhāṣyavacanajātasya
analyzed: bhābhatī nibandha prabhṛtayaḥ ca śruti upabṛṃhitam idam sūtra jātam bhagavataḥ bhāṣyakārasya udāhṛtam vacana jātam ca tathā eva anvavartanta na ca śruti upabṛṃhitasya etāvataḥ sūtra bhāṣya vacana jātasya

original: aiśvaryamajñānatirohitaṃ sad dhyānādabhivyajyata ityavocat||
analyzed: aiśvaryam ajñāna tirohitam sat dhyānāt abhivyajyate iti avocat

original: śarīriṇaḥ sūtrakṛdasya yattu tadabhyupetyoditamuktahetoḥ|| iti saṃkṣepaśārīrakoktarītyā'bhyupetyavādatvaṃ yuktaṃ vaktum|
analyzed: śarīriṇaḥ sūtrakṛt asya yat tu tat abhyupetya uditam ukta hetoḥ iti saṃkṣepaśārīraka ukta rītyā abhyupetyavāda tvam yuktam vaktum

original: tasmānmuktānāmīśvaramāvāpatteravaśyābhyupeyatvādetadasambhava eva pratibimbeśvaravāde doṣaḥ| tadāhuḥ kalpatarukārāḥ `na māyāpratibimbasakya vimuktairupasṛpyatā' iti| etadasambhavaśca ekajīvavādapāramārthikajīvabhedavādayorapi doṣaḥ|
analyzed: tasmāt muktānām īśvara māva āpatteḥ avaśya abhyupeya tvāt etad asambhavaḥ eva pratibimba īśvara vāde doṣaḥ tat āhuḥ kalpataru kārāḥ na māyā pratibimba sakya vimuktaiḥ upasṛpyatā iti etad asambhavaḥ ca eka jīva vāda pāramārthika jīva bheda vādayoḥ api doṣaḥ

original: yattu kaiścit dvaitibhirucyate bhedasya pāramārthikatvena muktau jīvasyeśvarabhāvābhāve'pi tatrāpīśvara iva pṛthagapahatapāpmatvādiguṇasambhavādavirodha iti| tattuccham| tathā sati jīvasyāpahatapāpmatvādikamastīti na tasya brahmaliṅgatvamiti śaṅkāparihārālābhena `uttarāccedāvirbhūtasvarūpastu'iti sūtravirodhāt|
analyzed: yat tu kaiścid dvaitibhiḥ ucyate bhedasya pāramārthika tvena muktau jīvasya īśvara bhāva abhāve pi tatra api īśvaraḥ iva pṛthak apahatapāpmatva ādi guṇa sambhavāt avirodhaḥ iti tat tuccham tathā sati jīvasya apahatapāpmatva ādikam asti iti na tasya brahma liṅga tvam iti śaṅkā parihāra alābhena uttarāt ced āvirbhūta svarūpaḥ tu iti sūtra virodhāt

original: `brāhmeṇa jaiminiḥ' itisūtre jīvagatasyāpahatapāpmatvādeḥ `upanyāsādhibhyaḥ'ityātrādiśabdārthatvena pareṣāmapyabhimatasya "jakṣan krīḍan ramamāṇaḥ"ityādiśrutyuditasya jakṣaṇādeśca brāhmatvanirdeśavirodhācca|
analyzed: brāhmeṇa jaiminiḥ iti sūtre jīva gatasya apahatapāpma tva ādeḥ upanyāsa ādhibhyaḥ iti ātra ādi śabda artha tvena pareṣām api abhimatasya jakṣan krīḍan ramamāṇaḥ ityādi śruti uditasya jakṣaṇa ādeḥ ca brāhma tva nirdeśa virodhāt ca

original: bhede teṣāṃ guṇānāṃ satyatvena `cititanmātreṇa'itisūtroktasya muktajīvānāṃ caitanyamātratvasya `evamapi' iti siddhāntasūtre'ṅgīkāravirodhācca, `sampadyāvirbhāvaḥ' ityadhikaraṇavirodhācca| tatra hi `svena rūpeṇābhiniṣpadyate', iti śrutau āgantunā kenacidrūpeṇābhiniṣpattirnocyate svenaśabdavaiyarthyāpatteḥ|
analyzed: bhede teṣām guṇānām satya tvena citi tanmātreṇa eti sūtra uktasya mukta jīvānām caitanya mātra tvasya evam api iti siddhānta sūtra iṅgīkāra virodhāt ca sampadi āvirbhāvaḥ iti adhikaraṇa virodhāt ca tatra hi svena rūpeṇa abhiniṣpadyate iti śrutau āgantunā kenacid rūpeṇa abhiniṣpattiḥ na ucyate svena śabda vaiyarthya āpatteḥ

original: yena rūpeṇa āgantunā svayamabhiniṣyadyate tasyātmīyatvasyāvaktavyatvāt| tasmādātmavācisvaśabdopādānāda nityasiddhena svasvarūpeṇaivābhiniṣpattirvivakṣitā, na tu kena ciddharmeṇeti vyavasthāpitam|
analyzed: yena rūpeṇa āgantunā svayam abhiniṣyadyate tasya ātmīya tvasya avaktavya tvāt tasmāt ātma vāci sva śabda upādānāt a nitya siddhena sva svarūpeṇa eva abhiniṣpattiḥ vivakṣitā na tu kena cit dharmeṇa iti vyavasthāpitam

original: kiñcedamapahatapāpmatvādi jāvasya muktāvāgantukaṃ cet, `sampadyāvirbhāvaḥ' iti muktāvāgantukarūpaniṣedhena `parābhidhyānāttu tirohitam' `uttarāccedāvirbhūtasvarūpastu' ityapahatapāpmatvāderbandhamuktyostirobhāvāvirbhāvapratipādanena ca virodhaḥ syāditi nityasiddhaṃ vācyamiti bandhasya mithyātvaṃ durvāram|
analyzed: kiñca idam apahatapāpma tva ādi jāvasya muktau āgantukam ced sampadi āvirbhāvaḥ iti muktau āgantuka rūpa niṣedhena para abhidhyānāt tu tirohitam uttarāt ced āvirbhūta svarūpaḥ tu iti apahatapāpma tva ādeḥ bandha muktyoḥ tirobhāva āvirbhāva pratipādanena ca virodhaḥ syāt iti nitya siddham vācyam iti bandhasya mithyātvam durvāram

original: nityasiddhamapahatapāpmatvaṃ hi sarvadā pāpmarahitatvam| na ca vastutaḥ sarvadā pāpmarahite pāpmasambandhaḥ, tanmūlakakartṛtva bhoktṛtvasambandho vā pāramārthikaḥ sambhavati| evaṃ ca jīvasyeśvarābhedo'pi durvāraḥ| śrutibodhyatadabhedavirodhibandhasya satyatvābhāvāt| anyathā saṃsāriṇi nityāsigaddhasatyasaṅkalpatirodhānoktyayogācca|
analyzed: nitya siddham apahata pāpma tvam hi sarvadā pāpma rahita tvam na ca vastutas sarvadā pāpma rahite pāpma sambandhaḥ tad mūlaka kartṛ tva bhoktṛ tva sambandhaḥ vā pāramārthikaḥ sambhavati evam ca jīvasya īśvara abhedaḥ api durvāraḥ śruti bodhya tad abheda virodhi bandhasya satya tva abhāvāt anyathā saṃsāriṇi nitya asi gaddha satya saṅkalpa tirodhāna ukti ayogāt ca

original: na hi jāvasya saṃsāradaśāyāmanuvartamāno yatkiñcidarthagocaraḥ kaścidastyavitathasaṃkalpastirohi ta iti parairapīṣyate| kiṃ tvīśvarasya yannityasiddhaṃ niravagrahaṃ satyasaṅkalpatvam, tadeva jīvasya saṃsāradaśāyāmīśvarābhedanabhivyaktyā svakīyatvenānavabhāsamānaṃ taṃ prati tirohitamityeva samarthanīyamiti ghaṭṭakuṭīprabhātavṛttāntaḥ|
analyzed: na hi jāvasya saṃsāra daśāyām anuvartamānaḥ yat kiñcid artha gocaraḥ kaścid asti avitatha saṃkalpaḥ tirohi te iti paraiḥ api iṣyate kim tu īśvarasya yat nitya siddham niravagraham satya saṅkalpa tvam tat eva jīvasya saṃsāra daśāyām īśvara abheda anabhivyaktyā svakīya tvena anavabhāsamānam tam prati tirohitam iti eva samarthanīyam iti ghaṭṭa kuṭī prabhāta vṛttāntaḥ

original: nanvapahatapāpmatvaṃ na pāpmavirahaḥ kiṃ tu pāpmahetukarmācaraṇe'pi pāpotpattipratibandhakaśaktiyogitvami na tasya nityasiddhatvena bandhasya mithyātvaprasaṅgaḥ| evaṃ satyasaṅkalpatvamapi śaktirūpeṇa nirvācyamiti neśvarābhedaprasaṅga iti cet, maivam| evaṃ śabdārthakalpane pramāṇabhāvāt|
analyzed: nanu apahatapāpmatvam na pāpma virahaḥ kiṃ tu pāpma hetu karma ācaraṇe pi na tasya nitya siddhatvena bandhasya mithyātva prasaṅgaḥ evam satyasaṅkalpatvam api śakti rūpeṇa nirvācyam iti na īśvara abheda prasaṅgaḥ iti ced mā evam evam śabda artha kalpane pramāṇa bhāvāt

original: na hi pāpajananapratibandhikā śaktiḥ saṃsārarūpaparibhramaṇadaśāyāṃ pāpānutpattyarthaṃ kalpanīyā| tadānīṃ tadutpatteriṣṭatvāt| vidyotayaprabhṛti tu vidyāmāhātmyādevāśleṣaḥ `tadadhigama uttarapūrvaghayoraśleṣavināśau tadvyapadeśāt' iti sūtreṇa darśitaḥ| tata eva muktāvapyaśleṣa upapadyata iti vyarthā śaktikalpanā|
analyzed: na hi pāpa janana pratibandhikā śaktiḥ saṃsāra rūpa paribhramaṇa daśāyām pāpa anutpatti artham kalpanīyā tadānīm tad utpatteḥ iṣṭa tvāt vidyotaya prabhṛti tu vidyā māhātmyāt eva āśleṣaḥ tad adhigamaḥ tad vyapadeśāt iti sūtreṇa darśitaḥ tatas eva muktau api aśleṣaḥ upapadyate iti vyarthā śakti kalpanā

original: tasmādudāhṛtaśrutisūtrānusāribhirmuktajīvānāṃ yāvatsarvamukti vastusaccaitanyamātratvāvirodhibaddhapuruṣavidyākṛtaniravagrahaiśvaryatadanuguṇaguṇakalāpaviśiṣṭaniratiśayānandasphuraṇasamṛddhanissandhibandhaparameśvarabhāvāpattirādartavyeti siddham||
analyzed: tasmāt udāhṛta śruti sūtra anusāribhiḥ mukta jīvānām yāvatsarvamukti vastu sat caitanya mātratva avirodhi baddha puruṣa vidyā kṛta niravagraha aiśvarya tad anuguṇa guṇa kalāpa viśiṣṭa niratiśaya ānanda sphuraṇa samṛddha nissandhi bandha parameśvara bhāva āpattiḥ ādartavyā iti siddham

original: vidvadgurorvihitaviśvajidadhvarasya śrīsarvatomukhamahāvratayājisūnoḥ|
analyzed: vidvat guroḥ vihita viśvajit adhvarasya śrī sarvatomukha mahāvrata yāji sūnoḥ

original: śrīraṅgarājamakhinaḥ śritacandramaulerastyappadīkṣita iti prathitastanūjaḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: śrī raṅga rāja makhinaḥ śrita candramauleḥ asti appadīkṣitaḥ iti prathitaḥ tanūjaḥ

original: tantrāṇyadhītya sakalāni sadā'vadātavyākhyānakauśalakalāviśadīkṛtāni|
analyzed: tantrāṇi adhītya sakalāni sadā avadāta vyākhyāna kauśala kalā viśadīkṛtāni

original: āmnāyamūlamanurudhya ca sampradāyam siddhāntabhedalavasaṅgrahamityakārṣīt || 2 ||
analyzed: āmnāya mūlam anurudhya ca sampradāyam siddhānta bheda lava saṅgraham iti akārṣīt 2

original: siddhāntarītiṣu mayā bhramadūṣitena syādanyathā'pi likhitaṃ yadi kañcidasya||
analyzed: siddhānta rītiṣu mayā bhrama dūṣitena syāt anyathā api likhitam yadi kañcid asya

original: saṃśodhane sahṛdayāḥ sadayā bhavantu satsampradāyapariśīlananirviśaṅkāḥ ||3||
analyzed: saṃśodhane sahṛdayāḥ sa dayāḥ bhavantu sat sampradāya pariśīlana nirviśaṅkāḥ

original: || iti śāstrasiddhāntaleśasaṅgrahe caturthaḥ paricchedaḥ||
analyzed: iti śāstrasiddhāntaleśasaṅgrahe caturthaḥ paricchedaḥ
